Berakhot 31a:4-13: Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: asur leadam sheyyemalle sechok piv baolam hazze, shenneemar: "az yimmale sechok pinu uleshonenu rinna". ematay, bizman sheyyomru vaggoyim higdil Adonai laasot im elle". amru alav al resh lakish shemmiyyamav lo mille sechok piv baolam hazze, mikki shama merabbi yochanan rabbeh.
Tanu rabbanan: en omdin lehitpallel lo mittoch din, velo mittoch devar halacha, ella mittoch halacha pesuka.
Amar abbaye: ki ha derabbi zera, deamar rabbi zera: benot yisrael hechemiru al atzman, sheafillu root tippat dam kechardal yoshvot aleha shiva nekiyyim.
Rava amar, ki ha derav hoshaya, deamar rav hoshaya: maarim adam al tevuato umachnisah bammotz shellah, kede shettehe behemto ochelet, ufetura min hammaaser.
Veibbaet ema, ki ha derav huna, deamar rav huna, amar rabbi zeera: hammakkiz dam bevehemat kodashim, asur bahanaa, umoalin bo.
Rabbanan avdi kematnitin, rav ashe aved kevarayyta.

Tanu rabbanan: en omdin lehitpallel lo mittoch atzvut, velo mittoch atzlut, velo mittoch sechok, velo mittoch sicha, velo mittoch kallut rosh, velo mittoch devarim betelim, ella mittoch simcha shel mitzva.

Vechen lo yippater adam mechavero lo mittoch sicha, velo mittoch sechok, velo mittoch kallut rosh, velo mittoch devarim betelim, ella mittoch devar halacha. shekken matzinu banneviim harishonim, shessiyyemu divrehem bedivre shevach vetanchumim.
Vechen tena mari bar bereh derav huna bereh derabbi yirmeya bar abba: al yippater adam mechavero ella mittoch devar halacha, shemmittoch kach zochrehu.
Chullin 84a:25-84b:4: Harotze sheyyitashsher yaasok bivhema dakka. amar rav chisda, may dichtiv: "veashterot tzoncha" – shemmeashsherot et baalehen.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: kasa decharashin, vela kasa defoshrin. vehane mille bichli mattachot, aval bichli cheres let lan ba. uvichle mattachot name la amaran, ella dela shade behu tzivayya, aval shade behu tzivayya let lan ba. vechi la shade behu tzivayya name la amaran, ella dela tzitz, aval tzitz let lan ba.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: mi shehinniach lo aviv maot verotze leabbedan – yilbash kele fishtan, veyishtammesh bichle zechuchit, veyiskor poalim veal yeshev immahen. yilbosh kele fishtan – bechittana romita. veyishtammesh bichle zechuchit – bezuggita chivvarta. veyiskor poalim veal yashav immahen – betore dinfish pesedayyhu.

Daresh rav avvira, zimnin amar la mishshemeh derabbi amme, vezimnin amar la mishshemeh derabbi assi: may dichtiv "tov ish chonen umalve yechalkel devarav bemishpat"? leolam yochal adam veyishte pachot mimma sheyyesh lo, veyilbash veyitkasse bema sheyyesh lo, vichabbed ishto uvanav yoter mimma sheyyesh lo, shehen teluyin bo vehu taluy bemi sheamar vehaya haolam.
Eruvin 82a:2-8: Gufa, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol makom sheamar rabbi yehuda "ematay" uvamme" bemishnatenu — eno ella lefaresh divre chachamim. verabbi yochanan amar: "ematay" lefaresh, uvamme" lachalok.
Veematay" lefaresh hu? veha tenan: veellu hen happesulim: hamesachek bekuveya, umalve beribbit, umafriche yonim, vesochare sheviit.
Amar rabbi yehuda: ematay — bizman sheen lo ummanut ella hi, aval yesh lo ummanut shello hi — hare ze kasher.
Vetane ala bevarayyta, vachachamim omrim: ben sheen lo ummanut ella hi, uven sheyyesh lo ummanut shello hi — hare ze pasul.
Hahi derabbi yehuda amar rabbi tarfon hi.
Detanya, amar rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi tarfon: leolam en echad mehen nazir, lefi sheen nezirut ella lehafelaa.
Alma kevan dimsappeka leh i nazir i la nazir hu — la meshabed nafsheh. hacha name: kevan dela yada i kane i la kane — la gamar umakne.

Kiddushin 39b:15-40a:3: Rame rav tovi bar rav kisna lerava: tenan kol haose mitzva achat metivin lo: asa – in, lo asa – la. ureminhi: yashav velo avar avera – notnim lo sachar keose mitzva! amar leh: hatam, kegon shebba devar avera leyado venitztzol hemenna.

Ki ha derabbi chanina bar pappe tevateh hahi matronita. amar milleta umalli nafsheh shichna vechiva, avada hi milleta veittassi. arak, tesha behahu be vane dechi havo ayylin bitren afillu bimama havo mittazzeki. limchar amaru leh rabbanan: man natrach? amar lehu: shene

Nose kesar shemaruni kol hallayla. amaru leh: shemma devar erva ba leyadcha venitztzalta hemennu, ditnena: kol habba devar erva leyado venitztzal hemennu – osin lo nes. "gibbore choach ose devaro lishmoa bekol devaro" – kegon rabbi tzadok vachaverav.

Rabbi tzadok tevateh hahi matronita, amar la: chalash li libbay vela matzena, ikka midde lemechal? amara leh: ikka davar tame. amar la: may nafka minna? deaved ha – achevl ha. shegarat tannura, ka mannecha leh. salek veyatev begavveh. amara leh: may hay? amar la: deaved ha – nafel beha. amra leh: i yadi kulle hay – la tzaartaych.

Rav kahana hava kamzabben dikkule, tevateh hahi matronita. amar la: ezil eykashshet nafshay, salek vekanafel meiggara leara. ata eliyyahu kabbeleh. amar leh: atrachtan arba mea parse! amar leh: mi geram li, lav anyuta? yehav leh shifa dedinare.
Mishnah Bava Batra 10:2-5:
Get pashut, edav bishnayim. umekushshar, bishlosha. pashut shekkatuv bo ed echad, umekushshar shekkatuv bo shene edim, shenehem pesulin. katav bo zuzin mea deinnun silin esrin, en lo ella esrin. zuzin mea deinnun telatin silin, en lo ella mane. chesaf zuzin deinnun, venimchak, en pachut mishshetayim. kesaf silin deinnun, venimchak, en pachut mishshenayim. darkonot deinnun, venimchak, en pachut mishshetayim. katuv bo milmala mane umillematta matayim, milmala matayim umillematta mane, hakkol holech achar hattachton. im ken, lamma chotvin et haelyon, sheim timmachek ot achat min hattachton, yilmad min haelyon: 
Kotvin get laish af al pi sheen ishto immo, vehashshover laishsha af al pi sheen balah immah, uvilvad sheyyehe makkiran, vehabbaal noten sachar. kotvin shetar lelove af al pi sheen malve immo, veen kotvin lemalve, ad sheyyehe love immo, vehallove noten sachar. kotvin shetar lemocher af al pi sheen lokeach immo. veen kotvin lelokeach, ad sheyyehe mocher immo, vehallokeach noten sachar: 
En kotvin shetare erusin venissuin ella middaat shenehem, vehechatan noten sachar. en kotvin shetare arisut vekabbelanut ella middaat shenehem, vehamekabbel noten sachar. en kotvin shetare verurin vechol maase vet din ella middaat shenehem, ushenehem notnin sachar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, shenehem kotvin shenayim, laze leatzmo velaze leatzmo: 
Mi sheppara miktzat chovo vehishlish et shetaro veamar lo, im lo natatti lecha mikkan vead yom peloni ten lo shetaro, higgia zeman velo natan, rabbi yose omer, yitten. rabbi yehuda omer, lo yitten:
Mishnah Bava Batra 10:6-8:
Mi shennimchak shetar chovo, meidin alav edim, uva lifne vet din veosin lo kiyyum, ish peloni ven peloni nimchak shetaro beyom peloni, ufeloni ufeloni edav. mi sheppara miktzat chovo, rabbi yehuda omer, yachalif. rabbi yose omer, yichtov shover. amar rabbi yehuda, nimtza ze tzarich lihyot shomer shovro min haachbarim. amar lo rabbi yose, kach yafe lo, velo yura kocho shel ze: 
Shene achin, echad ani veechad ashir, vehinniach lahen avihen merchatz uvet habbad, asaan lesachar, hassachar laemtza. asaan leatzman, hare heashir omer leani, kach lecha avadim veyirchatzu vammerchatz, kach lecha zetim uvo vaasem bevet habbad. shenayim shehayu veir achat, shem echad yosef ben shimon veshem acher yosef ben shimon, en yecholin lehotzi shetar chov ze al ze velo acher yachol lehotzi alehen shetar chov. nimtza leechad ben shetarotav shetaro shel yosef ben shimon parua, shetarot shenehen peruin. ketzad yaasu, yeshaleshu. veim hayu meshullashim, yichtevu siman. veim hayu mesummanin, yichtevu kohen. haomer livno, shetar ben shetarotay parua veeni yodea ezehu, shetarot kullan peruin. nimtza leechad sham shenayim, haggadol parua vehakkatan eno farua. hammalve et chavero al yede arev, lo yippara min hearev. veim amar al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze, yippara min hearev. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, im yesh nechasim lallove, ben kach uven kach lo yippara min hearev. vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hearev laishsha bichtubbatah vehaya valah megarshah, yaddirenna hanaa, shemma yaasu kenuneya al nechasim shel ze veyachazir et ishto: 
Hammalve et chavero bishtar, gove minnechasim meshubadim. al yede edim, gove minnechasim bene chorin. hotzi alav ketav yado shehu chayyav lo, gove minnechasim bene chorin. arev hayyotze leachar chittum shetarot, gove minnechasim bene chorin. maase va lifne rabbi yishmael veamar, gove minnechasim bene chorin. amar lo ben nannas, eno gove lo minnechasim meshubadim velo minnechasim bene chorin. amar lo, lamma. amar lo, hare hachonek et echad bashshuk umetzao chavero veamar lo hannach lo, patur, shello al emunato hilvahu. ella ezehu arev shehu chayyav, halevehu vaani noten lecha, chayyav, shekken al emunato hilvahu. amar rabbi yishmael, harotze sheyyachkim, yaasok bedine mamonot, sheen lecha miktzoa battora gadol mehen, shehen kemayan hannovea. veharotze sheyyaasok bedine mamonot, yeshammesh et shimon ben nannas:
Mishnah Eruvin 1:1-3:
Mavoy shehu gavoah lemala meesrim amma, yemaet. rabbi yehuda omer, eno tzarich. veharachav meeser ammot, yemaet. veim yesh lo tzurat happetach, af al pi shehu rachav meeser ammot, en tzarich lemaet: 
Hechsher mavoy, bet shammay omrim, lechi vekora, uvet hillel omrim, lechi o kora. rabbi eliezer omer, lechayayin. mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad lifne rabbi akiva, lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al mavoy shehu fachot mearba ammot, shehu o velechi o vekora. al ma nechleku, al rachav mearba ammot vead eser, shebbet shammay omrim, lechi vekora, uvet hillel omrim, o lechi o kora. amar rabbi akiva, al ze veal ze nechelaku: 
Hakkora sheamru, rechava kede lekabbel ariach. veariach, chatzi levena shel shelosha tefachim. dayya lakkora shettehe rechava tefach, kede lekabbel ariach learko:
Mishnah Eruvin 1:4-8:
Rechava, kede lekabbel ariach, uveria, kede lekabbel ariach. rabbi yehuda omer, rechava af al pi sheen beria: 
Hayta shel kash o shel kanim, roin otah keillu hi shel mattechet. akumma, roin otah keillu hi feshuta. agulla, roin otah keillu hi merubbaat. kol sheyyesh behekkefo shelosha tefachim, yesh bo rochav tafach: 
Lechayayin sheamru, gavhan asara tefachim, verachban veavyan kol shehu. rabbi yose omer, rachban shelosha tefachim: 
Bakkol osin lechayayin, afillu vedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim. verabbi yose oser. umetamme mishshum golel, verabbi meir metaher. vechotvin alav gitte nashim, verabbi yose haggelili fosel: 
Shayyara shechanta bevika vehikkifuha vichle vehema, metaltelin betochah, uvilvad sheyyehe gader gavoah asara tefachim, velo yihyu feratzot yeterot al habbinyan. kol pirtza shehi cheeser ammot, mutteret, mippene shehi chefetach. yater mikkan, asur:
Mishnah Negaim 1:1-2:
Marot negaim shenayim shehen arbaa. baheret azza chashsheleg, sheniyya lah kesid hahechol. vehasseet kikrum betza, sheniyya lah ketzemer lavan, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hasseet ketzemer lavan, sheniyya lah kikrum betza: 
Happatuch shebbashsheleg, keyayin hammazug beshaleg, happatuch shebbassid, kedam hammazug bechalav, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer, adamdam shebbaze veshebbaze, keyayin hammazug bemayim, ella shel sheleg azza veshel sid deha mimmenna:
Mishnah Negaim 1:3-6:
Arbaa marot haellu mitztarfin ze im ze liftor, ulehachlit, ulehasgir. lehasegir et haomed besof shavua rishon. liftor et haomed besof shavua sheni. lehachelit et shennolad lo michya o sear lavan, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. lehachelit et shennolad lo fisyon, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. lehachelit et hahofech kullo lavan mittoch happetur. liftor et hahofech kullo lavan mittoch hechlet o mittoch hesger. ellu marot negaim shekkol negaim teluyim bahen: 
Rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, marot negaim shishsha asar. rabbi dosa ben harekinas omer, marot negaim sheloshim veshishsha. akavya ven mahalalel omer, shivim ushenayim. rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, en roim et hannegaim battechilla leachar hashshabbat, sheshshavua shello chal lihyot beshabbat. velo vashsheni, sheshshavua sheni shello chal lihyot beshabbat. velo vashshelishi labbattim, sheshshavua shelishi shello chal lihyot beshabbat. rabbi akiva omer, leolam roim. chal lihyot betoch hashshabbat, maavirin leachar hashshabbat. veyesh baddavar lehakel ulehachmir: 
Ketzad lehakel. haya vo sear lavan vehalach lo sear lavan, hayu levanot vehishchiru, achat levana veachat shechora, vehishchiru shetehen, arukkot vehiktziru, achat arukka veachat ketzara vehiktziru shetehen, nismach hashshechin lishtehen o leachat mehen, hikkif hashshechin lishtehen o leachat mehen, o chillekan hashshechin umichyat hashshechin vehammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak, hayta vo michya vehalcha lah hammichya, hayta merubbaat venaaset agulla o arukka, mevutztzeret venaaset min hatztzad, mechunneset venitpazzera, uva hashshechin venichnas betochah. hikkifah, chillekah, o miatah hashshechin o michyat hashshechin, vehammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak, haya vo fisyon vehalach lo fisyon, o shehalcha lah haom o shennitmaata veen baze uvaze chaggeris, hashshechin umichyat hashshechin vehammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak cholkin ben haom lappisyon, hare ellu lehakel: 
Ketzad lehachemir. lo haya vo sear lavan venolad lo sear lavan, hayu shechorot vehilbinu, achat shechora veachat levana vehilbinu shetehen, ketzarot veheerichu, achat ketzara veachat arukka veheerichu shetehen, nismach hashshechin lishtehen o leachat mehen, hikkif hashshechin et shetehen o et achat mehen, o chilleko hashshechin umichyat hashshechin vehammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak vehalchu lahem, lo hayta vo michya venolda lo michya, hayta agulla o arukka venaaset merubbaat, min hatztzad venaaset mevutztzeret, mefuzzeret venitkannesa uva hashshechin venichnas betochah, hikkifah, chillekah, o miatah hashshechin o michyat hashshechin vehammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak vehalchu lahen, lo haya vo fisyon venolad bo fisyon, hashshechin umichyat hashshechin vehammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak cholkin ben haom lappisyon vehalchu lahen, hare ellu lehachemir:
Mishnah Negaim 2:1-5:
Baheret azza niret baggermani keha, vehakkeha vakkushi azza. rabbi yishmael omer, bene yisrael, ani chapparatan, hare hen keeshkeroa, lo shechorim velo levanim, ella venoniyyim. rabbi akiva omer, yesh latztzayyarim sammanin shehen tzarin tzurot shechorot, levanot uvenoniyyot. mevi sam benoni umakkifo mibbachutz, veterae vabbenoni. rabbi yehuda omer, marot negaim lehakel aval lo lehachemir, yerae haggermani bivsaro lehakel, vehakkushi babbenoni lehakel. vachachamim omrim, ze vaze babbenoni: 
En roim hannegaim bashshacharit uven haarbayim, velo vetoch habbayit, velo vayyom hameunnan, lefi shehakkeha niret azza. velo vatztzohorayim, lefi sheazza niret keha. ematay roin. beshalosh, bearba, uvechamesh, uvesheva, uvishmone, uvetesha, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, bearba, bechamesh, bishmone, uvetesha: 
Kohen hassuma veachat meenav, o shekkaha meor enav, lo yire et hannegaim, shenneemar (Vayikra 13), lechol mare ene hakkohen. bayit haafel, en potchin bo challonot lirot et nigo: 
Ketzad reiyyat hannega. haish nire cheoder, uchemosek zetim. haishsha keorechet uchemenika et benah, keoreget beomdin lashshechi layyad hayemanit. rabbi yehuda omer, af ketova vefishtan lassemalit. keshem shennire lenigo, kach hu nire letiglachto: 
Kol hannegaim adam roe, chutz minnige atzmo. rabbi meir omer, af lo nige kerovav. kol hannedarim adam mattir, chutz minnidre atzmo. rabbi yehuda omer, af lo nidre ishto shebbenah leven acherim. kol habbechorot adam roe, chutz mibbechorot atzmo:
Mishnah Negaim 3:1-4:
Hakkol mittammein bannegaim, chutz min hannachrim veger toshav. hakkol kesherim lirot et hannegaim, ella shehattuma vehattohora vide chohen. omrim lo emor tame, vehu omer tame. emor tahor, vehu omer tahor. en roim shene negaim keechad, ben beish echad uven bishne anashim, ella roe et haechad umasgiro umachlito ufotro, vechozer lashsheni. en masgirin et hammusgar velo machlitin et hammuchlat. en masgirin et hammuchlat, velo machlitin et hammusgar. aval battechilla, besof shavua, hammasgir masgir, vehammachlit machlit, masgir ufoter, machlit ufoter: 
Chatan shennira vo nega, notnin lo shivat yeme hammishte, lo uleveto velichsuto. vechen baregel, notnin lo chol yemot haragel: 
Or habbasar mittamme vishne shavuot uvishlosha simanin, besear lavan uvemichya uvefisyon. besear lavan uvemichya, battechilla, uvesof shavua rishon, uvesof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. uvefisyon, besof shavua rishon, uvesof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. umittamme vishne shavuot, shehen shelosha asar yom: 
Hashshechin vehammichva mittammein beshavua echad uvishne simanin, besear lavan uvefisyon. besear lavan, battechilla, besof shavua, leachar happetur. uvefisyon, besof shavua, leachar happetur. umittammein beshavua echad, shehu shivat yamim:
Mishnah Negaim 3:5-8:
Hannetakin mittammein bishne shavuot, bishne simanin, besear tzahov dak uvefisyon. besear tzahov dak, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. uvefisyon, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. umittammein bishne shavuot, shehen shelosha asar yom: 
Hakkarachat vehaggabbachat mittammeot bishne shavuot, uvishne simanin, bemichya uvefisyon. bemichya, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. uvefisyon, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, uleachar happetur. umittammeot bishne shavuot, shehen shelosha asar yom: 
Habbegadim mittammeim bishne shavuot uvishlosha simanin, birakrak uvaadamdam uvefisyon. birakrak uvaadamdam, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, uvesof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. uvefisyon, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur. umittammein bishne shavuot, shehen shelosha asar yom: 
Habbattim mittammein bishlosha shavuot uvishlosha simanim, birakrak uvaadamdam uvefisyon. birakrak uvaadamdam, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, besof shavua shelishi, leachar happetur. uvefisyon, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, besof shavua shelishi, leachar happetur. umittammein bishlosha shavuot, shehen tisha asar yom. en bannegaim pachot mishshavua echad, velo yoter al shelosha shavuot:
Mishnah Oholot 18:4-8:
Sede vochin, lo nittaat, velo nizraat, vaafarah tahor, veosin mimmenna tannurim lakkodesh. umodim bet shammay uvet hillel shebbodkim leose fesach, veen bodkin litruma. ulenazir, bet shammay omrim, bodkin. uvet hillel omrim, en bodkin. ketzad hu vodek. mevi et heafar shehu yachol lahasito venoten letoch kevara shennekaveha dakkim, umemache, im nimtza sham etzem kasseora, tame: 
Ketzad metaharin bet happeras. notlin mimmennu shelosha tefachim, o noten al gabbav shelosha tefachim. im natal mechetzyo echad shelosha tefachim, venatan al gabbe chetzyo acher shelosha tefachim, tahor. rabbi shimon omer, afillu natal mimmennu tefach umechetza, venatan alav tefach umechetza mimmakom acher, tahor. harotzef bet happeras baavanim sheeno yachol lahasitan, tahor. rabbi shimon omer, af haozek bet happeras, tahor: 
Hamehallech bevet happeras al avanim sheeno yachol lahasitan, al haadam veal habbehema shekkochan yafe, tahor. al avanim shehu yachol lahasitan, al haadam veal habbehema shekkochan ra, tame. hamehallech beeretz haammim, beharim uvasselaim, tame. bayyam uvashshunit, tahor. veezehu hashshunit, kol makom shehayyam ole vezapo: 
Hakkone sade vesureya, semucha leeretz yisrael, im yachol lehikkanes lah betohora, tehora, vechayyevet bammaasrot uvashsheviit. veim eno yachol lehikkanes lah betohora, temea, vechayyevet bammaasrot uvashsheviit. medorot haggoyim, temein. kamma yishhe vetochan vihe tzarich bedika, arbaim yom, af al pi sheen immo ishsha. veim haya eved o ishsha meshammerim oto, eno tzarich bedika: 
Et ma hem bodkim, et habbivim haamukkim veet hammayim hasseruchim. bet shammay omrim, af haashpattot veafar hattichoach. uvet hillel omrim, kol mekom shehachazir vehachulda yecholim lehallech bo, eno tzarich bedika:
Mishnah Oholot 18:9-10:
Haitztevaniyyot, en bahen mishshum medor haggoyim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, ir goyim shecharva, en bah mishshum medor goyim. mizrach kisrin umaarav kisrin, kevarot. umizrach akko haya safek, vetiharuhu chachamim. rabbi uvet dino nimnu al keni vetiharuhu: 
Asara mekomot en bahen mishshum medor goyim. ohole haarviyyim, vehassukkot, vehatztzerifin, vehabburganin, vehaalketiyyot, uvet shaar, vaavirah shel chatzer, vehammerchatz, umekom hachitztzim, umekom halligyonot:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 1:1-2:
Dine mamonot, bishlosha. gezelot vachavalot, bishlosha. nezek vachatzi nezek, tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha, bishlosha. haones vehamefatte vehammotzi shem ra, bishlosha, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, motzi shem ra, beesrim ushelosha, mippene sheyyesh bo dine nefashot: 
Makkot, bishlosha. mishshum rabbi yishmael amru, beesrim ushelosha. ibbur hachodesh, bishlosha. ibbur hashshana, bishlosha, divre rabbi meir. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, bishlosha matchilin, uvachamishsha nosin venotnin, vegomrin beshiva. veim gamru vishlosha, meubberet:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 1:3-6:
Semichat zekenim vaarifat egla, bishlosha, divre rabbi shimon. verabbi yehuda omer, bachamishsha. hachalitza vehammeunin, bishlosha. neta revai umaaser sheni sheen damav yeduin, bishlosha. hahekdeshot, bishlosha. haarachin hammittaltelin, bishlosha. rabbi yehuda omer, echad mehen kohen. vehakkarkaot, tisha vechohen. veadam, kayyotze vahen: 
Dine nefashot, beesrim ushelosha. harovea vehannirba, beesrim ushelosha, sheneemar (Vayikra 20) veharagta et haishsha veet habbehema, veomer (sham) veet habbehema taharogu. shor hanniskal, beesrim ushelosha, shenneemar (Shemot 21) hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat, kemitat bealim kach mitat hashshor. hazzeev vehaari, haddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash, mitatan beesrim ushelosha. rabbi eliezer omer, kol hakkodem lehargan, zacha. rabbi akiva omer, mitatan beesrim ushelosha: 
En danin lo et hashshevet velo et nevi hashsheker velo et kohen gadol, ella al pi vet din shel shivim veechad. veen motziin lemilchemet harshut, ella al pi vet din shel shivim veechad. en mosifin al hair veal haazarot, ella al pi vet din shel shivim veechad. en osin sanhedriyyot lashshevatim, ella al pi vet din shel shivim veechad. en osin ir hanniddachat, ella al pi vet din shel shivim veechad. veen osin ir hanniddachat bassefar, velo shelosha, aval osin achat o shetayim: 
Sanhedri gedola hayta shel shivim veechad, uketanna shel esrim ushelosha. uminnayin laggedola shehi shel shivim veechad, shenneemar (Bamidbar 11) esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael, umoshe al gabbehen, hare shivim veechad. rabbi yehuda omer, shivim. uminnayin lakketanna shehi shel esrim ushelosha, shenneemar (sham la) veshaftu haeda vegomer vehitztzilu haeda, eda shofetet veeda matztzelet, hare chan esrim. uminnayin laeda shehi asara, shenneemar (sham 14) ad matay laeda haraa hazzot, yatzu yehoshua vechalev. uminnayin lehavi od shelosha, mimmashma shenneemar (Shemot 23) lo tihye achare rabbim leraot, shomea ani sheehye immahem letova, im ken lamma neemar (sham) achare rabbim lehattot, lo chehattayatcha letova hattayatcha leraa. hattayatcha letova al pi echad, hattayatcha leraa al pi shenayim, veen bet din shakul, mosifin alehem od echad, hare chan esrim ushelosha. vechamma yehe veir utehe reuya lesanhedrin, mea veesrim. rabbi nechemya omer, matayim usheloshim, keneged sare asarot:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 2:1-4:
Kohen gadol dan vedanin oto, meid umeidin oto, choletz vecholtzin leishto, umeyabbemin et ishto, aval hu eno meyabbem, mippene shehu asur baalmana. met lo met, eno yotze achar hammitta, ella hen nichsin vehu nigle, hen niglin vehu nichse, veyotze immahen ad petach hair, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, eno yotze min hammikdash, shenneemar (Vayikra 21) umin hammikdash lo yetze. ucheshehu menachem acherim, derech kol haam ovrin baze achar ze vehamemunne mematztzeo beno leven haam. ucheshehu mitnachem meacherim, kol haam omrim lo anu chapparatcha, vehu omer lahen titbarchu min hashshamayim. ucheshemmavrin oto, kol haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al hassafsal: 
Hammelech lo dan velo danin oto, lo meid velo meidin oto, lo choletz velo choltzin leishto. lo meyabbem velo meyabbemin leishto. rabbi yehuda omer, im ratza lachalotz o leyabbem, zachur latov. amru lo, en shomin lo. veen nosin almanato. rabbi yehuda omer, nose hammelech almanato shel melech, shekken matzinu vedavid shennasa almanato shel shaul, shenneemar (Shmuel b 12) vaettena lecha et bet adonecha veet neshe adonecha bechekecha: 
Met lo met, eno yotze mippetach palterin shello. rabbi yehuda omer, im rotze latzet achar hammitta, yotze, shekken matzinu vedavid sheyyatza achar mittato shel avner, shenneemar (sham 3) vehammelech david holech achare hammitta. amru lo, lo haya haddavar ella lefayyes et haam. ucheshemmavrin oto, kol haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al haddargash: 
Umotzi lemilchemet harshut al pi vet din shel shivim veechad. uforetz laasot lo derech, veen memachin beyado. derech hammelech en lo shiur. vechol haam bozzin venotnin lefanav, vehu notel chelek barosh. lo yarbe lo nashim (Devarim 17), ella shemone esre. rabbi yehuda omer, marbe hu lo, uvilvad shello yehu mesirot et libbo. rabbi shimon omer, afillu achat umesira et libbo, hare ze lo yissaenna. im ken lamma neemar (Devarim 17) velo yarbe lo nashim, afillu chaavigayil. lo yarbe lo susim (sham), ella chede merkavto. vechesef vezahav lo yarbe lo meod (sham), ella chede litten afsanya. vechotev lo sefer tora lishmo. yotze lammilchama, motziah immo. nichnas, machnisah immo. yoshev baddin, hi immo. mesev, hi chenegdo, shenneemar (sham) vehayta immo vekara vo kol yeme chayyav:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 2:5-3:4:
En rochvin al suso, veen yoshvin al kiso, veen mishtammeshin besharvito, veen roin oto keshehu mistapper velo cheshehu arom velo vevet hammerchatz, shenneemar (sham) som tasim alecha melech, shettehe emato alecha: 
Dine mamonot, bishlosha. ze borer lo echad veze borer lo echad, ushenehen borrin lahen od echad, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, shene dayyanin borrin lahen od echad. ze posel dayyano shel ze veze posel dayyano shel ze, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ematay, bizman shemmevi alehen reaya shehen kerovin o fesulin, aval im hayu chesherim o mumchin, eno yachol lefaslan. ze posel edav shel ze veze posel edav shel ze, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ematay, bizman shehu mevi alehem reaya shehen kerovim o fesulim. aval im hayu chesherim, eno yachol lefaslan: 
Amar lo neeman alay abba, neeman alay avicha, neemanin alay shelosha roe vakar, rabbi meir omer, yachol lachazor bo. vachachamim omrim, eno yachol lachazor bo. haya chayyav lachavero shevua veamar lo dor li vechayye roshcha, rabbi meir omer, yachol lachazor bo. vachachamim omrim, en yachol lachazor bo: 
Veellu hen happesulin, hamesachek bekuvya, vehammalve veribbit, umafriche yonim, vesochare sheviit. amar rabbi shimon, bitchilla hayu korin otan osfe sheviit, mishsherabbu haannasin, chazru likrotan sochare sheviit. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman sheen lahem ummanut ella hi, aval yesh lahen ummanut shello hi, kesherin: 
Veellu hen hakkerovin, aviv veachiv vaachi aviv vaachi immo uvaal achoto uvaal achot aviv uvaal achot immo uvaal immo vechamiv vegiso, hen uvenehen vechatnehen, vechorgo levaddo. amar rabbi yose, zo mishnat rabbi akiva. aval mishna rishona, dodo uven dodo. vechol harauy leyarsho, vechol hakkarov lo beotah shaa. haya karov venitrachek, hare ze kasher. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu meta vitto veyesh lo vanim mimmenna, hare ze karov:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:5-8:
Haohev vehassone. ohev, ze shushevino. sone, kol shello dibber immo shelosha yamim beeva. amru lo, lo nechshedu yisrael al kach: 
Ketzad bodkim et haedim, hayu machnisin otan umeayyemin alehen umotziin et kol haadam lachutz, umeshayyerin et haggadol shebbahen, veomrim lo emor heach atta yodea shezze chayyav laze. im amar, hu amar li sheani chayyav lo, ish peloni amar li shehu chayyav lo, lo amar kelum, ad sheyyomar, befanenu hoda lo shehu chayyav lo matayim zuz. veachar kach machnisin et hashsheni uvodkim oto. im nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanim, nosin venotnin baddavar. shenayim omrim zakkay, veechad omer chayyav, zakkay. shenayim omrim chayyav, veechad omer zakkay, chayyav. echad omer zakkay, veechad omer chayyav, vaafillu shenayim mezakkin o shenayim mechayyevin veechad omer eni yodea, yosifu haddayyanin: 
Gamru et haddavar, hayu machnisin otan. haggadol shebbaddayyanim omer, ish peloni atta zakkay, ish peloni atta chayyav. uminnayin lichsheyyetze echad min haddayyanim lo yomar ani mezakke vachaveray mechayyevin aval ma eese shechaveray rabbu alay, al ze neemar lo telech rachil beammecha (Vayikra 19), veomer holech rachil megalle sod (Mishlei 11): 
Kol zeman shemmevi reaya, soter et haddin. amru lo, kol reayot sheyyesh lecha have mikkan ad sheloshim yom. matza vetoch sheloshim yom, soter. leachar sheloshim yom, eno soter. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, ma yaase ze shello matza vetoch sheloshim umatza leachar sheloshim. amru lo have edim veamar en li edim, amru have reaya veamar en li reaya, uleachar zeman hevi reaya umatza edim, hare ze eno chelum. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, ma yaase ze shello haya yodea sheyyesh lo edim umatza edim, lo haya yodea sheyyesh lo reaya umatza reaya. amru lo have edim, amar en li edim, have reaya veamar en li reaya, raa shemmitchayyev baddin veamar kirvu peloni ufeloni vehaiduni, o shehotzi reaya mittoch afundato, hare ze eno chelum:
Mishnah Shabbat 21:2-22:2:
Haeven sheal pi hechavit, mattah al tziddah vehi nofelet. hayta ven hechaviyyot, magbiah umattah al tziddah vehi nofelet. maot sheal hakkar, noer et hakkar vehen noflot. hayta alav lashleshet, mekannechah bismartut. hayta shel or, notnin aleha mayim ad shettichle: 
Bet shammay omrim, magbihin min hashshulchan atzamot ukelippin. uvet hillel omrim, notel et hattavla chullah umenaarah. maavirin millifne hashshulchan perurin pachot mikkazzayit vesear shel afunin vesear shel adashim, mippene shehu maachal behema. sefog, im yesh lo or bet achiza, mekannechin bo, veim lav, en mekannechin bo. vachachamim omrim ben kach uven kach, nittal beshabbat, veeno mekabbel tuma: 
Chavit shennishbera, matztzilin hemenna mezon shalosh seuddot, veomer laacherim, bou vehatztzilu lachem, uvilvad shello yispog. en sochatin et happerot lehotzi mehen mashkin, veim yatzu meatzman, asurin. rabbi yehuda omer, im leochalin, hayyotze mehen muttar, veim lemashkin, hayyotze mehen asur. challot devash sherissekan meerev shabbat veyatzu meatzman, asurin. verabbi eliezer mattir: 
Kol shebba vechammin meerev shabbat, shorin oto vechammin beshabbat, vechol shello va vechammin meerev shabbat, medichin oto vechammin beshabbat, chutz min hammaliach hayyashan, vedagim meluchim ketannim vekuleyas haispanin, shehadachatan zo hi gemar melachtan:
Mishnah Shabbat 22:3-6:
Shover adam et hechavit leechol hemenna gerogarot, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot keli. veen nokvim megufa shel chavit, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim mattirin. velo yikkevenna mitztziddah. veim hayta nekuva, lo yitten aleha shaava, mippene shehu memareach. amar rabbi yehuda, maase va lifne rabban yochanan ben zakkay baarav, veamar, choshshani lo mechattat: 
Notnin tavshil letoch habbor bishvil sheyyehe shamur, veet hammayim hayyafim baraim bishvil sheyyitztzannu, veet hatztzonen bachamma bishvil sheyyechammu. mi shennashru chelav badderech bemayim, mehallech bahen veeno choshesh. higgia lechatzer hachitzona, shotchan bachamma, aval lo cheneged haam: 
Harochetz beme meara uveme teverya venistappeg, afillu veeser alunetiot, lo yeviem beyado. aval asara vene adam mistappegin baalunetit achat penehem yedehem veraglehem, umeviin otah beyadan: 
Sachin umemashmeshin bivne meayim, aval lo mitammelin velo mitgardin. en yordin lekordima, veen osin appiktevizin, veen meatztzevin et hakkatan, veen machazirin et hashshever. mi shennifreka yado veraglo, lo yitrefem betzonen, aval rochetz hu chedarko, veim nitrappa nitrappa:
Mishnah Shabbat 23:1-5:
Shoel adam mechavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen, uvilvad shello yomar lo haleveni, vechen haishsha mechavertah kikkarot. veim eno maamino, manniach tallito etzlo veose immo cheshbon leachar shabbat. vechen erev pesach birushalayim shechal lihyot beshabbat, manniach tallito etzlo venotel et pischo, veose immo cheshbon leachar yom tov: 
Mone adam et orchav veet parperotav mippiv, aval lo min hakketav. umefis im banav veim bene veto al hashshulchan, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot mana gedola keneged ketanna, mishshum kuvya. umattilin chalashim al hakkadashim beyom tov, aval lo al hammanot: 
Lo yiskor adam poalim beshabbat, velo yomar adam lachavero liskor lo foalim. en machshichin al hattechum liskor poalim ulehavi ferot, aval machshich hu lishmor, umevi ferot beyado. kelal amar abba shaul, kol sheani zakkay baamirato, rashshay ani lehacheshich alav: 
Machshichin al hattechum lefakkeach al iske challa, veal iske hammet lehavi lo aron vetachrichin. goy shehevi chalilin beshabbat, lo yispod bahen yisrael, ella im ken bau mimmakom karov. asu lo aron vechafru lo kever, yikkaver bo yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael, lo yikkaver bo olamit: 
Osin kol tzarche hammet, sachin umedichin oto, uvilvad shello yazizu vo ever. shomtin et hakkar mittachtav umattilin oto al hachol bishvil sheyyamtin. koshrim et hallechi, lo sheyyaale, ella shello yosif. vechen kora shennishbera, somchin otah besafsal o baarukkot hammitta, lo shettaale, ella shello tosif. en meammetzin et hammet beshabbat, velo vechol im yetziat nefesh. vehameammetz im yetziat nefesh, hare ze shofech damim:
Mishnah Shabbat 24:1-4:
Mi shehechshich badderech, noten kiso lenachri, veim en immo nachri, menicho al hachamor. higgia lechatzer hachitzona, notel et hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat, vesheenan nittalin beshabbat, mattir et hachavalim, vehassakkin noflin mealehem: 
Mattirin pekie amir lifne vehema, umefaspesim et hakkefin, aval lo et hazzerin. en merassekin lo et hashshachat velo et hecharuvin lifne vehema, ben dakka ben gassa. rabbi yehuda mattir becharuvin laddakka: 
En ovsin et haggamal, velo dorsin, aval malitin. veen mamrim et haagalim, aval malitin. umehalketin lattarnegolin. venotnin mayim lammursan, aval lo govlim. veen notnin mayim lifne devorim velifne yonim shebbashshovach, aval notnin lifne avazim vetarnegolim velifne yone hardesiyyot: 
Mechattechin et haddeluin lifne habbehema, veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim. rabbi yehuda omer, im lo hayta nevela meerev shabbat, asura, lefi sheenah min hammuchan:
Mishnah Shabbat 24:5: Mefirin nedarim beshabbat, venishalin lidvarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat. pokkin et hammaor, umoddin et hammatlit veet hammikve. umaase vime aviv shel rabbi tzadok uvime abba shaul ben batnit, sheppakku et hammaor betafiach, vekashru et hammekeda vegemi, leda im yesh baggigit poteach tefach im lav. umiddivrehen lamadnu, sheppokkin umoddin vekoshrin beshabbat:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Tefilat hashshachar mitzvatah sheyyatchil lehitpallel im hanetz hachamma uzemannah ad sof shaa reviit shehi shelishit hayyom. veim avar o taa vehitpallel achar arba ad chatzot hayyom yatza yede chovat tefilla. aval lo yatza yede chovat tefilla bizmannah. shekkeshem shettefilla mitzva min hattora kach mitzva middivrehem lehitpallel otah bizmannah kemo shettiknu lanu chachamim uneviim:

Kevar amarnu shettefillat hammincha keneged tamid shel ben haarbayim tikkenu zemannah. ulefi shehaya hattamid karev bechol yom betesha shaot umechetza tikkenu zemannah mittesha shaot umechetza vehi hannikret mincha ketanna. ulefi shebbeerev happesach shechal lihyot beerev shabbat hayu shochatin et hattamid beshesh shaot umechetza, amru shehammitpallel meachar shesh shaot umechetza yatza. umishshehiggia zeman ze higgia zeman chiyyuvah vezo hi hannikret mincha gedola:

Nahagu anashim harebe lehitpallel gedola uketanna vehaachat reshut. vehoru miktzat haggeonim sheen rauy lehitpallel reshut ella haggedola. vechen haddin noten mippene shehi keneged davar sheeno tadir bechol yom. veim hitpallel haggedola chova lo yitpallel ketanna ella reshut:

Ha lamadta shezzeman mincha gedola mishshesh shaot umechetza ad tesha shaot umechetza. uzeman mincha ketanna mittesha shaot umechetza ad sheyyishshaer min hayyom shaa urevia. veyesh lo lehitpallel otah ad shettishka hachamma:
Tefillat hammusafin zemannah achar tefillat hashshachar ad sheva shaot bayyom. vehammitpallel otah achar sheva shaot af al pi sheppasha yatza yede chovato mippene shezzemannah kol hayyom:
Tefillat haerev af al pi sheenah chova hammitpallel otah zemannah mittechillat hallayla ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. vtfillat neila zemanna kede sheyyashlim otah samuch lishkiat hachamma:

Hammitpallel tefilla kodem zemannah lo yatza yede chovato vechozer umitpallel otah bizmannah. veim hitpallel tefillat shacharit bishat haddechak achar sheala ammud hashshachar yatza. veyesh lo lehitpallel tefillat arvit shel lele shabbat beerev shabbat kodem shettishka hachamma. vechen yitpallel arvit shel motzae shabbat beshabbat lefi shettefillat arvit reshut en medakdekin bizmannah. uvilvad sheyyikra keriat shema bizmannah achar tzet hakkochavim:

Kol mi sheavar alav zeman tefilla velo hitpallel bemezid en lo takkana veeno meshallem. beshogeg o shehaya anus o tarud meshallem otah tefilla bizman tefilla hassemucha lah. umakdim tefilla shebbizmannah veachareha mitpallel et hattashlumin:

Ketzad. taa velo hitpallel shacharit veavar chatzi hayyom yitpallel mincha shetayim. rishona tefillat mincha vehashsheniyya tashlume shacharit. taa velo hitpallel mincha ad sheshshaka hachamma yitpallel arvit shetayim. rishona arvit usheniyya tashlume mincha. taa velo hitpallel arvit ad sheala ammud hashshachar mitpallel shacharit shetayim. rishona shacharit vehashsheniyya tashlume arvit:

Taa velo hitpallel lo tefilla zo velo tefilla hassemucha lah eno meshallem ella acharona bilvad. ketzad. taa velo hitpallel lo shacharit velo mincha mitpallel arvit shetayim rishona arvit vehaacharona tashlume mincha. aval shacharit en lah tashlumin shekkevar avar zemannah. vechen bishar tefillot:
Hayu lefanav shete tefillot shel mincha veshel musafin mitpallel shel mincha veachar kach mitpallel shel musafin. veyesh mi shemmore sheen osin betzibbur ken kede shello yitu:
Chamishsha devarim meakkevin et hattefilla af al pi shehiggia zemanna. tohorat yadayim. vechissuy haerva. vetohorat mekom tefilla. udevarim hachofzim oto. vechavvanat hallev:

Tohorat yadayim ketzad. rochetz yadav bemayim ad happerek veachar kach yitpallel. haya mehallech badderech vehiggia zeman tefilla velo haya lo mayim. im haya beno uven hammayim arbaa milin shehem shemonat alafim amma holech ad mekom hammayim verochetz veachar kach yitpallel. haya beno uven hammayim yoter al ken mekanneach yadav bitzror o beafar o bekora umitpallel:

Bamme devarim amurim lefanav aval im haya mekom hammayim laachorav en mechayyevin oto lachazor laachorav ella ad mil. aval im avar min hammayim yoter eno chayyav lachazor ella mekanneach yadav umitpallel. bamme devarim amurim sheeno metaher litfilla ella yadav bilvad, bishar tefillot chutz mittefillat shacharit. aval shacharit rochetz panav yadav veraglav veachar kach yitpallel. veim haya rachok min hammayim mekanneach yadav bilvad veachar kach yitpallel:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 8:7-9:
Haddash kigrogeret chayyav veen disha ella begiddule karka. vehamefarek hare hi toledet haddash vechayyav vechen kol kayyotze baze. hacholev et habbehema chayyav mishshum mefarek vechen hachovel bechay sheyyesh lo or chayyav mishshum mefarek. vehu sheyyihye tzarich laddam sheyyetze min hachabbura. aval im nitkavven lehazzik bilvad patur mippene shehu mekalkel. veeno chayyav ad sheyyihye baddam o bachalav shehotzi kigrogeret: 
Bamme devarim amurim bechovel bivhema vechayya veof vechayyotze bahem. aval hachovel bachavero af al pi shennitkavven lehazzik chayyav mippene nachat rucho shehare nitkarra dato veshachcha chamato vahare hu kimtakken. veaf al pi sheeno tzarich laddam shehotzi mimmennu chayyav: 
Shemona sheratzim haamurim battora hen sheyyesh lahen orot leinyan shabbat kemo chayya uvehema veof. aval shear shekatzim uremasim en lahen or. lefichach hachovel bahen patur. veechad hachovel bivhema chayya veof o bishmona sheratzim veasa bahen chabbura veyatza mehem dam o shennitzrar haddam af al pi shello yatza chayyav:
Niddah 20b:7-10: Ifra hormiz, immeh deshabbur malka, shaddara dema lekammeh derava. hava yatev rav ovadya kammeh, archeh. amar la: hay dam chimmud hu. amara leh livreh: ta chazi kamma chakkime yehudae! amar la: dilma kesome baarubba.
Hadar shaddara leh shittin mine dema, vechullehu amrinhu. hahu batra dam kinnim hava, vela yeda. istayyay milleta, veshaddar la serikuta dimkattela kalme. amara: yehudae, bitvavne delibba yatvitu!
Amar rav yehuda: meresha hava chazena dema, kevan deamra li immeh deyitzchak beri, hay tippeta kammayyta la mayytinan la kammayyhu derabbanan mishshum dizhima — la chazena.

Mashge yesharim ׀ bederech ra bishchuto hu-yippol utemimim yinchalu-tov {p}
Sanhedrin 7b:9-8a:6: Ketiv: "lo taasun itti elohe chesef velohe zahav". elohe chesef velohe zahav hu dela avdi, ha deetz shere? amar rav ashe: eloah habba bishvil kesef, veeloah habba bishvil zahav.
Rav, ki hava ate leve dina, amar hachi: birut nafsheh liktala nafek, utzevu beteh let hu aved, verekan leveteh ayel. ulevay shettehe bia kitzia.

Ki have chaze ambuha desafre abbatreh, amar: "im yaale lashshamayim sio [vegomer] kegello lanetzach yoved vegomer". mar zutera chasida, ki havo mechattefi leh beshabbeta derigla, amar hachi: "ki lo leolam chosen veim nezer ledor vador".

Daresh bar kappara: mena ha milleta daamaru rabbanan, "hevu metunin baddin"? dichtiv: "lo taale vemaalot", usemich leh "veelle hammishpatim". amar rabbi eliezer: minnayin ledayyayn shello yefassea al rashe am kodesh? shenneemar: "lo taale vemaalot", usemich leh "veelle hammishpatim".

"Asher tasim"? "asher telammedem" mibbee leh! amar rabbi yirmeya, veittema rabbi chiyyay bar abba: ellu kele haddayyaynin. rav huna, ki hava nafek ledina, amar hachi: appiku li mane chanutay: makkel uretzua, veshofara, vesandala.

"Vaatzavve et shoftechem baet hahi". amar rabbi yochanan: keneged makkel uretzua tehe zariz. "shamoa ben achechem ushefattem" – amar rabbi chanina: azhara laddayyayn shello yishma divre baal din kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero, veazhara levaal din shello yatim devarav laddayyayn kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero. keri beh name: "shamma ben achechem".
Rav kahana amar: mehacha, millo tissa" – lo tassi.
"Ushefattem tzedek". amar resh lakish: tzaddek et haddin, veachar kach chotchehu. "ben ish uven achiv uven gero". amar rav yehuda: afillu ben bayit laaliyyay.
"Uven gero". amar rav yehuda: afillu ben tannur lechirayim.
"Lo takkiru fanim bammishpat". rabbi yehuda omer: lo takkirehu. rabbi elazar omer: lo tenakkerehu.
Ushepizchaneh derav ata lekammeh ledina. amar lo: lav ushepizchani at? amar lo: in. amar leh: dina it li. amar leh:
Pesilna lach ledina. amar leh rav lerav kahana: pok dayyeyneh. chazyeh dahava ka gaes beh. amar leh: i tzayytat – tzayytat, vei la – mappekna lach rav meunnach.
"Kakkaton kaggadol tishmaun". amar resh lakish: sheyyehe chaviv alecha din shel peruta kedin shel mea mane. lemay hilcheta? illema leayyone beh umifsekeh – peshita! ella leakdomeh.

"Lo taguru mippene ish". amar rabbi chanan: al tachnis devarecha mippene ish. "ki hammishpat lelohim hu". amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: amar hakkadosh baruch hu, lo dayyayn larshaim shennotlin mizze mamon venotnim laze shello kaddin, ella shemmatrichin oti lehachazir mamon livalav.

"Vehaddavar asher yikshe mikkem". amar rabbi chanina veittema rabbi yoshiyya: al davar ze neenash moshe, shenneemar "vayyakrev moshe et mishpatan lifne Adonai". matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak: mi ketiv "veashmiachem"? "ushemativ" ketiv! i gemirna – gemirna, vei la – azelna ugemirna.

Ella, kidtanya: reuya parashat nachalot shettikkatev al yede moshe rabbenu, ella shezzachu benot tzelafchad venichteva al yadan. reuya hayta parashat mekoshesh shettikkatev al yede moshe rabbenu, ella shennitchayyev mekoshesh venichteva al yado. lelammedcha shemgalgelin chova al yede chayyayv, uzechut al yede zakkay.

Ketiv: "vaatzavve et shoftechem baet hahi", uchetiv: "vaatzavve etchem baet hahi". amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi simlay: azhara latztzibbur shettehe emat dayyayn alehen, veazhara laddayyayn sheyyisbol et hatztzibbur. ad kamma? amar rabbi chanan, veittema rabbi shabbetay: "kaasher yissa haomen et hayyonek".
Zohar, Emor 13: (Vayikra 21:17) ish mizzaracha ledorotam asher yihye bo mum. ribbi yitzchak amar, begin deihu pagim, uman deihu pagim, la itchaze leshammesha bekudesha. veha ukemuha, debar nash deishtechach pagim, let beh mehemnuta, vehahu pegimu ashid aleh, kol shekken kahana, devaya leishtachcha shelim, mareh dimhemnuta, yatir micholla, veha ukemuha.

Ribbi elazar hava yativ bekistera deve chamuy, vehu hava amar, zilga divkistira beeta shechiach. adhachi, avar chad bar nash, pagim meeneh chad. amar chamuy, nishal lehay. amar, pagim hu, velav mehemana. amar, nishal bahadeh. atu sheilu leh. amar leh, tufeka man hu bealma. amar atira, aval deyashlif, bahadeh ana mikkullehu. (sefer acher attira, aval deyashlif, vavy al da, bahadeh ana mikkullehu) amar ribbi elazar, bemilloy ishtema, delav mehemnuta gabbeh, velav bar mehemana hu. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu amar chol ish asher bo mum lo yikrav, deha kedushsha dilella, la sharya baatar pagim.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 8:20) letora velituda im lo yomru kaddavar hazze. letora velituda. man hu tora, uman hu teuda. ella tora, da tora shebbichtav. teuda, da tora shebbeal pe. tora shebbeal pe la sharya baatar pagim, deha mittora shebbichtav itbene. ketiv tzor teuda chatom tora belimmuday, tzor teuda, da tora shebbeal pe, begin detamman ittetzar tzerora dechayye, uvituda itkeshar kishra dechayye (nusach acher kishra dimhemnuta) dilella, lemehevi kolla chad.
Umittamman letatta itparshan orchin ushevilin, umittamman mitparshin orchin bealmin kullehu hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim.

Chatom tora, chatima deorayyta, deihi tora shebbichtav bean atar. belimmuday, illen nevie, kema deat amer (Melachim 1 7:21) vayyakem et haammud hayemani vayyikra shemo yachin vayakem et haammud hassemali vayikra shemo boaz. umittamman itparshan orchin linvie mehemne, vekayyme illen bekiyyuma legufa, leshit tehirin, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim Adonai:15) shokav ammude shesh. vecholla la kayyeyma ella bishlimu, vela sharya kedushsha decholla, ella bishlimu, kad mitchabberan da beda, kolla hu shelim, kolla hu chad, la itpegim atar. veal da ikre keneset yisrael shalem, kema deat amer (Bereshit 14:18) umalki tzedek melech shalem (Tehillim 76:3) vayhi veshalem sukko.

Uvegin kach la sharya kolla, ella baatar shelim. veal da chol ish asher bo mum lo yikrav. kegavvna da karbena deveh muma la yitkeriv. may tama. dichtiv ki lo leratzon yihye lachem. vei tema ha kudesha berich hu la share ella baatar tevira, bemana tevira, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 57:15) veet dakka ushefal ruach. hay atar shelim yattir hu mikkolla, (dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 57:15) veet dakka ushefal ruach) begin demaich garmeh lemishre aleh gauta decholla, gauta illaa, veda hu shelim. aval la ketiv, vet ivvir veshavur vecharum vesarua. ella veet dakka ushefal ruach, man demaich garmeh, kudesha berich hu zakif leh.
Uvegine kach, kahana dekaim letatta kegavvna dilella, bae lemehevi shelim yattir mikkolla, vela yitchaze pagim, veal da azhar lehu lechahane, dichtiv ish mizzaracha ledorotam asher yihye vo mum.

Tu patach veamar, (Malachi 1:8) vechi taggishun ivvir lizboach en ra, vechi taggishu fisseach vechole en ra, vechi kudesha berich hu amar en ra, i hachi tov hu. ella sofeh dikra ochach, deyisrael beinnun yomin havo memanan kahane mare demumin, al gabbe madbecha, uleshammesha al makdesha, veamre may ichpat leh lekudesha berich hu da, o ochora. veinnun havo deamre en ra. vekudesha berich hu ativ lehon hahi milla dahavo amre. amar: yisrael attun amre kad mekarve mare demumin al pulechani en ra, may ichpat leh lekudesha berich hu.

Sofeh dikra ma ketiv, hakerivehu na lefechatcha hayirtzecha o hayissa fanecha. bar nash minnayychu, i baitu leshalume lemalka, ulekarva kammeh dorona, attun meshadrin leh bifgima, o la. hayirtzecha o hayissa fanecha behahu dorona, kol shekken vekol shekken deattun mekarvin kamay bar nash pagim lekarva dorona, ha dorona dilchon lechalba itmesar, devadday bar nash deihu pagim, pagim hu mikkolla, pagim hu mehemnuta. veal da chol ish asher bo mum lo yikrav.

Amar ribbi yose, zammin kudesha berich hu leashlema lehu leyisrael, uleishtakkecha shelemin becholla, dela yehe behon mare demumin kelal, begin dihon tikkuna dealma, keillen mane ulevusha debar nash deinnun tikkuna degufa, hada hu dichtiv (iyyov 38:14) vyityatztzevu kemo levush.

(Sefer acher davar acher) ta chaze, kad yittearun meafra, kema dealu, hachi yekumun, chigrin o sumin. alu chigrin vesumin, yekumun behahu levusha, dela yemrun deochora hu deittear. ulevatar, kudesha berich hu yese lon, veyishtachchun shelemin kammeh, ucheden yehe alma shelim becholla, keden (zecharya 14:9) bayom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.
Zohar, Emor 16: Ta chaze, bar nash deityeylid la itmana aleh chela dilella, ad deitgezar. kevan deitgezar, ittear aleh (rucha) ittearuta derucha dilella. zache leitasseka beorayyta, ittear aleh ittearuta yattir. zache veavid pikkude orayyta, ittear aleh ittearuta yattir. zache veitnesiv, zache veolid benin, veolif lon orchoy demalka kaddisha, ha keden hu adam shelim. shelim becholla.

Aval behema deityelidat, behahi shaata deityelidat, hahu chela deit lah besofah, it lah behahi shaata deityelidat, veitmana aleh. uvegin kach ketiv, shor o chesev o ez ki yivvaled. egel o tale, o sair o gedi la ittemar, ella shor o chesev o ez, hahu deit leh lesofa, it leh beshaata deityeylid.

Vehaya shivat yamim tachat immo, begin leityashsheva beh hahu chela veitkayyaym beh. uvemma yitkayyaym beh. kad yishre aleh shabbat chad, vei la, la yitkeyyaym. (veod daatayybesh mazevahemaa deimmeh) ulevatar deyitkeyyaym beh hahu chela, ketiv yeratze lekarban ishshe laAdonai, bekiyyuma deshabbat chad, deabar aleh.

Uvar nash, bekiyyuma deshabbat chad, itkayyaym beh ittearuta dehay alma, vechela dileh. batar deitgezar, ittear aleh ittearuta derucha illaa, ukkeneset yisrael abar aleh, vechamat leh, birshima kaddisha, veatarat aleh, vesharya aleh rucha dehahu alma kaddisha, kema deat amer, (yechezkel 16:6) vaeevor alayich vaerech mitboseset bedamayich vegomer. bedamayich: bitre.

Vei tema, hatam kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, dishchiach benayyhu dam pesach vedam mila, keden ketiv bedamayich chayi, hacha may bedamayich. ella teren, chad demila, vechad difria. chad digziru, dichneset yisrael. vechad difria, betzaddik yesod olam. veillen teren damin devar nash kaim beginayyhu bekiyyuma dealma deate, hada hu dichtiv bedamayich chayi.
Zohar, Emor 25: Amar ribbi elazar, seudata telitaa deshabbat, kad ira beh oshpiza, shavkin leh o la shavkin leh, i la shavkin leh, ishtechach ushepiza dechayyay mippatora demalka, i shavkin leh, ishtechach pegimu bisudata demalka.

Amar leh ribbi shimon avoy, lemalka deira beh ushepiza, venatil mechla mikkammeh, vesalleka leushepizeh, ishtechach af al gav demalka la achal immeh, mimmechla demalka ka achil, umalka yahiv leh lemechal. vechol da, begin dehu ushepize demalka. uveve rav hamenuna sava, la chayyshe leushepiza beshaata da, ulevatar mesaddere patora leoshpiza.
Behay yoma millula asir, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar, utenan cheftzecha ketiv, begin dehay yoma kol mehemnuta itkeshar beh.

Amar leh ribbi elazar, vehech avidna dela lesaddera (sefer acher lesalleka) seudata demalka leushepiza, deha arbesar dechal lihyot beshabbat, salleka seudata demalka lefischa, af al gav delav ihu ushepizeh.

Amar leh hachi amena dei hu ushepizeh, (kol hahu yoma) yachla lesalleka leh, vei lav la salleka leh. vei nema 18 dechal lihyot beshabbat, itdachyay seudata demalka mikkamme seudata defischa. shane pesach, disudata deshabbat itdachyay bechamma gavvnin. chad, begin matzot umerorim, devae bar nash deyishtechach taiva. vechad, begin pesach veha nahama la ishtechach 46 shaot ulemala, desiddura defatora bela nahama, lav hu siddura.

Vei tema bechamra, chamra share, begin detaiv (sefer acher degarer sefer acher dagebayr) libba. aval miomay ishtaddallena dela batilna seudata deshabbat, afillu innun yome, deishtechach beh. behay yoma chakal detappuchin kaddishin itberach, umitbarchan illain vetattain, vehay yoma kishura hu deorayyta.

Amar ribbi abba, hachi hava avid ribbi shimon, bezimna deistellak seudata deshabbata, mesadder patoreh veishtedal bemaase merkava, vahava amar ha seudata demalka deyete lemechal gabbay. begine kach, shabbat, ishtechach becholla adif mikkol zimnin vechaggin, veikre kodesh vela mikra kodesh.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kullehu moadim mikrae kodesh karenan behu. aval nafke rosh hashshana veyoma dechippura dela ishtechach behu chedvavta, deha innun dina havo, aval illen telata, zeminin mikkodesh, lechedvavta lecholla, leishtashea behu bekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 12:12) usemachtem lifne Adonai elohechem, uchetiv (Devarim 27:7) vesamachta lifne Adonai elohecha. behay yoma deshabbeta, itneshe kol tzaara vechol rugeza vechol dochaka mikkol alma, begin deihu yoma dehilula demalka, denishmatin ittosfan, kegavvna dealma deate.

Amar ribbi yitzchak leribbi yehuda, ketiv (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho, vetanenan zachrehu al hayyayin, amay al hayyayin. amar leh, begin deyayin chedvavta deorayyta, veyena deorayyta, chedvavta hu decholla. vehay yayin chadde lemalka, vehay yayin meattera lemalka beitroy, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo baatara sheittera lo immo. vetanenan becholla bayay leachazaa bar nash ovada. dela ishtechach kedushsha ella beyayin, kema deat amer (Shir hashshirim 1:4) ki tovim dodecha miyyayin, miyyayin innun tavaan, nazkira dodecha miyyayin. veal da kidusha deshabbat beyayin, veha ukemuha, veha ittemar.
Zohar, Emor 3: (Vayikra 21) emor el hakkohanim, ribbi yitzchak amar, emor el hakkohanim, bilchishu. kema dechol ovadehon dechahane bilchishu, kach amira dilhon bilchishu. emor veamarta: zimna chad, uteren zimnin, leazhara lehu al kedushayyhu, begin dela yistaavun. deman dimshammesh baatar kaddisha, baya deyishtechach kaddisha becholla. lenefesh lo yittamma, kema deokimna, degufa bela ruach, misava hu, veshare aleh ruach misava. deha tiuveta deruche misave legabbe gufehon deyisrael ihu, begin deitterak minnayyhu rucha kaddisha, uvemana dekudesha, atyayn leitchabbera. vechahane deinnun kaddishin, kedushshata al kedushshata, la bayayn leistaava kelal, begin dichtiv, (Bamidbar 6:7) ki nezer elohav al rosho. uchetiv ki shemen mishchat elohav alav ani Adonai.

Vehu kegavvna dilella kaim letatta, dichtiv, (Tehillim 133:2) kashshemen hattov al harosh yored al hazzakan zekan aharon sheored al pi middotav, hay kera ukemuha, aval kashshemen hattov al harosh, da meshach revut kaddisha illaa, denagid venafik meatar denahara amika decholla. davar acher, denagid venafik meresha dechol reshin, setima dechol setimin. al harosh, al harosh vaday, resha deadam kadmaa.

Yored al hazzakan, da dikna yakira, kema deukemuha. zekan aharon, da kohen gadol dilella, veha ukemuha. vehahu shemen, yored al pi midotav, demeinnun meshichan, nagid venafik venachit letattae, uchegavvna da nagid veitattar kahana tattaa, bimshach revut letatta.

Hay kera, lav resheh sefeh, velav sefeh resheh. ketiv emor el hakkohanim bene aharon veamarta alehem lenefesh lo yittamma. la yittammeu mibbae leh, mahu lo yittamma. ella, al hahu kohen illaa mekullehu kaamar. amar ribbi yehuda veha ketiv vehakkohen haggadol meechav. (kan chaser) ella vadday hachi hu kema deittemar, veamar ribbi yitzchak, kahana dekaim letatta, kegavvna dilella, bikdushsha itzterich leishtakkecha yattir mikkolla, kema deittemar.
Zohar, Emor 32: Tu patach veamar, (Tehillim 98:1) mizmor shiru laAdonai shir chadash ki niflaot asa. shir chadash ikre. begin kach behakerivchem mincha chadasha. hatam minchat kenaot, hacha mincha chadasha. chadasha dechiddusha decholla (sefer acher dechullah) hacha. kishshura decholla deella vetatta, kishshura dimhemnuta. veal da yaakov shelema itattar beitroy, veorayyta ityeyhivat.

Vechad matun bikkurim legabbe kahana, hava bae bar nash lememar ulefarsha millin, al hahu ilana deara, deishtelim kegavvna dilella, bitresar techumin, beshivin anpin, uvaa leovada leh lavan aramaa, deitpegim alma begineh. vekudesha berich hu sheziv leh, veitattar bedinoy (sefer acher bivnoy) kema deokimna. begin hahu ilana, dechol kishra dimhemnuta, beh talyay. veal da mincha chadasha itkere. may tama. begin dechedvavta deilae vetattae hu, vechedvavta desihara. uvechol zimna chadtute desihara, kishra dimhemnuta hu, vechedvavta dilah. (desihara)

Lemalka dahavo leh benin, uveratta chada, atkin seudata lechullehu benin, la ishtechachat hahi beratta al patora. kad atat, amrat lemalka, mari, lechol achay zeminat veyahavat lechol chad manin yedian, veli la yahavat chulaka benayyhu. amar leh, chayyayich berati, mana dilach yishtekach al chad teren. ha kolla yittenun lach mechulakehon. ishtechach levatar bidaha chulakin, al chad teren mikkola. kach keneset yisrael, mikkolla natla chulakin, veal da itkere kalla, kelula. kachalla dechullehu mezamnin lah manin vechulakin vetachshitin, kach hi keneset yisrael, chadtute (nusach acher chedvavta) dilah becholla, vecholla yahavin lah chulakin umanin.

Ta chaze, beshaata demalka kaddisha ishtechach beitroy, chedvavta dichneset yisrael hu. vechad orayyta ityeyhivat, itatterat keneset yisrael beitrin illain, uvegin dechol kishra dimhemnuta, itkeshar behay ilana, ikre yom echad. dichtiv, (zecharya yad) vehaya yom echad hu yivvada laAdonai. yom echad vadday, dekneset yisrael yom echad, bekishshura dilella.

Kishshura dilella, resha vegulegalta umoche. (vaychi 221) kishshura ochora, teren deroin vegufa. daachidan, (kishshura achara) mechela deresha. veokma rav hamenuna, (sefer acher bitren) bitlat keshirin daavahata (kishshura achara). teren kayaymin (nusach acher kavelayyn diltatta) deitmeshachu bimshach revut, (bekiyyuma) bitren dargin, teren nachalin, leachnasha zara, leappaka bedarga ochora, befum amma. ilana da, hu gufa deemtzaita, deachid lechol hane, vecholla mitkashsheran beh, vehu behon, veal da kolla chad. vechad izdavvgat beh matronita, keden hu echad, veha okimna mille.

Ta chaze, ketiv bayyom hashshemini atzeret. man atzeret. ella behahu atar, decholla mitkashsheran kachada, ikre atzeret, may atzeret, (sefer acher kenufeya kenishu) kenishu. vei tema hacha deikre atzeret, may taama. ella bechol innun yomin, yome seudate deanfe ilana havo. veal da, shivim parim innun. levatar, chedvavta (degufa) deilana mammash, vechedvavta deorayyta. uvegineh hu yoma chad atzeret. chedvavta deorayyta, chedvavta deilana, dehu gufa.

Veal da let chulaka behay yoma, ella lekudesha berich hu ucheneset yisrael. begin kach, atzeret tihye lachem, lachem, vela leochora. (sefer acher levatar chedvavta daalanea mammash uvegineh hu yoma chad velet chulaka behay yoma ella lekudesha berich hu ucheneset yisrael veal da ketiv atzeret tihye lachem. uf hachi behay yoma chedvavta daarayytea chedvavta daalanea dehu gufa vecholla ishtechach beh) deha beshaata demalka ishtechach, kolla ishtechach beh. veal da tanenan, baatzeret al perot hailan, veha ukemuha begin kach echad ikre, echad vadday, kema deamaran.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa vegomer, solet tihyena chametz teafena. may shena hacha chametz (bichneset yisrael), ella begin decholla achidan beh (vechen) beilana, deha beilana achidan anfin, beilana achidan alin, kelifin, dinin saggiin bechol sitrin, kolla ishtechach beh. uvegin dehay ilana, mechapper al yetzer hara, dehu beve motveh devar nash.

Amar ribbi elazar, mehay ilana ittezanu kol shear ilanin letatta. vehu ishtarsha al chad nahara amika, denagid venafik vela paskin memoy lealmin. aleh ketiv (Yirmeyahu 17:8) vehaya keetz shatul al mayim veal yuval yeshallach sharashav, veal da ikre orayyta, (Mishlei 3:18) etz chayyim hi vegomer. umay vetomcheha meushshar. ha ukemuha, aval vetomcheha meushshar, kema deat amer (Bereshit 30:13) beashri ki ishsheruni banot.
Zohar, Terumah 15: Barchu et Adonai. et dayyka. kidkamran, da (Bereshit Adonai amud bet) shabbat demaale shabbatta. baruch Adonai hamevorach, da appiku devirchan mimmekora dechayye, vaatar denafik minneh kol shakyu, leashkaa lecholla. uvegin deihu mekora beraza deat kayyeyma, karenan leh hamevorach, ihu mabbua devera. kevan dematu tamman, ha vadday bera itmalleya, dela paskin memoy lealmin.

Veal da la amrenan, baruch et Adonai hamevorach, ella baruch Adonai, deilmale la mate hatam neviu mimmekora illaa, la itmalleya bera kelal, veal da hamevorach, amay ihu hamevorach. begin deihu ashlim veashke leolam vaed. olam vaed da ihu shabbat demaale shabbatta, vaanan takin birkan beatar deikre mevorach. vechevan dematan hatam, kullehu leolam vaed, veda ihu baruch Adonai hamevorach. ad hacha, matun birkan mealma illaa, vechullehu leolam vaed, leitvarcha uleitshakaa, ulemehve shelim kedka yeot, malya michol sitrin.

Barucha: da (162 amud alef, ekev 271 amud alef) mekora illaa, dechol birkan nafkin minneh. vechad sihara ishtelim, karenan lah hachi legave tattae, aval baruch mekora illaa kidkamran. Adonai: da emtzai dechol sitrin illain. hamevorach: da shelama deveta, mabbua devera, leashlama uleashkaa kolla. leolam vaed: da alma tattaa, deitzterich leitbarcha. umishcha urevu devaruch Adonai vehamevorach, kolla ihu leolam vaed. (mevorach kema deat amar (Bereshit 49) ben porat)

Veal da, beracha da, itzterichu kol amma levarcha, uvemaale shabbatta, biru deliva, uvechedva bau lemishre besheruta bivracha da, leitbarcha hay shabbat demaale shabbatta, (lelya) meamma kadisha kedka yeot. behay beracha.

(Sefer acher barchu) kad sharan yisrael levarcha, kala azla bechullehu rekiin, demitkaddeshe bikdushsha demaale shabbatta. zakkain attun amma kadisha, deattun mevarche umekaddeshe letatta, begin deyitbarchun veyitkaddeshun leella, kamma mashreyayn illain kaddishin, zakkain innun behay alma, vezakkain innun bealma deate, vela mevarche yisrael beracha da, ad demitatteran beitrin denishmatin kaddishin kidkamran. zakkaa amma dezakke lon bealma den, lemizke lon lealma deate.

Behay lelya shimmusha dechakkimin, beillen nishmatin kaddishin demitatteran behu, veaf al gav deha okimna vecholla chad. uvechol atar detishkach lechakkimin behay milla, besitra da, ulezimnin besitra da, kolla ihu chad. vehane mille ha okimna, aval bezimna da, demitatteran kullehu benishmatin veruchin chadtin yeterin kaddishin, keden ihi zimna deshimmusha dilhon, begin deliheve negidu lehahu shimmusha, bingidu dikdusha, benayycha illaa, veyifkun benayyhu kadishin kadka chazi.

Raza da lechakkimin ityeyhivat. beshaatta deitpelig lelya, belelya da, kudesha berich hu bae leaala beginta dilella. veraza da, beyome (Vayikra 49 amud bet) dechol kudesha berich hu al beginta deeden diltatta, leishtashea im tzadikayya desharan tamman, uveshabbat, behahu lelya deshabbeta, kudesha berich hu al beginta dilella, beraza dimkora illaa.

Begin divyome dechol, kol nishmatin detzadikayya kullehu, beginta di beara sharyayn. vechad itkaddash yoma bemaale shabbatta, kol innun mashreyayn demalachin kaddishin di memanan go ginta diltatta, kullehu sallekin lehane nishmatin, desharyayn go ginta diltatta, leaala legabbe hahu rekia dekayyeyma al ginta, umittamman izdamnu retichin kadishin, desacharan kurese yekara demalka, vesallekin lon lechol innun nishmatin, beginta dilella.
Kevan deillen ruchin sallekin, keden ruchin (98 amud bet, shalach 173 amud alef) acharanin kaddishin, nachtin, leitattera behu amma kaddisha. illen sallekin, veillen nachtin.

Vei tema, ha ginta divara, beyoma deshabbeta yatva berekanayyay bela nishmatin detzaddikayya. lav hachi. ella nishmatin azlin, venishmatin atyayn. nishmatin sallekin, venishmatin nachtin. nishmatin azlin miggo ginta, venishmatin atyayn lego ginta. kol innun nishmatin detzaddikayyay, demitlabbenan beyome dechol, vead la alu lego ginta, beshaata deillen nafkin, illen alin veginta la (253 amud alef) ishtear berekanyya. beraza delechem happanim beyom hillakcho.

Vei tema, kad ahadru beyome dechol. bema (nusach acher kema) itmashshechan duchete learka ufuteya veruma, beginta, vela ityeda. kegavvna deraza deeretz hatztzevi, dehava itmeshshach lechol sitrin vela ityeda. kegavvna ditzvi, dechol ma deitrabbe, mashkeh itrabbe lechol setar, vela ityeyda. veit kema nishmatin, dechevan desallekin, tu la nachtin.

Nishmatin sallekin, venishmatin nachtin, leitattera behu amma kaddisha. uvemaale shabbatta, gilgula denishmatin ihu, illen azlin, veillen atyayn, illen sallekin veillen nachtin. man chame kamma retichin kaddishin, di meshattete lechan ulechan. kullehu bechedva, kullehu biru, beillen nishmatin leattera leamma kaddisha, leattera lechamma tzaddikayyay, ginta deeden letatta, ad shaata decharoza kaim, vekare mekudash mekudash. keden nayycha shechiach, ushechichu lecholla. vechayyayve gehinnam kullehu mishtachche beduchetayyhu, veit lon nayycha. venishmatin kullehu mitatteran, illen leella veillen letatta. zakkaa amma, dechulaka da lehon.

Befalgut lelya demaale shabbatta, dechakkimin mitarin leshimmusha dilhon, hahu rucha illaa, demitatteran beh, kad yoma itkaddash, beshaata deinnun nayyme bearsayyhu, venishmatin acharanin dilhon, baan lesalleka lemechome bikara demalka, keden hahu ruach illaa denachit bemaale shabbatta, natil hahi nishmeta, vesallekin leella, veitsachya nishmeta achara bevusemin deginta deeden, vetamman chame ma dechame.

Vechad nachta leashraa beduchetaha befalgut lelya, hahi nishmeta tavat leduchetaha. uvae leinun chakkimin lomar, chad pesuka deitaruta, dehahu rucha illaa kaddisha deatra deshabbatta, kegon, (Yeshayahu 61:1) ruach Adonai elohim alay yaan mashach Adonai, oti levasser anavim vegomer. (yechezkel 1:21) belechtam yelechu uveamdam yaamodu uvehinnasam meal haaretz vegomer, el asher yihye sham haruach lalechet yelechu vegomer. begin demitatteran behahu rucha, beitaruta dilhon bechedva deshimmusha, viyhe negidu dehahu ruach illaa deshabbatta, behahu shimmusha demitzva.

Rav hamenuna sava, kad hava (24 amud alef) salik minnahara bemaale shabbatta, hava yativ riga chada, vezakif enoy, vahava chadde, vahava amar, dehava yativ, lemecheme chedva demalache illae. illen sallekin, veillen nachtin. uvechol maale shabbatta, yativ bar nash baolam hanneshamot. zakkaa ihu man deyada berazin demareh.

rashi: El hechatzer hachitzona. lefi shehaya medabber bahechol lifnay velifnim ukeraam "chatzer happenimit" (Yechezkel 44:17), veetzlam yesh lo likrot ezrat yisrael chatzer hachitzona, lechach hutzrach lichpol shete peamim, lomar sheal ezrat nashim hu omer, makom shekkol yisrael nichnasin:
Vehinnichu otam belishchot hakkodesh. kemo sheamar moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom (Vayikra 16:23) "ufashat et bigde habbad asher lavash vehinnicham sham":

Velo yekaddeshu et haam. tirgem yonatan: "vela yitarvun im amma bilvushehon", kelomar: lo yiggeu el haam bevigdehem hakkedoshim, sheen bigde chol tehorin etzel bigde hakkodesh (raa Rashi Yechezkel 42:14):
targum: Uvemifakhon midarta dekudesha ledarta varayta leitarava im ama yishlechun yat levushehon di inun meshamshin behon veyachatun yathon belishchat kudesha veyilbeshun levushin ocharanin vela yitarvun im ama bilvushehon:

rashi: Ki techel liznot. keshettitchallel ay zenut, shehayta vah zikkat baal vezanta, o min haerusin o min hannissuin; verabbotenu nechleku vaddavar vehakkol modim shello dibber hakkatuv bifnuya (80 sanhedrin nusach acher):
Et aviha hi mechallelet. chillela uvizzeta et kevodo, sheomrim alav arur shezzo yalad, arur shezzo giddel (sham):
Ki vassukkot hoshavti. anne chavod (sham; mechilta 12):

Velo techallelu. laavor al devaray mezidin; mimmashma shenneemar velo techallelu ma talo venikdashti? mesor atzmecha vekaddesh shemi. yachol beyachid, talo betoch bene yisrael; ucheshehu moser atzmo yimsor atzmo al menat lamut, shekkol hammoser atzmo al menat hannes, en oshin lo nes, shekken matzinu vachananya mishael vaazarya shello masru atzman al menat hannes, shenneemar (Daniel 50), "vehen la yedia leheve lach malka" vegomer, matztzil velo matztzil — "yedia leheve lach" vegomer (sifra):
Harifot. chittim hanniddochim bammachtesh:
Machtesh. asita (chullin nov.), mortior belaaz:
Baeli. hu buchena, polin mortero belaaz. al shem shemmaalin oto umakkin bo tamid nikra eli:
targum: In machyat leh leshatya bemachteshe bego siyata uveuderach la taavir mineh shatyuteh:

rashi: Marbe hono beneshech vetarbit lechonen dallim. harshut shomin alav shehu mitashsher belo mishpat, venotlin mamono, uvonin bo gesharim umetakkenin bo hadderachim, vezehu chaninat dallim. kach derasho rabbi tanchuma (tanchuma, mishpatim 5):
targum: Demasgia mazaleh benichteta uveribbita leman dimrachem al miskene mechansheh:

ohc: Vechol melacha vegomer ki yom kippurim vegomer. netinat taam ze hu al derech ma sheamru besota daf 40, sheen omrim pesukim keshehakkohanim mevarchin et haam, vehattaam amru veze leshonam: kelum yesh eved shemmevarchin oto veeno maazin? ad kan. ulederech ze amar "vechol melacha lo taasu", vehattaam "ki yom kippurim hu", perush ki itztzumo shel yom mechapper, veyesh lecha adam shehazzeman mechapper alav vehu asuk bimlachto. vehammaskil al devar itztzumo shel yom levavo yavin hammechapper, ki hu adon hammeir hayyom lesaggel segel davar ze.

rashi: Emor el hakkohanim. emor veamarta, lehazehir gedolim al hakketannim (yevamot 114):
Bene aharon. yachol chalalim tal hakkohanim:
Bene aharon. af baale mumin bemashma:
Bene aharon. velo benot aharon (sifra):
Lo yittamma beammav. beod shehammet betoch ammav, yatza met mitzva (sham):
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma shinna misseder haragil lomar bechol hattora "dabber el" vegomer. od lamma hikdim hattoar lammetoar shehaya tzarich lomar "bene aharon hakkohanim". uderashot sheddarshu chazal (torat kohanim) bimkoman omdim, hagam sheyyedabber beseder ze. veyitbaer al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha (tanchuma kan) veze leshonam: amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe en nae leyotze venichnas lefanay lehistakkel bammet vechulei, ad kan, vehu amro emor leshon maala, "el hakkohanim" perush, letzad shehem kohanim mesharte pene melech. uma hi hammaala, shello yittammeu lenefesh adam, kemaamaram zichronam livracha sheen nae leyotze venichnas vechulei. umittaam ze hikdim hattoar lammetoar lehasemich hammaala letzad heyotam kohanim, ma shello haya nishma ken im haya omer "emor el bene aharon".

Veamarta alehem lenefesh vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar veamarta. verazal amru (torat kohanim, yevamot 114:) kamma derashot, veod yesh leeloah millin, vehu al derech ma shekkatav harambam perek 2 mehilchot avel veze leshono: hametamme et hakkohen, im hayu shenehem mezidim, hakkohen loke veze hametamme over mishshum velifne ivver vegomer, veim haya hakkohen shogeg vehametamme mezid, hare ze shemtammeo loke, ad kan. vekashe, minnayin lo leharambam lechayyev hametamme malkut, veharav hammaggid umaharik lo amru kan davar, ki im hallechem mishne asher hu katav veze leshono: behilchot kilayim katav rabbenu baze shehammalbish kilayim lachavero, im haya hallovesh shogeg hammalbish loke, vetama alav hakkesef mishne vechatav sheshshaal ze harosh meharash velo zachinu litshuva vechulei, veefshar lo demashma leh lerabbenu demiddeamrinan beferek shelosha minim (nazir 44.) degalle kera benazir shello asa hammetamme kannitma middichtiv "vetimme et rosh nizro", mashma divalma avdinan hammetamme kannitma, ulechach katav rabbenu beferek Adonai mehilchot nezirut sheim haya hannazir shogeg veze shettimmeo mezid eno loke, ad kan divre harav. veenam nirim, dekashe: 1 lamma lo yihye hannazir binyan av lechol hattora kullah delo amrinan hametamme kannitma vechulei, vechen al ze hadderech. veod hahu denazir shehutzrach hakkatuv lemaet mishshum shehayiti dan kal vachomer mittiglachat shechayyav, deha chomer battuma mibbattiglachat, talmud lomar "vetimme et rosh" vegomer ad kan. im ken zulat hakkal vachomer lo haya tzarich lemaet, veadrabba tigdal medurat hakkushya larambam mehahu deferek shelosha minim.

Vehannachon beenay shettamo shel rambam hu meotah sheamru bemassechet nazir daf 44, veze leshonam: uma tuma vechulei lo asa bah metamme kemittamme, tiglachat lo kol shekken shello asa megalleach kemitgalleach? amar kera "taar lo yaavor", keri beh lo yaavor hu velo yaavir leacher, ad kan. uferesh Rashi: lo yaavir lo acher, ad kan. perush, azhara leacher shello yaavir taar al rosh hannazir, sheim lo chen tihye hakkavvana shello yaavir hannazir sear shel adam acher, ufashut. vetzarich ladaat kavvanat hashshas minnayin doresh "lo yaavir lo acher", im doresh hammasoret halo masoret "lo yaavir" hu beYod ben bet laresh. veod lichshennomar sheen chesron hayyod meakkevet, af al pi chen adayin chaser tevat "lo" shezzulatah yihye mashmaut "lo yaavir" shehannazir lo yaavir laacherim.

Achen kavvanat hashshas shemmedayyek maamar hakkatuv "taar lo yaavor" vegomer, shehaya lo lomar "lo yegallach et rosho" o "lo yaavir al rosho" yod ben bet leresh, veyachzor el hannazir haamur besamuch, veyitle haissur kamtzuvve alav, lo bemaase hattaar shello bechinnuy el hammitgalleach, keamro "taar lo yaavor" shemmashmaut haddevarim yaggidu sheasar hammaase ben al yad hammitgalleach ben al yad acherim. vehu maamar hashshas keri beh lo yaavor hu velo yaavir lo acher, perush, mashmaut hatteva taggid leesor haddavar ben al yado ben al yede acher. umaamar "keri beh" eno meduyyak, ella malbishim hammechuvvan batteva, vehaven.

Umeatta kemo chen nomar bedin kilayim sheamar (Vayikra 19:19) "uveged kilayim shaatnez lo yaale alecha" velo amar "lo taale alecha", mashma shello al hammaale alav lechud metzavve ella al hammaase hu metzavve, shello yihye ben mimmennu ben mehazzulat. velaze pasak harambam (hilchot kilayim 90 36) shehammalbish kilayim lachavero mezid loke. uchemo chen nomar bema shellefanenu betumat kohen, mimma sheamar hakkatuv "lo yittamma" azhara shello bechinnuy lannitma, lomar shemmazhir ben lakkohen atzmo ben laacherim al hattuma. veshiur hammitzva hi shemmetzavve Adonai baruch hu leval yihye hakkohen tame. umeatta kol hammetammeo ben hu ben acher hare ze avar al hallav veloke. uchefi ze alu piske rambam al nachon.

Uvaze navo leyashshev dikduk hakkatuv shekkafal lomar "emor" veamarta", ki letzad shetztzivva Adonai lakkohanim gam laacherim al tumatam, keneged hakkohanim amar "emor el hakkohanim", ucheneged azharat acherim shello yetammeu amar veamarta alehem. veulay shettevat "alehem" chozeret leyisrael hammetzuvvim bechol hammitzva. vetimtza sheamar besof inyan ze (Vayikra 21:24) "vaydabber moshe el aharon veel banav veel kol bene yisrael" hare shehatztziuuy neemar meAdonai gam leyisrael, veze yatzdik lecha perushenu shehaazhara ba kan gam leyisrael shello yetammeu hakkohanim. uvetorat kohanim (Vayikra 21:24) amru veze leshonam: "vaydabber Adonai" hizhir et aharon al yede habbanim veet habbanim al yede yisrael veet habbanim ze al yede ze. veellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim.

Lenefesh. razal darshu (torat kohanim) lerabbot reviit dam vechulei, veraiti larambam zichrono livracha shekkatav beferek 3 mehilchot avel veze leshono: echad hammet veechad shear hattumot happorshot min hammet shenneemar "lenefesh", akkal, vehikshu alav middetana betorat kohanim veze leshonam: en li ella hammet, minnayin lerabbot haddam? talmud lomar "lenefesh", minnayin lerabbot kol hattumot happorshot min hammet? talmud lomar "veamarta alehem" lerabbot vechulei, ad kan. veteretz hakkesef mishne shessover rambam shemmittevat "lenefesh" gamrinan hakkol, sheshshekulim hem, ukera lo tzarich ella asmachta ad kan. veen divre hakkesef mishne nirim, ki minnayin lo larambam livnot binyan chadash shello kedivre habbarayta.

Achen hannachon hu ki rambam zichrono livracha barayta acheret hu sheraa, vehinne hi ketuva bappesikta, veze leshonam: "emor veamarta" – lehazehir gedolim al hakketannim, "lenefesh lo yittamma" – lehavi reviit dam shettetze min hammet shehu belo yittamma, ad kan leshonam, vehuvea barayta zo bivamot (114.). ulefi barayta zo titchayyev lomar sheggam shear tumot happorshot min hammet mitrabbot min "lenefesh", shehare doresh kefel "veamarta" lehazehir gedolim al hakketannim. vehaddavar pashut etzli shenneelma barayta zo meene hakkesef mishne, veharaya shekkatav harav bapperek hannizkar din 12 veze leshono: kohen katan vechulei haggedolim vechulei keferush Rashi "emor veamarta" vegomer, ad kan. hinne mimma shemmochiach din ze middivre Rashi velo middivre habbarayta, atta yodea shello yada habbarayta.

Venishar leyashshev minnayin lahem lidrosh mittevat "lenefesh" reviit dam vechulei, vedilma hutzrach lomar "lenefesh" lehodia sheeno mazhir ella al tumat met velo al shear tumot. veyesh lomar shehaya lo lomar "lemet lo yittamma" umeamro lenefesh darshu reviit dam vechol sheyyesh bo nefesh. aval temee met enam bichlal ze.

Lo yittamma. amar leshon yachid hagam shehitchil ledabber bilshon rabbim "hakkohanim", "alehem". lisvarat tanna sheddarash kefel "veamarta" lehazehir gedolim al hakketannim, meatta en lanu mekom azhara lammetamme shello yetamme lechohen, laze amar lashon yachid vaamira lerabbim, lomar sheazharat rabbim al hayyachid, ha lamadta azhara lammetamme.

Od nire shechash hakkatuv lomar "lo yittammeu", shello tavo hassevara litot shello hikpid hakkatuv ella al tumat kelalut hakkohanim, ki davar ze eno ella chukka veen lanu ella ma shebba beferush, aval kohen yachid lo yakpid alav, talmud lomar "yittamma" leshon yachid.

Od, letzad shetztzivva Adonai lakkohanim (Vayikra 10:9) issur yayin veshechar, vesham gilla hakkatuv shettaam haissur hu leval yaavdu avodat hakkodesh shetuye yayin, veim ken shello bizman mishmartam o shello bizman avoda yecholin lishtot yayin veshechar, veim ken tavo hassevara sheyyillamed satum mehameforash ladun betaam issur tuma shehu mehattaam atzmo shenneesra shetiyyat yayin veshechar neesra tuma kede sheyyihye rauy laavoda. laze nitchakkem Adonai vedibber leshon yachid "lo yittamma" lomar sheafillu echad mehakkohanim hu omed beissur ze, umimmotza davar atta lamed shello mittaam bittul avoda ki en avoda betela meheder kohen echad, ella vadday sheissur tumat kohen hi chovat gavra, vaafillu mi shemmishmarto baa lizman rachok af al pi chen hu beissur ze, umittaam haamur bedivrehem zichrono livracha uchetavnuhu lemala.

rashi: Umin hammidda hazzot. bekane hammidda shennimdad bo ribbua har habbayit chamesh meot al chamesh meot, kemo sheamur bainyan shel mala (Yechezkel 42:20): "learba ruchot medado choma lo saviv", "chamesh meot kanim vegomer" (Yechezkel 42:16-19):

Tamod orech chamishsha veesrim elef. kanim, verochav aseret alafim kanim; ulefi shello peresh bappasuk rishon ma hen chamishsha veesrim elef, im kanim im ammot, hutzrach lomar shechamishsha veesrim middot – bikne hammidda shennimdedu bah chamesh meot al chamesh meot shel har habbayit nimdadin alafim hallalu latteruma:
targum: Umin mishchata hada timshach ureka asrin vechamsha alfin ufuteya asra alfin uveh yehe mikdesha kodesh kudeshin:

rashi: Hashshomim. ellu haedim:
Chol. lehavi et haddayyanim (sifra):
Et yedehem. omrim lo damcha beroshcha, veen anu neenashim bemitatcha, sheatta garamta lecha (sham):
Chol haeda. bemaamad kol haeda, (mikkan) sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto (80 sham):

Uvekutzrechem. chazar veshana, laavor alehem bishne lavyn; amar Rabbi avdime berabbi yosef, ma raa hakkatuv littenah veemtza hargalim — pesach vaatzeret mikkan verosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim vechag mikkan — ? lelammedcha shekkol hannoten leket shichcha ufea leani karauy, maalin alav keillu bana bet hammikdash vehikriv karbenotav betocho (sifra):
Taazov. hannach lifnehem vehem yilketu, veen lecha lesayyea leechad mehem (pea 85):
Ani Adonai elohechem. neeman leshallem sachar:
