ohc: Uvekutzrechem et ketzir vegomer. ma inyan ze lechan? veulay shebba lechayyev gam sade shehuva mimmennu haomer shechayyav beleket ufea, shettavo hassevara lomar kevan shettechillato niktzar lekarban yihye patur mippea vechulei talmud lomar. velaze timtza shello hizkir ella leket ufea shehem chovat sade belo sovev emtzai, velo huzekar shichcha shehi baa mitztzad baal hassade. uvetorat kohanim amru sheramaz Adonai baze shekkol mi shennoten leket shichcha ufea maale alav keillu bet hammikdash kayyam vehu makriv karbenotav letocho vechulei, ad kan. ma sheamar shichcha af shello huzekar bappasuk, letzad shehi mitzva shechayyav bah keleket ufea kelalah. vehakkatuv shello katav lehaircha shennitkavven gam ken ladderech shekkatavti.

rashi: Vehenif hakkohen otam, tenufa. melammed shetteunin tenufa chayyim, yachol kullam, talo "al shene chevashim" (80 menachot 62):
Kodesh yihyu. lefi sheshshalme yachid kadashim kallim, huzkak lomar beshalme tzibbur shehen kadshe kadashim:
Laaretz yihye lo laachuzza. targum yonatan: "da ara tehe rabba leachasanta":
Velo yonu. leshon onaat mamon, sheggozlin et nachalatam:
targum: Da ara tehe lerabba leachsanta beyisrael vela yenisun od ravreve yat ami veara yittenun levet yisrael leshivtehon:

rashi: Pene tzonecha. al yekallu beenecha lehitbonen bam tamid ma hem tzerichim:
targum: Ma dedae ant da appe anach vesim libbach al kevatin:

rashi: Ach. kol achin verakkin shebbattora miutim — mechapper hu lashshavim veeno mechapper al sheenam shavim (sifra):
ohc: Yom hakkippurim hu mikra kodesh vegomer. perush, belo emtzaut keriatam oto kodesh, uvelo innuy shemmitannim bo, hu yom kippur mitztzad atzmo. umeatta yesh sachar lemitzvat keriat kodesh veinnuy bo, millevad revach hakkappara.

rashi: Almana ugerusha. min haish hazzar:
Vezera en lah. mimmennu:
Veshava. ha im yesh lah zera mimmennu, asura vitruma kol zeman shehazzera kayyam (yevamot 77):
Vechol zar lo yochal bo. lo va ella lehotzi et haonen — shemmuttar bitruma, zarut amarti lecha velo aninut (sham sham 68):
ohc: Uvat kohen ki tihye almana vegomer. medabber hakkatuv bivchinat neshama lanneshama sheen maggiah devekut hara kol ikkar, ella shehi borachat veholechet lah kemo sheamarnu, vehu ma shennatan taam bevat kohen telisha, lomar ki bechina zo meulla beyoter, velaze en zar ittah kemo sheamarnu shealeha neemar "lo yeunne latztzaddik" vegomer (Mishlei 12:21). vekoroteha hem shettihye almana ugerusha, amar almana keishsha sheen lah baal hazzan umefarnesah, kemo chen balah lo zan velo mefarnesah bemitzvot uvemaasim tovim. ugerusha ki letzad sheppashat yado haadam laavor pi Adonai – gershah mimmennu kemo shekkatavnu. vezera en lah – shello asa perot baolam hazze, af al pi chen veshava el bet aviha vachazaratah hi leechol mishshulchan aviha kime neureha shehayta ochelet bevusha millechem aviha tochel, ma sheen ken neshama shehissiga asot tora umitzvot sheochelet yegiah keadam haochel mishshello.

Veamro vechol zar lo yochal kodesh, natan taam lamma en hashshem yitbarach merachem gam lanneshama lehaachilah kodesh betorat chen vachesed, laze amar hattaam hu "vechol zar" vegomer, velaze neshama shennidbak bah bechinat hara hannikra zar lo tochal, leval yochal hazzar hahu hannidbak bah:

rashi: Kol nevela uterefa vegomer. lefi shehuttera lahem melikat chattat haof, shehi nevela uterefa, hutzrach lehazehiram al shear nevelot uterefot; kach pershu rabbotenu (menachot ma.):
targum: Kol nevela utevira min ofa umin beira la yechlun kahanaya:

rashi: Tzav et bene yisrael. zo farashat mitzvat hannerot, ufarashat veatta tetzavve lo neemra ella al seder melechet hammishkan, lefaresh tzorech hammenora, vechen mashma: veatta sofcha letzauot et bene yisrael al kach:
Shemen zayit zach. shelosha shemanim yotzim min hazzayit, harishon karuy zach, vehen meforashin bimnachot (daf 86) uvetokko:
Tamid. millayla lelayla, kemo olat tamid, sheenah ella miyyom leyom:
ohc: Tzav et bene yisrael vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma inyan mitzvat shemen vehadelakato bemakom ze, gam mitzvat maarechet hashshulchan ma inyano lechan, uma gam shekkevar neemru haddevarim kichtavan bimkoman bemitzvat hammishkan umitzvotav. verashi zichrono livracha peresh ma shepperesh, veen bidvarav davar maspik. veramban zichrono livracha katav shekkala hashshemen vechulei, veen reaya lidvarav.

Veulay ki letzad shetztzivva mitzvot sheviiyyot – pesach shiva yamim, chag hassukkot shiva yamim, simchat hamminim shiva yamim, gam rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim yeshnam bivchinat hashsheva leheyotam bachodesh hashshevii, laze samach laze gam ken mitzvat hammenora shehi bechinat sheva nerot, gam hashshulchan yeshno besod sheva dichtiv "shesh hammaarachet" vegomer vehashshulchan hassedurot alav shehu sod hammitkabbetz bo shesh maalot vehi mashlemet sheva, vetimtza shetztzivva gam ken befarasha zo mitzvat haomer shehu sheva shabbatot, gam mitzvat hashshabbat, nimtzeta omer shekkalal kol mitzvot hashsheviiyyot yachad lomar ki sodam veikkaram echad.

Od efshar shennitkavven bismichut parashat menora lefarashat sukka, al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha (torat kohanim) befasuk "michutz lefarochet haedut" veze leshonam: vechi leora haya tzarich? vahalo kol haarbaim shana shehayu bammidbar lo halchu ella leoro, ufershu hattosafot (shabbat 22:) shello hayu holchim leor hachamma ella leor hashshechina, shehayu roim ma shebbetoch hattappuach vechulei, ella edut levae olam vechulei, ad kan. vehu ma shennitchakkem Adonai bismichut ze shel mitzvat hammenora lemitzvat sukka "ki vassukkot" vegomer, lomar ki yisrael letzad anne chavod lo haya lahem or hashshemesh, vahalichatam hayta leoro yitbarach, im ken mitzvat menora enah ella lefarochet haedut, edut levae olam vechulei.

rashi: Paare. kappiyelsh belaaz:

Lo yachgeru bayyaza. shaninu bivrayta: en chogrin bemakom shemmeziin, lo lemala meatzilehem velo lematta mimmatnehem, shehu mekom zea (zevachim 18:). anlashoyira belaaz. lashon acher: asra hattora lakkohanim malbushe hatztzemer, ki hatztzemer mezia hagguf umezia et habbasar:
targum: Kovin devutz yehon al reshehon umichnesin devutz yehon al chartzehon vela yezarzun al chartzehon elahen al levavehon yesarun:

rashi: Dabber el bene yisrael, moade Adonai. ase moadot sheyyihyu yishorael melummadin bahem, shemmeabberim et hashshana al galuyyot shenneekru mimmekoman laalot laregel vaadayin lo higgiu lirushalayim (sifra):
ohc: Moade Adonai vegomer. gezerat haddibbur. razal amru (torat kohanim) ki hu "asher tikreu otam", perush ki moade Adonai hem bizman sheyyikreu otam yisrael. vetzarich ladaat lamma chazar lomar "elle hem moaday". od tzarich ladaat lamma chazar letzauot al hashshabbat. veod roe ani shechazar lomar paam sheni achar mitzvat hashshabbat "elle moade Adonai".

Venire ki shiur hakketuvim hu, shemmittechilla tzivva Adonai ki ikkar hammoadot taluy bazzemannim asher yikreu otam, vechash hakkatuv sheyyitu lomar shebbichlal ze gam ken kedushshat yom hashshabbat im yaskimu lidchoto miyyomo leyom acher yitkaddesh al pihem, laze chazar uferesh elle hem moaday sheshet yamim vegomer, perush elle shehem shabbatot hem moaday, moadim shekkava habbore veenam begeder hishtannut. vechazar lomar elle moade Adonai mikrae kodesh asher hirsheti etchem shettikreu otam attem, bachodesh harishon vegomer, pesach shavuot rosh hashshana yom kippur sukkot, ellu en kedushshatam ella al pi yisrael.

Od nire lomar taam shekkafal lomar asher tikreu otam shete peamim, al derech ma shekkatav rambam beferek 4 mehilchot kiddush hachodesh veze leshono: al shalosh sibbot meabberin hashshana – al hattekufa, veal haaviv, veal perot hailan. veyesh sham devarim acherim shebbet din meabberin bishvilan mippene hadderachim vechulei umippene haggesharim vechulei umippene tannure fesachim vechulei umippene galuyyot yisrael shenneekru mimmekoman vaadayin lo higgiu lirushalayim vechulei, ad kan. hare ki lishte sibbot kollot meabberin umeacharin hammoed, haachat letzad tenae hazzeman sheyyihye baaviv, vehashsheniyya letzad kishron haam. laze amar hakkatuv shete peamim "asher tikreu otam", veshello tomar shelletzad tenae hazzeman shehitna hakkatuv chodesh haaviv levad meabberin, aval lechishron haam yaase hammoed bazzemannim hannimtzaim muchsharim, talmud lomar shete peamim asher tikreu otam.

rashi: Veish ki yakke. lefi shenneemar makke ish vamet (Shemot 21), en li ella sheharag et haish, ishsha vekatan minnayin? talo "kol nefesh adam":
Veyinnazru. en nezira ella ferisha, vechen hu omer "vayyinnazer meacharay" (Yechezkel 14), "nazoru achor" (Yeshayahu 1) — yifreshu min hakkodashim bime tumatan (sifra):
Veyinnazru mikkodshe vene yisrael, asher hem makdishim li velo yechallelu et shem kodshi. sares hammikra vedarshehu:
Asher hem makdishim li. lerabbot kadshe chohanim atzman:

Vachamishsha veesrim elef. kanim orech vaaseret alafim rochav – tarimu retzua acheret, etzel zo bidromah shel zo, letzorech haleviyyim; kach meforash besof hassefer, shehi baddarom (Yechezkel 48:10-13). matzati, esrim leshachot yihye lalviyyim behekkef hammikdash, lishmor habbayit ulenoy, umotar hartzuot yaasu letzarchehem, tosfot:
targum: Veasrin vechamsha alfin ureka veasra alfin puteya vihe lelevae meshamshe veta lehon leachasana asrin lishkan:

rashi: Reshit ketzirchem. shettehe rishona lakkatzir (sifra):
Omer. asirit haefa kach hayta shemah, kemo vayyamoddu vaomer (Shemot 16):

Vayyannichuhu. levaddo, velo hinnichu mekoshesh immo — sheshshenehem hayu beferek echad — veyodim hayu shehammekoshesh bemita, aval lo forash lahem beezo mita lechach neemar (Bamidbar 15), ki lo forash ma yeashe lo; aval bammekallel hu omer lifrosh lahem, shello hayu yodim im chayyav mita im lav (sifra; sanhedrin 78):

Lo yikrechu korcha. al met vahalo af yisrael huzharu al kach? ella lefi shenneemar beyisrael ben enechem (Devarim 14), yachol lo yehe chayyav al kol harosh, tal berosham, veyillamdu yisrael mikkohanim bigzera shava, neemar kan karcha veneemar beyisrael karcha, ma kan kol harosh af lehallan kol harosh bemashma — kol makom sheyyikrach barosh, uma lehallan al met, af kan al met (makkot 20):

Ufeat zekanam lo yegallechu. lefi shenneemar beyishorael lo tashchit, yachol likketo bemalket urehitni yehe chayyav, lechach neemar lo yegallechu. sheeno chayyav ella al davar hakkaruy gilluach veyesh bo hashechata, vezehu taar (sham):

Uvivsaram lo yisretu saratet. lefi shenneemar beyisrael veseret lanefesh lo tittenu (Vayikra 19), yachol sarat chamesh seritot lo yehe chayyav ella achat, tal lo yisretu saratet, lechayyev al kol serita userita, shetteva zo yetera hi lidrosh, shehaya lo lichtov lo yisretu vaani yodea shehi saretet (sifra; 42 20):

Nevela uterefa lo yochal letoma vah. leinyan hattuma hizhir kan, sheim achal nivlat of tahor sheen lah tumat magga umassa ella tumat achila bevet habbelia, asur leechol bakkodashim; vetzarich lomar "uterefa" — mi sheyyesh bemino terefa, yatza nivlat of tame sheen bemino terefa:
Gala chatzir. kesheggala hechatzir bime nisan veyira haddeshe veneesfu asavim litzmoach, az yetiv lecha, sheyyihyu gizzotehem shel kevasim lilvushecha:
targum: Shevach amira veetchame dita veitkenesh isba deture:

rashi: Leish zar. lelevi veyisrael (sifra):
ohc: Uvat kohen vegomer hi vegomer. betorat kohanim darshu miut "hi" leimmah, sheimmah ochelet mitztziddah, hagam shehi enah ochelet, vaafillu nitalmena immah.

Veraiti lehair libbot bene adam beremez gadol asher ramza parasha zo. da ki amru zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 93.) sheam bene yisrael haderagatam lemala mehaderagat hammalachim. veamru od (Zohar 10 155.) ki Adonai bara arbaa olamot ze lemala mizze, ureshumim hemma bappasuk (Yeshayahu 43:7) "kol hannikra vishmi velichvodi berativ yetzartiv af asitiv". lichvodi – olam elyon hannikra atzilut, berativ – hannikra olam habberia, yetzartiv – yetzira, asitiv – asiyya. od yesh lecha ladaat ki kevodo yitbarach male kol olam veolam vead mittachat olam, dichtiv (Devarim 32:9) "umittachat zeroot olam", veoro yitbarach meir bearbaa olamot, hiv besod arba otiyyot shem havaya baruch hiv, yod beolam haatzilut, hei rishona beolam habberia vechulei, veamru zichronam livracha (Zohar 11 218:) shechiyyunit hammitnoea bivne el chay hiv meoro yitbarach, dichtiv (Devarim 33:27) "ki chelek Adonai ammo". gam keraam Adonai banav.

Od amru zichrono livracha (Zohar 9 80:, 94:) ki bechinot hachiyyuni shebbaadam yityaches elav arbaa kinnuyim: yesh sheyyikkare nefesh, veyesh sheyyikkare ruach, veyesh sheyyikkare neshama, veyesh sheyyikkare chayya, besod "ki ruach hachayya baofannim", vetikkare neshama lanneshama. veamru anshe emet ki bechina habbaa meor olam haasiyya, letzad heyoto muat veen bo ella kol shehu mehachiyyunit hammenaanea, vehu hiv shemmargish bemuregashot olam hazze, veasa Adonai kacha lesibbat haolam lihyoto gas, vezo tikkare nefesh. vehabba meor olam hayyetzira, letzad heyoto elyon meolam haasiyya, hearatah gedola vetikkare ruach. vehabbaa meor olam habberia tikkare neshama letzad haderagatah, vehabbaa meor olam haatzilut tikkare neshama lanneshama.

Vehinne haadon Adonai tzevaot asa hitkashsherut kol haolamot ruchani vegashmi beadam yashar, kashar kol haggashmiyyut vechol haruchaniyyut yachad. haggashmiyyut bana arbaa yesodot vesham sam lo chok haruchaniyyut mikkol haolamot. veyesh lecha ladaat ki haggashmiyyut yitnagged lechibbur haruchani yoter mehitnaggedut esh umayim, laze nitchakkem Adonai baruch hiv uvara baadam machon harishon shehu hannefesh sheen bah ella chelek muat meharuchaniyyut vehishra betochah bechina elyona mimmenna shehi bechinat haruach, venimtzet hannefesh memutztzaat ben hagguf uven haruach, ki en haruach omed baggeshem belo emtzaiyyut hannefesh, uchemo chen haruach mamtzia ben hannefesh vehanneshama, ki hannefesh beerech hanneshama sheorah rav kagguf leerech haruach, vechen neshama mematztzaat ben haruach uven neshama linshama. nimtzeta omer ki hannefesh yechola amod levaddah, veharuach bev, vehanneshama beg, uneshama linshama bed.

Od amru yode daat kadosh (Zohar 10 94:) ki hitatztzemut hashshelemim beemtzaut "lekach tov" asher natan lanu habbore hiv laalot middarga hattachtona lemadrega shellemala mimmenna, al ze hadderech nefesh yaale lemadregat ruach, veruach lemadregat neshama, uneshama lemadregat neshama linshama, vezo hi tachlit sibbat beriat haadam, ten lechacham veyechkam.

Od amru zichronam livracha ki hahassaga behaalaa zo tesovev sheyyishlach adam yado veyehane keadam haose beshello, vehu sod (tehillim 128:2) "yegia kappecha ki tochel ashrecha vetov lach", perush haosher shellecha vehattov shellecha, vehu maamar chachamenu zichronam livracha shehannefesh kodem biatah laolam hazze ochelet kevat bogeret, uvachazaratah kevat nesua.

Od yesh lecha ladaat ki kol asher yatzar uvara veasa Adonai, hakkol omed lemazon ulemichya meolam haelyon sheelav yikkare olam haatzilut, vehu or hayyod shebbishmo yitbarach, vehammazon hahu yikkare kodesh, vehu mekor hachayyut vehaosher vehattov. vahagam ki chol hannivraim yored lahem hachayyut, ki zulat hachayyut en nivra, vehu sod amro (Nechemya 9:6) "veatta mechayye et kullam", im kol ze yishtanne hashshefa behitrachakuto, kaasher yishtanne hatztzomeach min haaretz keshemmitrachek mehayyenika. veasa Adonai kacha latet lechol echad kefi bechinato uchefi asher yassig betaharato, gam laaretz haggashmit yitten lah Adonai mayim vezehu shifah vechayyutah veholida vehitzmicha. veal derech ze gam ken hiv shefa hachiyyuniyyut shel hannefashot veharuchot vehanneshamot uneshamot lanneshamot kefi bechinatah, ki lo chol hannefashot behaderaga achat, velo chol vechulei shavot vechulei, veen lecha nivra ben baggashmiyyim ben baruchaniyyim ben bammalachim haelyonim ben bannefashot ruchot (kochot) neshamot neshamot lanneshamot sheenam tzerichin lashshefa hakkadosh, ella kol echad kefi sharsho hakkadosh.

Od yesh lecha ladaat ki leheyot sheyyesh adam shezzoche lechol hammadregot hakkedoshot, veyesh shezzoche leshalosh, veyesh lishtayim, veyesh leachat, umi shello zacha ella bannefesh baolam hazze velo laruach en maasav moilim kelum, ki en koach beyado lahashivah lemala, ki en machazik beyado lehattotah ella beemtzaut haruach. im yizke laruach beemtzaut maasav hattovim yaale hannefesh lemadregat haruach. veda ki kaasher yaalenna lemadregat haruach hinne hiv kenaah bemaasav venikra hiv balah, vehu sod amro (Mishlei 23:2) "im baal nefesh atta", perush, kenaah vehu shello beemtzaut hayyegia, vehammussag mehayyegia naase haruach baal nefesh ki ola hi immo veshavim hem behaderaga umekom tachanoto tachanotah, mippitto tochal umikkoso tishte uvecheko tishkav. vechen haruach beerech hanneshama, vehanneshama beerech nishmatah. ukeniyyat madregat bechinot hakkedoshot halo hiv beechad mishshete sibbot: o mitztzad hammazria, ki haav yafil koach elyon babben kemo shepperashti befarashat vaychi (Bereshit 49:3) befasuk "reuven bechori", o letzad hitatztzemut beemtzaut esek hattora, uchemo shekkatav bazzohar hakkadosh (Zohar 11 91:) befarashat "shor o chesev o ez ki yivvaled", ki haadam yachol lehassig ma kefi hitatztzemuto battora vechulei, afillu yihye bemadrega sheen lematta mimmenna, im yitrach yassig haderagot elyonot kefi shiur hayyegia, yeuyyan sham devarav.

Od yesh lecha ladaat ki hammesubbav mechet haadam gam ken yishtanne kefi ma shehi bechinat haadam, ki eno dome pegam asher yesovev lannefesh kifgam haruach ushear hadderagot, ki pegam hannefesh yesovev kilyono besod (Yechezkel 18:4) "hannefesh hachotet hi tamut", ufegam haruach afillu lo yesovev ella ketamim unegaim yechashev pegam gadol, velaze yetzavve Adonai alav "veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah" vedarshu razal (shabbat kinnev:) tena lo kemo shennetanah lecha, shezzulat ze nidbakim bah sirche hattuma visabbuha ligyone hassitra achara veyimnauha mishshuv el mekomah harishon. ufegam hanneshama hagam shello yaggiah kashshiur hannizkar ella yifchat orah mimma shehaya techassehu kelimma, ki hakkol kefi hammevayyesh vehammitbayyesh. ufegam neshama lanneshama hagam shello yaggia aleha mehappegam velo hafechatat orah ella sheyyesovev shettetze mimmennu shello kirtzonah, kemo sheamru battikkunim (tikun 70) besod pasuk "lo yeunne latztzaddik kol aven" shemmedabber hakkatuv bemi sheyyesh lo neshama lanneshama ucheshebba adam lide chet mistalleket hanneshama hakkedosha shello yeunne lah aven, vesillukah ze takpid alav kefi erech maalatah, ha lema haddavar dome limachsen melech beveto vechozer bo umegarsho.

Veachare hodia Adonai otanu kol haamur, nuchal lomar ki hen henna haddevarim haamurim bakketuvim. vehitchil lomar vechol zar lo yochal kodesh medabber bishne inyene kodesh: bekodesh hakkarbanot, uvakkodesh hannelam shehu shefa haruchani mazon livne elohim.

Veamar toshav kohen vesachir lirmoz el haruach veel hannefesh, ki haruach hiv toshav kohen, perush, ki bo moshav hanneshama hannikret kohen shehi madrega haelyona, vesachir gam ken hiv hannefesh ki hiv happoel kol melachot haadam. shete bechinot ellu hodia hakkatuv sheenam reuyim leechol mehammazon hannikra kodesh letzad heyoto madrega gedola, vetze ulemad ma shekkatav harashbi (Zohar 10 121.) bahefresh shebben kodesh lekodesh.

Veamar vechohen ki yikne nefesh vegomer, perush kohen hi neshama haelyona tikkare kohen. vehizkirah bilshon zachar lomar ki kevan shehiggia legader ze tikkare bemadregat zachar. "ki yikne nefesh" – ki beemtzaut kishron maaseha kanta gam hannefesh veheelta otah lemadregatah vetikkare baal nefesh (Mishlei 23:2).
Hiv yochal bo. perush, ki yizke lehanot gam hannefesh mikkodesh, ma shello haya ze kodem aliyyatah, veamar hannefesh umikkol shekken haruach shehu elyon minnefesh.

Veamro vilid beto, yechavven el nafshot hakkedushsha asher naflu mizzeman kadmon, vehem mitbarrim beemtzaut kishron maase hatztzaddikim, shehammaase hattov hiv keeven hashshoevet lehotzi nitzotz hattov, veyityachasu beshem yelide hanneshama hamevarartam, veamar hakkatuv sheggam hem yaalu immah lehanot mikkodesh.

Veamro uvat kohen – medabber hakkatuv banneshama shennifgema venitmea bemaaseha, shettafsid hanaat hakkodesh. vehu amro uvat kohen shehi hanneshama, ki tihye leish zar shehu 131 shechamda matammotav vattizne acharav, "hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel". dikdek lomar "bitrumat", lomar sheafillu terumat hakkodashim lo tochel, tere mimmea, veen tzarich lomar hakkodesh atzmo. vedikdek lomar "hi" lishlol acheret habba mishpatah besamuch, dichtiv "uvat", veze hiv innuy hannefesh kesheyyechsar mezonah hi nishpelet venechshach orah veyarad hadarah rachamana litzlan.

rashi: Hakkerova. lerabbot et haarusa (sifra; yevamot 60):
Asher lo hayta leish. lemishkav:
Lah yittamma. mitzva (sifra; zevachim 100):
Peri etz hadar. etz shettaam etzo ufiryo shave (sukka 35):
Hadar. haddar beilano mishshana leshana, vezehu etrog (sham):
Kappot temarim. chaser 22, limmed sheenah ella achat:
Vaanaf etz avot. sheanafav keluim kaavotot vechachavalim, vezehu hadas, heasuy kemin kelia (sham 32):
Bayyom hahu yeachel. lo va lehazehir ella shettehe shechita al menat ken, sheim likboa lo zeman achila, kevar katuv uvesar zevach todat shelamav vegomer (Vayikra 7):
Ani Adonai. da mi gazar al haddavar veal yekal beenecha:
Vaachuzzat hair. behekkef hair, achuzzat moshav chol shellah, livnot bah yisrael battim:
Tittenu chameshet alafim rochav. bidromah shel sheniyya, veorech kemiddat shete hartzuot; nimtzet kol hatteruma merubbaat: esrim vachamishsha al esrim vachamishsha alafim:
Leummat terumat hakkodesh. kelomar: bemiddat orech retzuot terumat hakkodesh:
Lechol bet yisrael yihye. otah retzua shelishit tihye moshav lazzarim:
targum: Veachasanat karta tittenun chamsha alfin puteya veureka asrin vechamsha alfin lokovel afrashut kudesha lechol bet yisrael yehe:

rashi: Haezrach. ze ezrach, beyisrael — lerabbot et haggerim (sifra):
Ki im betulot. yikkechu hakkohanim haggedolim, aval yesh min hakkohanim asher yikkechu et haalmana, kegon hedyotin, vezehu mikkohen yikkachu – yesh min hakkohen shemmuttarin bealmana, matzati:
Asher tihye almana. gemura, perat ligrusha vachalutza, af al pi sheppenuya hi, asura af lehedyot (kiddushin 78.):
targum: Vearmila umetarcha la yisvun lehon linshin elahen betuleta mizara devet yisrael vearmalta di tehe armalta shear kahanaya yisvun:

rashi: Ki yochal kodesh. teruma:
Venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh. davar harauy lihyot kodesh, sheeno forea lo maot, ella perot shel chullin vehen naashin teruma (fesachim 32):
ohc: Venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh. razal nechleku beferek 6 ditrumot: rabbi eliezer omer kol sherauy lihyot kodesh, verabbi akiva omer hakkodesh sheachal, ad kan. veulay sheyyechavven lomar sheal yede hannetina zo maale alav hakkatuv keillu noten hakkodesh atzmo, ucheillu lo achal hakkodesh.

rashi: Velo yechallelu vegomer. lehaachilam lezarim:
Vaasitem … keves. chova laomer hu va:
Kol melacha vegomer. laavor alav belavin harebe, o lehazehir al melechet layla kimlechet yom:
Ki yivvaled. perat leyotze dofen (sham 38):

Umiyyad ben nechar. shehevi karban beyad kohen lehakerivo lashshamayim lo takrivu lo baal mum; veaappi shello neesru vaale mumim lekarban bene noach ella ikke mechussere ever, zot noheget bevama shebbassadot, aval al hammizbeach shebbammishkan lo takrivu, aval temima tekabbelu mehem, lechach neemar lemala ish ish, lerabbot et haggoyim shennodrim nedarim unedavot keyisrael (chullin 13):
Moshchatam. chibbulehon:
Lo yeratzu lachem. lechapper alechem:
Cherem. leshon kodesh; vechen kol leshon cherma shehu al hakkodesh (Vayikra 27:28):
targum: Minchata chatata vaashama inun yechluneh vechol charma veyisrael lehon yehe:

rashi: Yihye mizze. min hatteruma hazzo yihye letzorech hakkodesh lehar habbayit chamesh meot kanim, vehammotar levattim lakkohanim, kemo shemmeforash besof hassefer (Yechezkel 48:8-21):
targum: Yehe miden lekudesha chamesh mea bachamesh mea merubba sechor sechor vechamshin amin rucha leh sechor sechor:

rashi: Velo yechallel zaro. ha im nasa achat min happesulot, zaro hemenna chalal middin kedushshat kehunna (sham):
Nasu veen rodef rasha. nasu harshaim kesheyyavo edam veyippelu bedavar kal meen rodef:
Vetzaddikim. ammitz libbam (Amos 2:16) behakkadosh baruch hu kichfir asher yivtach bigvurato:
targum: Arkin rashie bidlet deradef lehon vetzadike hech arya demisteche lemechuleteh mesabberin lechachmata:

rashi: Veachare tohorato. achar perishato min hammet; kach shenuya bemoed katan (moed katan 15:):
targum: Uvatar dechuteh shava yomin yimnun leh:

rashi: Vehikravtem ishshe vegomer. hem hammusafin haamurim befarashat pinchas, velamma neemru chan? lomar sheen hammusafin meakkevin ze et ze:
Vehikravtem ishshe laAdonai. mikkol makom — im en parim have elim, veim en parim veelim have chevasim (sham):
Shivat yamim. kol makom shenneemar shivat shem davar hu — shavua shel yamim, shettina belaaz, vechen kol leshon shemonat sheshet chameshet sheloshet:

Melechet avoda. afillu melachot hachashuvot lachem avoda vetzorech — sheyyesh chesron kis bevattala shellahen — kegon davar haaved, kach hevanti mittokko, dekatane yachol af chullo shel moed yehe asur bimlechet avoda vechulei:
O gibben. shvrytzyvlsh belaaz, sheggevine enav searan aroch veshochev:
O dak. sheyyesh lo veenav dok, shekkorim 50, kemo "hannote chaddok" (Yeshayahu 40):

O tevallul. davar hamevalbel et haayin, kegon chut lavan hannimshach min halloven ufosek bassira, shehu ogel hammakkif et hashshachor shekkorim frvnylo, vehachut hazze posek et haogel venichnas bashshachor; vetargum tevallul "chilliz", leshon chillazon, shehu dome letolaat oto hachut, vechen kinnuhu chachme yishorael bemume habbechor chillazon, nachash, enav (bechorot 38):

Garav o yallefet. mine shechin hem; garav zo hacheres, shechin hayyavesh mibbifnim umibbachutz, yallefet hi chazazit hammitzrit, velamma nikret yallefet? shemmelappefet veholechet ad yom hammita, vehu lach mibbachutz veyavesh mibbifnim, uvemakom acher kore laggarav shechin hallach mibbachutz veyavesh mibbifnim, shenneemar "uvaggarav uvechares" (Devarim 28), keshessamach garav etzel cheres, kore layyallefet garav, ucheshehu samuch etzel yallefet, kore lacheres garav, kach meforash bivchorot (daf 41):
Meroach ashech. lefi hattargum meras pachadin, sheppechadav merussasin — shebbetzim shello chetutin, pechadin kemo "gide fachadav yesoragu" (Iyov 40):
Nidrehem. hare alay:
Nidvotam. hare zo:
Uminchato. minchat nesachav:
Shene esronim. kefula hayta:
Venisko yayin reviit hahin. aappi shemminchato chefula en nesachav kefulim:
Veachar yochal min hakkodashim. nidreshet bivamot (daf 74), bitruma shemmuttar leachlah behaarev hashshemesh:
Min hakkodashim. velo chol hakkodashim:
Ach el happarochet. lehazzot sheva hazzaot sheal happarochet.
Veel hammizbeach. hachitzon; ushenehem hutzrechu likkatev, umeforash betokko:
Velo yechallel et mikdashay. sheim avad avodato mechullelet lippasel (sifra):
Ben haarbayim. mishshesh shaot ulemala (sham):
Pesach laAdonai. hakeravat karban sheshshemo pesach:
ohc: Ben haarbayim pesach laAdonai. perush, chelek hannogea laAdonai mikkarban pesach shehu mattan damim vehaketarat chalavim yihye ben haarbayim, aval chelek hannogea leyisrael shehu achilat habbasar yihye belel chamishsha asar al matztzot umerorim. od yirtze beamro pesach laAdonai, letzad sheppesach mitzrayim shehu pesach rishon asuhu leahavat hearev vehammoil, hearev sheamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 19) shennitbassem pischo shel moshe meruchot gan eden, veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat bo (Shemot 12:43), vehammoil lifsoach hammashchit al battehem, vechan amar ki pesach dorot yaasuhu leshem Adonai hagam sheen bo echad mishshetehen.

rashi: Arum raa raa. roe puranut habbaa al haaretz venistar hemenna, shemmashach yado min haavera. ufetayim lo nisteru ella avru bederech raa:
Veneenashu. venifsedu:
targum: Arima chaza vishta umitshe veshavre avrin alah vechasrin:

rashi: Yochal piryah. vechen shomer adonav yechubbad, veyochal peri maalalav:
targum: Denater tenta achel piryaha udezaher bemareh nityakar:

rashi: Vehayta. hammincha hazzot, shekkol davar habba min hattevua bichlal mincha hu:
Vaachaluhu. musav al hallechem shehu leshon zachar:

Mevarech reehu. yesh meshabbeach et chavero yom yom, vehabberacha nehefechet liklala, sheomrim alav shehu vatran bemamono veashir, vehakkol bain veshoalin mimmennu, vehammalchut mitgaret bo ligbot mamon. kach nidrash bemassechet arachin (arachin 16.). veod yesh bemidrash rabbi tanchuma (tanchuma, balak kad): keneged bilam shehaya mevarech et yisrael bekol ram, shenneemar "vayyissa meshalo vegomer" (Bamidbar 23:7), leshon nesiut kol, vesofo yaatz lehachatiam:
targum: Dimvarech lechavreh bekala rama betzafra vekiduma levatata titchashiv leh:

rashi: Vaydabber moshe. hammitzva hazzot.
El aharon veel banav veel kol bene yisrael. lehazehir bet din al hakkohanim (80 sifra):
Bishchuto. milleshon shachat:
targum: Demashge teritze bearcha vishta begimutza hu nafel ushelime utemime nertun tavta:

rashi: Veroe zollim. mechabber lo zollim, vehu leshon reim:
targum: Denatar orayta vera hu demitbayen udemitchabber lizlile machametz avuy:

rashi: Vechohen ki yikne nefesh. eved kenaani shekkanuy legufo:
Vilid beto. ellu vene hashshefachot; veeshet kohen ochelet bitruma min hammikra hazze, sheaf hi kinyan kaspo, veod lamed mimmikra acher (Bamidbar 18), kol tahor bevetcha vegomer besifre:
Befesha eretz rabbim sareha. shezzehu puranut laaretz, bihyot sareha rabbim harodfim rak achar bitzam:
Uveadam mevin. uvishvil adam mevin yitarech happureanut millavo:
targum: Bechoveha deara sagiin ravrevanaha uvene nasha demitbaynin midiata nigdun:

rashi: Uvene yisrael asu. kol hammitzva haamura bassekila bemakom acher — dechiyya, regima uteliyya (80 sifra; sanhedrin 43):
ohc: Uvene yisrael asu vegomer. kashe, ma mekom "uvene yisrael asu" vegomer achar sheamar "vayyotziu et hamekallel vegomer vayyirgemu oto aven", hareni roe sheasu et asher tzivva Adonai? veyesh lomar, letzad shehaya haddavar al yede meriva umachloket shehayta ben hayyisreeli uven ben hayyisreelit, yesh makom lomar sheasu bo mishpat katuv leemtzaut gam ken tina shebballev, laze amar asu kaasher tzivva Adonai, perush, letzad mitzvat Adonai hu sheasu.
O nitkavven hakkatuv lehaalot hammitzva sheasauha kol yisrael, hagam shello hayta bo yad kullam.
O yirtze, sheal yede maase ze shekkinu kinat kevodo yitbarach, heela alehem hakkatuv gam ken keillu asu kol hattora, vehu amro "kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe" bederech kelal.

O yomar al ze hadderech, letzad shebbemitzvat Adonai lemoshe amar hotze et hamekallel shechozer el moshe ki hu yotzi oto, vehargima tihye al yede yisrael dichtiv veragmu oto kol haeda, vechan amar "vayyotziu hamekallel" shechozer el yisrael hammuzkarim besamuch, uva hakkatuv leshabbeach leyisrael veamar uvene yisrael asu kaasher tzivva Adonai lemoshe, perush, laasot hu, kadmu hem bedabbero alehem veasu oto kodem sheyyaasehu moshe, letzad hazzerizut vehammehirut lekayyem mitzvat Adonai. veladderachim harishonim nefaresh hotze, o hu o shelucho.
Chassalat parashat emor

rashi: Anshe ra lo yavinu mishpat. enam mesimim lev lefureaniyyot haatidot, sheyyitbonnu bah veyashuvu middarkam veyinnatzlu:
Umevakshe Adonai yavinu chol. tova veraa. mishpat. yoshtitza belaaz; kach peresh rabbi tanchuma (tanchuma, Bereshit 37) al dor hammabbul:
targum: Bene nasha bishe la mitbaynin dina udevae min kodam Adonai mitbaynin kulehon tavta:

rashi: Elle moade Adonai. lemala medabber beibbur shana vechan medabber bekiddush hachodesh:
Hashshabbat hashsheviit. ketargumo shevuata shevieta:
Ad mimmochorat hashshabbat hashsheviit tisperu. velo ad bichlal, vehen arbaim vetisha yom:

Chamishshim yom vehikravtem mincha chadasha laAdonai. bayyom hachamishshim takrivuha, veomer ani ze midrasho, aval peshuto ad mimmochorat hashshabbat hashsheviit shehu yom chamishshim tisperu, umikra mesoras hu:
Mincha chadasha. hi hammincha harishona shehuvea min hechadash, veitto hare karva minchat haomer enah kishar kol hammenachot, shehi vaa min hasseorim (menachot 14):

Lefarochet haedut. shellifne haaron shehu karuy edut; verabbotenu darshu al ner maaravi, shehu edut lechol bae olam shehashshechina shora veyisrael, shennoten bah shemen kemiddat chavroteha, umimmenna haya matchil uvah haya mesayyem (shabbat 22; menachot 86):

Yaaroch oto aharon meerev ad boker. yaaroch oto aricha haruya lemiddat kol hallayla, veshiaru chachamim chatzi log lechol ner vaner, vehen keday af lelele tekufat tevet, umidda zo hukbea lahem (menachot 89):
Gever rash. dayyan am haaretz:
Oshek dallim. bedin al sheeno matun bedin, hare hu kematar hassochef et hassade veen ose perot:
Sochef. shotef, uvammishna (ketuvot 7,8): "nistachafa sadehu", vechen "nischaf abbirecha" (Yirmeyahu 46:15) – nishtefu umaadu vechashlu:
targum: Gavra deashek lemiskene ech mitra chavita delet beh yitran:

rashi: Atzeret hiv. atzarti etchem etzli; kemelech shezzimmen et banav lisuda lechach vechach yamim, kevan shehiggia zemannan lippater, amar, banay bevakkasha mikkem akkevu immi od yom echad, kasha alay peredatchem:
Kol melechet avoda. afillu melacha shehi avoda lachem, sheim lo taasuha yesh chesron kis baddavar.
Lo taasu. yachol af chullo shel moed yehe asur bimlechet avoda, talo "hiv" (sham):
Ola umincha. minchat nesachim hakkereva im haola:
Devar yom beyomo. chok hakkatzuv bechummash happekudim:
Devar yom beyomo. ha im avar yomo batel karbano (80 sifra):
ohc: Moade Adonai. amar rabbi akiva (torat kohanim pasuk 35): ellu yeme moed sheasurin bimlacha, ad kan. venire ki laze gamar omer umillevad mattenotechem vegomer, kol nidrechem vegomer, kol nidvotechem asher tittenu laAdonai, shemmashma afillu olot, veen olot bain beyom tov, keamram (betza 19.): lachem velo legavoah, ella vadday sheen hakkatuv medabber ella bechullo shel moed.

rashi: Mimmoshvotechem. velo michutza laaretz (sifra):
Lechem tenufa. lechem teruma, hammuram leshem gavoah, vezo hi hammincha hachadasha haamura lemala:
Bikkurim. rishona lechol hammenachot, af leminchat kenaot habbaa min seorim lo tikrav min hechadash kodem lishte hallechem (sham):
Mimmochorat hashshabbat. mimmochorat yom tov:
Temimot tihyena. melammed shemmatchil umone mibbaerev, sheim lo chen enan temimot (sifra; menachot 66):
ohc: Usefartem lachem vegomer. amro lachem, letzad shetztzivva Adonai lispor sheva shabbatot, veamru zichronam livracha (Zohar 11 97.) ki letzad shehayu betumat mitzrayim veratza Adonai lehizdavveg leumma zo, dan bah kemishpat nidda sheddinah lispor shiva nekiyyim, vetzivva sheyyisperu shiva shavuot veaz yihyu muchsharim lehachenisatam kalla lachuppa. vahagam ki sham shiva yamim vechan shiva shavuot, letzad hafelagat hattuma, vegam heyotam bichlalut yisrael, shier hattemim deim ki chen mishpatam. veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk (Shemot 19:1) "bachodesh hashshelishi letzet" vegomer. vehu maamar hakkatuv kan usefartem lachem, perush sibbat sefira zo hi lesibbatchem, letaharatchem, shezzulat ze techef haya Adonai noten lahem hattora. ulederech ze yeduyyak al nachon taam mimmochorat hashshabbat velo miyyom hashshabbat atzmo, ki chen mishpat hassefira sheyyihyu kol hayyamim shelemim, uletzad sheyyom 15 benisan shehu yom hashshabbat haamur kan miktzat hayyom hayu adayin beeretz mitzrayim, laze yetzav Adonai lispor mimmochorat. vahagam ki ze haya befesach mitzrayim, kammishpat hazze yease beoto perek atzmo midde shana beshana, ki kemo chen yease besod Adonai kayyadua leyode chen. uchefi happeshat lezichron haover beyom hashshabbat lezichron "ki sheshet yamim" vegomer, vehammaskil yavin. veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat bereshit befasuk "vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii" (Bereshit 2:2).

Uvederech remez ramaz beamro usefartem al derech amram zichronam livracha ki nishmot am bene yisrael hem bivchinat halluchot, uveemtzaut tachalue hannefesh vetumat hattiuv yitlachlechu veyachshich oram, veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 32:2) ki halluchot shel sanpirinon hayu. laze amar usefartem lachem, perush, beemtzaut minyan ze attem meirim kesanpirinon et atzmechem.

Mimmochorat hashshabbat miyyom vegomer. perush, meachshav kodem shettikkansu laaretz "mimmochorat hashshabbat", ucheneged achar biatam laaretz amar miyyom haviachem vegomer, velaze hikdim "mimmochorat hashshabbat" leheyotah mitzva sheyyeshnah az, ma sheen ken "miyyom haviachem" shehu achar bia laaretz:

rashi: Shesh hammaarachet. shesh challot hammaarechet haachat:
Hashshulchan hattahor. shel zahav tahor; davar acher: al tohoro shel shulchan, shello yihyu hassenifin magbihin et hallechem meal gabbe hashshulchan (sham; menachot 97):
Lirtzonchem. haviu davar harauy leratztzot etchem lefanay, sheyyehe lachem leratzon, apeyymanet belaaz, veezehu harauy leratzon?
Tamim zachar babbakar bakkevasim uvaizzim. aval beolat haof en tzarich tammut vezachrut, veeno nifsal bemum ella bechesron ever (sifra):
Tov rash. af ani shebbattora:
Veholech betummo. bemaasim tovim:
targum: Tav miskena dimhalech bitmimuteh min hu dimakman archateh vehu attir:

rashi: Umauch vechatut venatuk vecharut. babbetzim o vaggid:
Mauch. betzav meuchin bayyad:
Kittot. ketushim yoter mimmauch:
Nittuk. telushin bayyad ad shennifseku chutim shetteluyim bahen, aval netunim hem betoch hakkis, vehakkis lo nitlash:
Vecharut. kerutin bichli veodan bakkis (bechorot 39):
[Umauch. targumo vedi meris, zehu leshono baaramit, leshon ketisha:
Vechatut targumo vedi resis, kemo "habbayit haggadol resisim" (Amos 6) — bekiot dakkot, vechen "kane hamerussas" (shabbat 80):]

Uveartzechem lo taasu. davar ze lesares shum behema vechayya, vaafillu temea, lechach neemar beartzechem lerabbot kol asher beartzechem, sheielo lo nitztauu al hasserus ella vaaretz, shehare serus chovat hagguf hi vechol chovat hagguf noheget ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz:
Lo yochal kodesh. bitruma hakkatuv medabber, shekkol hainyan dibber bah:

Toshav kohen vesachir. toshavo shel kohen usechiro, lefichach "toshav" ze nakud pattach, lefi shehu davuk; veezehu toshav? ze nirtza shehu kanuy lo ad hayyovel, veezehu shachir? ze kanuy kinyan shanim sheyyotze veshesh, ba hakkatuv velimmedcha kan sheen gufo kanuy laadonav leechol bitrumato (sifra; yevamot 70):

Velannasi mizze umizze litrumat hakkodesh velaachuzzat hair. besof happarasha hu cholek et eretz yisrael mimmizrachah lemaarvah lishlosh esre retzuot, shetem esre leminyan hashshevatim, vechol achat esrim vechamesh elef kanim rochav vearkan keorech kol eretz yisrael, uretzua achat lidromah, arka min haggevul mizrach vead gevul maarav, verachbah esrim vachamishsha alafim kanim, kishar kol chelek vechelek. umeotah retzua hu torem beemtzaitah shalosh retzuot hallalu haamurot lemala, shehem esrim vachamishsha alafim al esrim vachamishsha alafim, vehaodef alehem lammizrach ad sof haggevul haaretz, vechen lammaarav, yihye lannasi mizze umizze lammizrach ulemaarav:
El pene terumat hakkodesh veel pene achuzzat hair. keneged kol rochav shelosha hartzuot hammuvdalot litrumat hakkodesh shel retzuot hakkohanim vehaleviyyim vaachuzzat hair:
Mippeat yam yamma. mimmaarav terumat hakkodesh vehair ad maarav haggevul:

Umippeat kedma kadima. umimmizrach hatteruma lemetzer mimmizrach, leummot achad hachalakim shel shevatim hameforashin besof hassefer (Yechezkel 48:21), shehem miggevul yam shel eretz yisrael, ad gevul kadim:
targum: Ulerabba mikka umikka leafrashut kudesha uleachsanat karta lokovel afrashut kudesha velikovel achsanat karta meruach maarva maarva umeruach madincha madincha veureka lokovel chad min chulekaya mittechum mearva ad techum madincha:

rashi: Avveret. shem davar shel mum ivvaron belashon nekeva — shello yehe vo mum shel ivvaron:
O shavur. lo yihye:
Charutz. ris shel ayin shennisdak o shennifgam vechen sefato shennisdeka o nifgema (bechorot 38):
Yabbelet. veroe belaaz:
Garav. min chazazit vechen yallefet, uleshon yallefet kemo vayyilpot shimshon (Shoftim 16), sheachuza vo ad yom mita, sheen lah refua:
Lo takrivu. shalosh peamim, lehazehir al hakedashatan veal shechitatan veal zerikat daman (temura 6):
Veishshe lo tittenu. azharat haketaratan:
Sheol vaavaddo. lo tisbana millekabbel et harshaim letocham, keshem sheene haadam rasha lo tisbana millashut achar yetzer hara, millemalleot taavato:
targum: Sheyol veavdana la savan veayne degavra la savan:

rashi: Ach bachamishsha asar yom, tachoggu. karban shelamim lachagiga, yachol tidche et hashshabbat, talo ach, hoil veyesh lah tashlumin kol shiva:
Beospechem et tevuat haaretz. sheyyehe chodesh shevii ze ba bizman asifa, mikkan shennitztauu leabber et hashshanim, sheim en haibbur, peamim shehu veemtza hakkayitz o hachoref:
Tachoggu. shalme chagiga:
Shivat yamim. im lo hevi vaze, yavi vaze, yachol yehe mevian kol shiva, talmud lomar vechaggotem oto — yom echad bemashma velo yoter, velamma neemar shiva? letashlumin (chagiga 9):
Oto veet beno. noheg bannekeva — sheasur lishchot haem vehabben o habbat, veeno noheg bazzecharim, umuttar lishchot haav vehabben (sham 78):
Oto veet beno. af beno veoto bemashma (sham 82):
Harimu gerushotechem. salleku et sheattem megarshim et ammi minnachalatam:
targum: Kidnan amar Adonai elohim sagi lechon ravreve yisrael datfa uviza adu vedin dikshot uzechu avidu seliku tiklatchon migo ami amar Adonai elohim:

rashi: Vachalala. shennolda mippesule chehunna (kiddushin 77):

Vaasitem seir izzim. yachol shivat hakkevasim vehassair haamurim kan hem 7 hakkevasim vehassair haamurim bechummash happekudim, kesheatta maggia etzel parim veelim enan hem, emor meatta ellu leatzman veellu leatzman — ellu karvu biglal hallechem veellu lammusafin (sham):

Umin hammikdash lo yetze. eno holech achar hammitta (sanhedrin 18), veod mikkan lamdu rabbotenu shekkohen gadol makriv onen, vechen mashmao: af im metu aviv veimmo eno tzarich latzet min hammikdash ella oved avoda:
Velo yechallel et mikdash. sheeno mechallel bechach et haavoda, shehittir lo hakkatuv, ha kohen hedyot sheavad onen chillel (zevachim 16; sanhedrin 88):
Veal kol nafshot met vegomer. beohel hammet:
Nafshot met. lehavi reviit dam min hammet shemmetamme vaohel (sham):
Leaviv uleimmo lo yittamma. lo va ella lehattir lo met mitzva (sifra; nazir 47):
Ushemartem. zo hammishna:
Vaasitem. ze hammaase (sifra):
Vekiddashto. al karcho, sheim lo ratza legaresh halekehu veyasserehu ad sheyyegaresh (sifra; yevamot 88):
Kadosh yihye lach. nehog bo kedushsha, liftoach rishon bechol davar ulevarech rishon basseuda (horayot 12):
ohc: Vekiddashto. velo amar "vekiddashtem" kasseder hannidbar ad atta bilshon rabbim. ledivrehem zichronam livracha (yevamot pach:) sheazhara zo baa sheim kohen lo ratza legaresh ishsha zona vachalala vegomer, shemmalkin oto umeyasserin oto ad sheyyegaresh. ulefi hattaam shennatan hakkatuv ki et lechem elohecha hu makriv, tavo hassevara lomar ki kol od sheyyesh kohanim shelemim vechen rabbim hammaspikim lehakeriv en chiyyuv lachof, laze amar leshon yachid sheafillu al echad mehem yakpid laasot kammishpat hazze.

Kadosh yihye lach. perush, kede sheyyihye kadosh yihye lecha hakkohen, perush hinne hu shellecha lechofo al haddavar. veamro ki kadosh, perush letzad shekkadma lanu hayyedia ki hakkedushsha hi bechina hanniknet beratzon uvehashlamat hachefetz vehacheshek bah velo bichfiyya, veech omer hakkatuv lechofo al hakkedushsha, laze amar ki kadosh, perush, lo lehameshich lo hakkedushsha mechadash, shekkevar hu kadosh, ella shello leabbed kedushshato. veamro ani Adonai mekaddishchem, noten taam lechiyyuv yisrael bedavar ze, ki beemtzaut kedushshat kohen Adonai baruch hu mashre shechinato betochenu umekaddesh otanu, veim en kohen en avoda veen mikdash veen shochen.

rashi: Sarua. ever gadol mechavero:
Vekalut. parsotav kelutot (bechorot 40):
Nedava taase oto. levedek habbayit:
Uleneder. lammizbeach:
Lo yeratze. e ze hekdesh ba leratztzot? heve omer ze hekdesh hammizbeach (temura 7):
Kammayim. hallalu happanim sheatta mare letochan, hen marot lecha:
Ken lev haadam laadam. chavero, lefi ma sheadam yodea shechavero ohavo, ken hu mare lo panim:
targum: Hech maya vehech partzufe dela damyan chad lechad hechna libbehon divne nasha la damyan chad lechad:

rashi: Lehaniach. apposhir belaaz, kemo "vayyanach bechol gevul mitzrayim" (Shemot 10:14):
targum: Veresh kol bikkure kola vechol afrashut kola mikkol afreshutechon lechahanaya yehe veresh atzvatchon tittenun lechahana leashraa virketa bevetach:

rashi: Lo yifra. lo yegaddel pera al evel, veezehu giddul pera? yoter mishsheloshim yom (sham):

Uveyom boo. techilla el hakkodesh lehitchannech laavoda. yakriv chattato zo asirit haefa shello; kach shenuya bemoed katan (15, 2 – 16, 1), shekkohen hedyot taun asirit haefa beyom chinnucho, keinyan shenneemar "ze karban aharon uvanav vegomer" (Vayikra 6:13), uchemo shemmeforash bemassechet menachot (78, 1):
targum: Uveyom mealeh lekudesha ledarta gavayta leshamasha bekudesha yakriv chatateh amar Adonai elohim:

rashi: Lefalle neder. lehaferish bedibburo:

Sheshet yamim. ma inyan shabbat etzel moadot? lelammedcha shekkol hamechallel et hammoadot maalin alav keillu chillel et hashshabbatot, vechol hamekayyem et hammoadot maalin alav keillu kiyyem et hashshabbatot (sham):
Venokev shem. eno chayyav ad sheyyefaresh et hashshem, velo hamekallel bechinuy (sanhedrin 56):
Venokev. leshon kelala kemo (Bamidbar 23) "ma ekkov" (sanhedrin 56):
Vehenif. kol tenufa molich umevi maale umorid, molich umevi laatzor ruchot raot, maale umorid laatzor telalim raim (menachot 62):
Lirtzonchem. im takrivu kemishpat ze yihye leratzon lachem:
Mimmochorat hashshabbat. mimmochorat yom tov harishon shel pesach, sheim atta omer shabbat bereshit e atta yodea ezehu (sifra; menachot 66):
Zona. shennivala veilat yisrael haasur lah, kegon chayyave karetot o natin o mamzer (sifra; yevamot sefer acher):

Chalala. shennolda min happesulim shebbakkehunna, kegon bat almana mikkohen gadol o vat gerusha (vachalutza) mikkohen hedyot, vechen shennitchallela min hakkehunna al yede viat echad min happesulim lichhunna (80 sifra, kiddushin 77):
Ki im lishero. en sheero ella ishto (sham; yevamot 22):
ohc: Ki im lishero vegomer – tanya betorat kohanim veze leshonam: "sheero" – zo ishto, dichtiv "sheer avicha". "hakkarov" – lemaet arusa, perush letzad sheadayin lo nitkarva. "elav" – lemaet haggerusha, perush karov shennitrachek. yomar "leimmo", ma talmud lomar "leaviv"? ma immo shehi mitchallelet hare hu mittamme lah, aviv sheeno mitchallel eno din sheyyittamma lo? illu chen hayiti omer: ma immo beyadua, af aviv beyadua. aviv chazaka minnayin? talmud lomar "uleaviv", ad kan. hikshu chachme lunel leritz: leolam lo yomar hakkatuv "leaviv" veanu lemedin mikkal vachomer meimmo. ma tomar? hare aviv ze eno yadua keimmo, yittamma mimma nafshach: im ze aviv – mittamme, veim eno aviv, im ken hu mamzer veen lo kehuna, ad kan.

Uveenay eno kushya kelal, ki hakkatuv kan ba lishne devarim: lehattir ulehatzrich. lehattir tuma bakkerovim haggam sheasar barchokim, ulehatzrich – sheim lo ratza littamme metammein oto beal karcho, kemo sheamar hakkatuv "lah yittamma" veamru betorat kohanim "mitzva", shechayyav kol kohen littamme lammetim haamurim bainyan. vahagam shello neemar "lah yittamma" ella baachoto, hare amru betorat kohanim veze leshonam: maase beyosef hakkohen shemmeta ishto beerev pesach velo ratza littamme lah udechafuhu chachamim vetimmeuhu beal karcho, ad kan leshono. hare shellecha lefanecha sheal kol hakkerovim haamurim bainyan hu chayyav littamme. uchefi ze im hayiti dan tumat aviv middin ma nafshach en li makom lechayyevo littamme lo ki yomar mi yomar shehu aviv, uma gam im yamut aviv beerev pesach en levattel mitzvat pesach echad bemoado mechamat safek, velo mibbaya leman deamar (282 uferi chodesh) safek deorayta muttar middeorayta, peshita shello yittamme lidchot mitzvat pesach bemoado, ella afillu leman deamar safek deorayta asur middeorayta af al pi chen en lo lidchot mitzvat vadday mippene mitzvat safek, talmud lomar "leimmo uleaviv" shechayyav littamme lechol echad mehem devar tora. veayyen bappasuk sheachar ze.

Veod nire li, kevan sheyyesh metziut sheaviv en lo ella chazaka, vehabben muchzak bechohen, kegon sheyyesh lefanenu shene bene adam muchzakim bechezkat kohanim kol echad bifne atzmo, gam muchzakim sheechad mehem av veechad beno, umetziut ze yachol lihyot sheyyura chezkat haav sheeno kohen velo yura chezkat habben lahasiro mimmadregat kohen, venomar sheen ze aviv venishar habben bechezkato. vechevan shekken, im lo amar "leaviv" hayiti dan shello yittamma leaviv chazaka baofen hannizkar, mittaam shemma yura chezkat aviv vehabben yishshaer kohen leolam, velaze amar hattanna: aviv chazaka minnayin? talmud lomar "leaviv". vehinne ben lederech ze uven lederech rishon, aviv chazaka chayyav littamme lo, ki sof kol sof aviv eno ella chazaka vehattora chiyyevattu littamme.

Velivno ulevitto uleachiv vegomer. tanya betorat kohanim veze leshonam: yomar "livno ulevitto", ma talmud lomar "leimmo uleaviv"? beno uvitto sheeno chayyav bichvodam hare hu mittamme lahem, aviv veimmo shehu chayyav bichvodam eno din sheyyittamma lahem? illu chen hayiti omer livno ulevitto hannefalim, talmud lomar "leimmo uleaviv" – ma immo veaviv bene kayyama, af beno uvitto bene kayyama, ad kan. kashe, kefi ze lo haya tzarich lomar ella "leimmo velivno" vegomer velo yomar "leaviv". uletaanat ma immo beyadua, beno uvitto yochichu, shemmin hassetam enam beyadua ella chazaka, umittamme lahem. veen lomar sheggarua aviv mibbeno uvitto, shehare matzinu sheddan hattanna kal vachomer mehem leaviv uleimmo, veim ken lamma hutzrach lomar "leaviv"? veim legallot al beno uvitto shehem bene kayyama, lamdinan miyyittur "leimmo" sheen tzarich, shebbaa mikkal vachomer beno uvitto. veen lomar shetztzarich leaviv uleimmo shenehem yachad lemaet beno uvitto hannefalim, ki lamma lo yaspik echad? veod, im tzarich shenehem, ma makom lattanna laasot tzerichutot ben leaviv uleimmo, halo tzerichin shenehem lemaet beno uvitto nefalim, vehaddevarim peshutim.

Venire lomar, sheim lo amar "leaviv" hayiti dan al ze hadderech: ma talmud lomar "leimmo"? beno uvitto sheeno chayyav bichvodam mittamme lahem, immo lo kol shekken? illu chen hayiti dan gam aviv. talmud lomar "leimmo", lemaet aviv mittaam sheeno ella chazaka, vehayinu mitchayyevin lefaresh ki beno uvitto sheamar hakkatuv hem domim leimmo beyadua, uchegon shello haya metziut shettitabber ishto ella mimmennu al yede yedia berura bammetziut sheyyachol lihyot. ma sheen ken achar sheamar hakkatuv "leaviv" vehikshenu lamma hutzrach, veyavo dino meimmo, vehuchrachnu lomar shebba lomar afillu eno ella chazaka, im ken "immo" lamma li? shema minnah lemaet beno uvitto nefalim. vahagam shehattanna amar "leaviv uleimmo" lemaet hannefalim, lav davka, vesamach al ma sheheircha besamuch bidrashat "leaviv" shebba lomar afillu eno ella chazaka.

Ella shekkashe lema sheamru sham betorat kohanim besefa devarayta dilimmo uleaviv", veze leshonam: illu neemar "leaviv" velo neemar "leimmo" vechulei, hayiti omer, ma aviv sheeno mitchallel af immo sheenah mitchallelet, immo shennitchallela minnayin? talmud lomar "leimmo", ad kan. hare shehutzrach "leimmo" lerabbot afillu nitchallela, uminnayin lo lemaet hannefalim? veim tidrosh lannefalim, nitchallela minnayin? veod tzarich ladaat kefi ze, bitto shennitchallela im chayyav littamme lah o lo, sheyyesh panim lomar davka immo shechayyav bichvodah hu shennitrabbet afillu nitchallela, veyesh panim lomar kevan sheggilla kera shehachillul eno pogem hakkureva, hu haddin bitto.

Achen behair bedivre hattanna, minnayin matza lomar sheyyittamma leimmo shennitchallela? im miyyittur, dilma itzterich mishshum shehayiti omer "leaviv" letzad sheyyesh bo maala sheeno mitchallel, ma sheen ken haem sheggerua meerech av letzad shemmitchallelet. uchemo chen dikdek hattanna bitchillat devarav beamro "ma aviv sheeno mitchallel", mashma ki hahefresh yutzrach laasot bo hahadraga hagam sheeno vannimtza ella kevan sherauy lihyot, veim ken nuchal lomar ad atta sheimmo shennitchallela patur milletamme. uvehechreach lomar shehattanna sover ki amro "leimmo" mashmautah hu ben kohenet ben chalala. haemet sheim lo haya omer ella "leaviv" haya levaal din lachlok velomar, immo gerua meaviv gam bihyotah kohenet, kevan sheyyeshnah bechillul, aval achar sheamar "leimmo" afilu nitchallela bemashma. uchemo chen tadun kesheamar hakkatuv "ulevitto" afilu nitchallela bemashma, ki lo tala hakkatuv haddavar ella besibbat hakkureva, veimmo shennitchallela uvitto shennitchallela nikraim immo uvitto. umeatta kevan shebbelo ribbuy anu omrim ki mashmaut "bitto" hu afillu shennitchallela kol shennikret bitto yittamma lah, im ken navo ladin lamma amar "immo", vahalo tavo bekal vachomer mibbitto, uma bitto shennitchallela mittamme lah, immo itzterich?

Achen im lo amar hakkatuv "leimmo", az lo hayinu omrim ki "leaviv" ba lemaet beno uvitto hannefalim, ella lemaet immo. umiut ze karov yoter benishma millelech lechappes achar hannefalim shel beno uvitto lomar shealehem ba, vehayiti memaet immo mittaam shemmitchallelet. ucheshehayinu baim ladun mibbitto shemmitchallelet umittamme lah, hayinu maamidin miut haem keshennitchallela davka, aval lo nitchallela hayta baa mikkal vachomer mibbitto. ucheshennavo ladun bevitto afillu nitchallela mimmashmaut hatteva kemo sheamarnu lemala sheafillu nitchallela tikkare bitto, hayinu chozrim vedanim bitto shennitchallela meimmo shennitchallela, uma immo shennitchallela eno mittamme lah kemo sheddarashnu miyyittur "leaviv", bitto shennitchallela lo chol shekken. vahagam shemmashmaut "bitto" yaggid afillu nitchallela, ze min hassetam, aval kesheyyavo hallimmud bemiut o bekal vachomer nachzor lehaamidah beshello nitchallela.

Haole mikkol hakkatuv beomek hakkatuv hu, sheim lo amar hakkatuv "leaviv" shemmimmennu navo litot shebba lemaet immo kemo shekkatavti, lo haya tzarich lomar "leimmo" vehayta baa mibbeno uvitto kannizkar. veim lo amar "leimmo" shemmimmenna haya ba hattaut lomar shebba lemaet aviv letzad sheeno yadua ella chazaka, lo haya tzarich lomar "leaviv". im ken tikshe lo yomar lo aviv velo immo, laze darshu shebba lemaet hannefalim sheeno mittamme lahem. umeatta en makom lanu lomar sheyyomar o "leimmo" levad o "leaviv" levad, ki echad mehem sheyyomar yolid hattaut veyistor habbinyan. venitchakkem Adonai ledabber divre emet, velaze nitchakkem hattanna vekadam lehodia hattaut hayyotze meim yomar echad mehem, veachar kach darash yittur shenehem yachad, vehaven. uvaze ala divre hattanna leor olam divre elohim chayyim.

rashi: Ki arav zar. adam shennaasa arev, gorem sheamar haddayyan lammalve: kach bigdo! (bava metzia 115.):
targum: Mitnesev martute deman dearev lenucheraa veal appe nucheraya mashkeneh:

rashi: Hammotzi etchem. al menat ken:
Ani Adonai. neeman leshallem sachar (sham):
Venasa cheto. becharet kesheen hateraa:
Al hallechem. biglal hallechem, chova lallechem (sifra; menachot 45):

Uminchatam veniskehem. kemishpat mincha unesachim hameforashim bechol behema befarashat nesachim, shelosha esronim lappar ushene esronim laayil veissaron lakkeves, zo hi hammincha, vehannesachim chatzi hahin lappar ushelishit hahin laayil ureviit hahin lakkeves:
Vehayta lahem. hakkehunna lenachala:
targum: Utehe lehon leachasana chulak motar kurebani chulakhon veachsana la tittenun lehon beyisrael mattenan dihavet lehon inun achasantehon:

rashi: Bechol sheretz asher yitma lo. beshiur harauy letamme — bechaadasha (chagiga 11):
O veadam. bemet:
Asher yitma lo. beshiuro letamme vezehu kazzayit (ohalot 82):
Lechol tumato. lerabbot nogea bezav vezava nidda veyoledet:
Bechol teme nefesh. bemi shennitma vemet:
ohc: Mizzera aharon. hutzrach lehazekiram paam sheniyya, lomar shehem davka hu sheyyeshnam behaarev shemesh, aval kadashim sheochlim yisrael shehem (hashshelamim) [maaser sheni] en tzerichim haarev shemesh, kach darshu betorat kohanim.

Veamro vehu tzarua, darshu betorat kohanim veze leshonam: en li ella zaro, atzmo minnayin? talmud lomar "vehu" vegomer, ad kan. hinne bedin ze i efshar lomar ma shepperashnu befasuk (Vayikra 21:7) "ish mizzaracha", ki Adonai yishmor, letzad sheyyesh kan gam ken "asher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara", veaharon matzinu shello perash meishto, veim lo haya omer "vehu" haya makom lomar sheaharon yochal hakkodashim betuma, talmud lomar "vehu". vechevan shennitrabba aharon nitrabbu gam ken banav, umeatta pasuk rishon sheamar "ish mizzaracha asher yihye vo mum" velo nitrabba aharon, emor meatta sheeno bichlal, vehu mittaam shehu muvtach sheyyishmerehu Adonai lo ulevanav shello yippol bahem mum, uchemo shekkatavti.

rashi: Lechem elohav. maachal elohav, kol seuda keruya lechem, kemo "avad lechem rav" (Daniel Adonai):
ohc: Dabber el aharon lemor. amar "lemor", letzad shehammitzva baa leaharon keamro "dabber el aharon" shehittil alav lehaferish baale mumin mehakkohanim leheyot shehu kohen gadol, laze amar lemor sheyyazhir gam ken kol hakkohanim sheyyomar lahem hammitzva, venimtzeu muzharim hakkohanim al atzman vechohen gadol gam ken muttal alav leval [yiggash] (yazid) ish baal mum.

Ish mizzaracha vegomer. lo amar kasseder sheamar bitchillat happarasha, velo kasseder sheamar bapparasha sheachareha "dabber el aharon veel banav veyinnazru", velo keseder yayin veshechar sheamar "atta uvanecha" (Vayikra 10:9). veulay ki nitkavven Adonai bemetek leshono lomar sheaharon uvanav muvtachim mikkol hammumin haamurim bapparasha, laze lo hizkir lo hu velo banav ella "zaracha". vahagam sheggam banav yikkaru zaracha, af al pi chen mimma sheshshinna heircha ki al habbaim acharehem hu omer. vedikdek gam ken lomar "mizzaracha", hivtichacha shello yippol hammum bechullam ella bemiktzatam, veayyen beferush pasuk "vehu tzarua" (Vayikra 22:4).

rashi: Lirtzonchem tizbachu. techillat zevichatchem hizzaharu shettehe leratzon lachem, umahu haratzon?

Beyom hahu yochal. lo va lehazehir ella shettehe shechita al menat ken — al tishchatuhu al menat leachlo lemachar, sheim tachshevu vo machashevet pesul lo yehe lachem leratzon; davar acher lirtzonchem — ledatechem, mikkan lammitassek sheppasul bishchitat kadashim; veaappi shepperet banneechalim lishne yamim, chazar uferet banneechalin leyom echad shettehe zevichatan al menat leachlan bizmannan:
Vehikravtem ishshe. hammusafin haamurin bechummash happekudim:
Ani Adonai elohechem. elohe chullechem, keshem sheani meyached shemi alechem, kach ani meyachado al haggerim:
ohc: Kagger kaezrach. velo amar hagger kaezrach, sheaz yihye nishma ki madregat ger lematta mimmadregat ezrach, shehakkatan nitle baggadol, laze amar kagger kaezrach perush haezrach kagger vehagger kaezrach sheshshekulim hem bammishpat.

rashi: Hammenora hattehora. shehi zahav tahor; davar acher al tohorah shel menora, shemmetaharah umedashshenah techilla min haefer (80 sifra):

Lo yittamma baal beammav lehechallo. lo yittamma leishto pesula shehu mechullal bah beodah immo, vechen peshuto shel mikra: lo yittamma baal bishero beod shehu betoch ammav — sheyyesh lah kovrin, sheenah met mitzva, uveeze sheer amarti? beoto shehu lehechallo — lehitchallel hu mikkehunnato (80 sifra; yevamot 90):
Vekali. kemach asuy mikkarmel rach shemmeyabbeshin oto battannur:
Vecharmel. hen kelayot, shekkorin garenayyleysh:

Bechol moshvotechem. nechleku vo chachme yishorael, yesh shellamdu mikkan shehechadash noheg bechutza laaretz, veyeo lo va ella lelammed shello nitztauu al hechadash ella leachar yerushsha vishiva, mishshekkibbeshu vechilleku (kiddushin 37):
Ken yinnaten bo. pershu rabbotenu sheeno netinat mum mammash ella tashlume mamon, shamin oto keeved, lechach katuv bo leshon netina — davar hannatun miyyad leyad (bava kamma 84; ketuvot 32):
Venatatta al hammaarechet. al kol achat mishshete hammaarachot; vehayu shene veziche levona melo kometz lechol achat:
Vehayta. hallevona hazzot:

Lallechem leazkara. sheen min hallechem legavoah kelum, ella hallevona nikteret keshemmesallekin oto bechol shabbat veshabbat, vehi lezikkaron lallechem, sheal yadah hu nizkar lemala, kakkometz shehi azkara lammincha (80 sifra):

Uvehappilchem et haaretz benachala. sheatidim lachalok et eretz yisrael lishnem asar retzuot; lo kachaluka harishona shehayta larav kefi minyano velammeat kefi pekudav (Bamidbar 26:54), vehayu shene shevatim o shelosha birtzua achat, achshav hachalakim shavim vekshurot hakkerem, mippeat yam ad peat kadim, kemo shemmeforash besof hassefer (Yechezkel 48):
Teruma laAdonai. livnot bet hammikdash hazze bo:
targum: Uvefalgutehon yat ara veachasana tifreshun afrashuta kodam Adonai kudesha min ara ureka asrin vechamsha alfin ureka ufuteya asra alfin kudesha hu bechol techuma sechor sechor:

rashi: El shaare hechatzer happenimit. lifnay velifnim beyom hakkippurim:
Velo yaale alehem tzemer. techelet shehaya bammeil uvaavnet (Shemot 39:24, 29) lo yilbashennu beyom hakkippurim baavodat penim:
Vavayta. velifnim:
targum: Vihe bemealhon letare darta gavayta levushe vutza yilbeshu vela yehe alehon kesut amar beshamashutehon betare darta gavayta ulegav:

rashi: Delef tored. geshem hannotef min haggag letoch habbayit vetored et bene habbayit:
Beyom sagrir. yom haggeshem, shehakkol nisgarim bevattehem:
Veeshet medinim nishtava. shenehem shavin (yevamot 63:):
targum: Ich dilfa denatef beyoma desagrira hechna itteta tagranuta denatzya:

rashi: Kol ish asher bo mum. lerabbot shear mumin:
Mum bo. beod mumo bo pasul, ha im avar mumo kasher (sifra):
Lechem elohav. kol maachol karuy lechem:
ohc: Kol ish vegomer mizzera aharon vegomer. kefel haazhara hu leyisrael shello yannichu lehakeriv baal mum, velaze lo asa hatztziuuy lenocheach, vehaven:

rashi: Kol ish asher yikrav. en keriva zo ella achila, vechen matzinu shenneemra azharat achilat kadashim betuma bilshon negia, "bechol kodesh lo tigga" (Vayikra 12), azhara laochel, ulemaduha rabbotenu miggezera shava; veiel shechayyav al hannegia, shehare neemar karet al haachila betzav et aharon (Vayikra 7), shete karetot zo etzel zo, veim al hannegia chayyav, lo hutzrach lechayyevo al haachila vechen nidrash betokko: vechi yesh nogea chayyav? im ken ma tal yikrav? mishsheyyichshar likkarev, sheen chayyavim alav mishshum tuma ella ikke karvu mattirav (sifra; zevachim 45): veitto shalosh karetot betumat kohanim lamma, kevar nidreshu bemassechet shevuot (daf 7), achat lichlal veachat lifrat vechulei:

Vetumato alav. vetumat haadam alav, yachol babbasar hakkatuv medabber — vetumato shel basar alav — uvetahor sheachal et hattame hakkatuv medabber, al karchacha mimmashmao atta lamed — bemi shettumato porachat mimmennu hakkatuv medabber, vezehu haadam sheyyesh lo tohora bitvila (sifra):
Venichreta. yachol mitztzad ze letzad ze — yikkaret mimmekomo veyityashshev bemakom acher — tal ani Adonai, bechol makom ani (sham):
ohc: Emor alehem. betorat kohanim amru veze leshonam: "alehem" – ellu haomdim lifne har sinay, ad kan. huksha lahem yittur "emor alehem", im al haamurim besamuch shehem hakkohanim, lo haya tzarich lomar, shealehem hitchil ledabber veze gemar hammitzva shehitchil ledabber bah. veim al yisrael, halo lo huzkeru besamuch laze! amar al haomdim behar sinay, ki sham nizdavvega umma leloheha, uchesheyyedabber setam, haddavar muvan shealehem hu omer. uchefi ze hare onesh ze hu gam leyisrael. veim tomar, im ken lamma bechol hattora mazkir bene yisrael bechol perat uferat velo hispik lomar "dabber alehem"? kevar amru zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 2:5) mashal lemi shehaya lo ben chaviv vetamid zichrono befiv: "echol beni", "shete beni". kemo chen hakkadosh baruch hu, leahavat yisrael arev alav zichronam befiv. uvemakom sheyyesh lidrosh darshinan.

rashi: Kodesh min haaretz. sares et hammikra: motar hakkodesh asher min haaretz hu yihye lakkohanim mesharte hammikdash hakkerevim vego'; kodesh min haaretz hi hatteruma hazzot:

Lakkohanim mesharte hammikdash yihye. haodef al chamesh meot shel har habbayit: shenem asar elef umatayim vachamishshim lammizrach, uchenegdan lammaarav, vehammikdash baemtza, vearbaat alafim usheva meot vachamishshim latztzafon, uchenegdan laddarom:
Vehaya lahem makom levattim. haodef hazze shessaviv hammikdash:
Umikdash lammikdash. vachamesh meot al chamesh meot haemtzaiyyim (Yechezkel 45:2) yihyu mekuddashim letzorech hammikdash, ishiyntigya alshiyntuiyra belaaz:
targum: Kudesha min ara hu lechahanaya di meshamshin bevet makdesha dayya yehe dekarivin leshamasha kodam Adonai vihe lehon atar shevik leveta vechivsha lemakdesha:

rashi: Tzofneha tzafan ruach. mi shessavur leshamrah mitteznuteha, tzefunat ruach hu; keshem shei efshar litzpon haruach, ken hi, lo titztzafene:
Veshemen yemino yikra. kore hu hatztzaraat lavo alav ad sheyyegarshenna, kammetzora hammittaher beshemen bevohen yado hayemanit (Vayikra 14:17):
targum: Rucha garvayta kashya uvishma dimina mitkarya:

rashi: Vehaavadti. lefi shehu omer karet bechol makom veeni yodea ma hu, keshehu omer vehaavadti, limmed al hakkaret sheeno ella avaddon:
Kedoshim yihyu. al karcham yakdishum bet din bechach (sifra):
Vayyikkov. ketargumo "ufaresh", shennakav shem hameyuchad vegiddef, vehu shem hameforash sheshshama missinay (sifra):
Veshem immo shelomit bat divri. shivchan shel yishorael sheppirsemah hakkatuv lezo, lomar shehi levaddah hayta zona:
Shelomit. dahava pitpeta "shelam alach", "shelam alechon", mefatpetet bidvarim, shoelet bishlom hakkol:
Bat divri. dabberanit hayta, medabberet im kol adam, lefichach kilkela:
Lematte dan. maggid sheharasha gorem genay lo, genay leaviv, genay leshivto; kayyotze vo "oholiav ben achisamach lematte dan" (Shemot 31), shevach lo, shevach leaviv, shevach leshivto (sifra):
ohc: Veshem immo. tzarich ladaat lamma lo hizkir shemah bitchilla keshehizkiro ad havaato el moshe, veyesh lomar bishte derachim: haechad lishvach al ze hadderech – vayyaviu oto el moshe veshem immo vegomer, perush, gam hi mikkelal hammeviim. vehaechad lignay – vayyaviu oto el moshe veal yede havaa zo nitchayyeva shehakkatuv yefarsem otah sheimmo hi shelomit, umimmotza davar atta yodea ki nichmeru rachameha al benah, uchetiv (Mishlei 12:10) "verachame reshaim achzari", laze gilla otah hakkatuv ki zot haishsha veze benah. gam hizkir shivtah lehattaam atzmo shekkatavti, ki min hassetam hashshevet yerachem veyaamod leezer hakkerovim, velaze amru bammidrash (Vayikra Rabba 32) genay lo genay leshivto vechulei:

rashi: Verosham lo yegallechu. lehaavir et kol hassear:
Ufera lo yeshallechu. giddul sear lo yarbu:

Kasom yichsemu. kakkussemet hazzo, shessedurin bashshibbolet rosho shel ze letzad ikkaro shel ze; kach shamati mishshemo shel rabbi menachem zatzal. veyittachen lefarsho leshon middat davar hashshave, lo gezizat rosh velo giddul sear, ella bemidda shava; 287 belaaz:
targum: Vereshehon la yegilchun uferua la yirbun sappara yisperun yat sear reshehon:

rashi: Umechir sade. yishvu lecha haattudim, ki tochal habbasar vetimkor haorot:
targum: Imre lilvushach vegadya letagrutach:

rashi: Mikkodshe hakkodashim. ellu kadshe hakkodashim:

Umin hakkodashim yochel. ellu kadashim kallim, veim neemru kadshe hakkodashim lamma neemar kadashim kallim? im lo neemar, hayiti omer bekadshe hakkodashim yochal baal mum, shemmatzinu shehutteru lezar, sheachal moshe besar hammilluim, aval bechaze veshok shel kadashim kallim lo yochal, shello matzinu zar cholek bahen, lechach neemru kadashim kallim, kach meforash bizvachim (daf 101):
Matzref. keli asuy letzaref kesef vehakkur asuy livchon zahav, veish nitzraf umitchashshev lefi mahalalo. al yede shehabberiyyot mehallelot oto bemaasav hattovim, nivchan larabbim, im tov im ra:
targum: Tzarafa lechaspa vechura ledahava vegavra min puma dimshabbechanoy:

rashi: Vehakkohanim haleviyyim. mishshevet levi:
Bene tzadok. lefi shehaya kohen gadol sheshshimmesh rishon bammikdash bime shelomo, nikreu al shemo:
Bitot. kenayinshaarr belaaz:
targum: Vechahanaya levae bene tzadok di netaru yat matrat makdeshi bemite bene yisrael mibbatar pulechani inun yitkarvun lefulechani leshamasha kodamay vishamishun al madbechi lekarava kodamay terav vedam nichsat kudeshin amar Adonai elohim:

rashi: Mikra kodosh. kaddeshehu vichsut nekiyya uvitfilla, uvishar yamim tovim bemaachol uvemishte uvichsut nekiyya uvitfilla (80 sifra):
Yachad pene reehu. yachad talmide chachamim mechaddedin ze laze bahalacha (taanit 7.):
targum: Parzela befarzela latish vegavra latish appeh dechavreh:

rashi: Ki chol ish asher bo mum lo yikrav. eno din sheyyikrav, kemo hakerivehu na lefechatecha (Malachi 1):
Charum. shechatmo shakua ben shete haenayim, shekkochel shete enav keachat (sifra; bechorot 43):
Sarua. sheechad meevarav gadol mechavero — eno achat gedola veeno achat ketanna, o shoko achat arukka mechavertah (sifra; bechorot 40):

Vayyetze ben ishsha yisreelit. mehechan yatza? rabbi levi omer meolamo yatza, rabbi berechya omer mipparasha shellemala yatza, ligleg veamar "beyom hashshabbat yaarchennu" derech hammelech leechol pat chamma vechol yom, shemma pat tzonenet shel tisha yamim, bitmiha? umatnita amara mibbet dino shel moshe yatza, mechuyyav, ba litta oholo vetoch machane dan, amru lo ma tivcha lechan? amar lahem mibbene dan ani, amru lo "ish al diglo veotot levet avotam" ketiv (Bamidbar 2), nichnas levet dino shel moshe veyatza mechuyyav, amad vegiddef (sifra, Vayikra 32):
Ben ish mitzri. hu hammitzri sheharag moshe (sham):
Betoch bene yisrael. melammed shennitgayyer (sifra):
Vayyinnatzu bammachane. al iske hammachane:
Veish hayyisreeli. ze shekkenegdo shemmicha vo mitta oholo:
ohc: Vayyetze ben ishsha vegomer. amar vayyetze al derech amram zichronam livracha (tanchuma) befasuk "vayyetze haegel hazze" sheyyatza belo kavvanat happoel, kemo chen kan lo shennitkavvena haishsha yisreelit lemaase hakkiur ella belo mitkavven lidvar issur yatza hannega, keamram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 1:28) sheheemid hammitzri habbaal laavodato vechazar labbayit veasa maase, vehaishsha chashva ki balah haya veyatza nega ze. velaze timtza shehakkatuv mashve zichron haishsha lezichron haish hayyisreeli, dichtiv haishsha hayyisreelit veish hayyisreeli ki nekiyya haishsha meavon veshava laish hayyisreeli hammuzkar lefanenu sheen bo dofi. veamro betoch bene yisrael lomar shello haya betocham mamzer kayyotze bo.

Od yirtze, shello natnu lo moshav betocham, shebbemakom shehaya rotze lataat oholo haya omer lo "encha mishshellanu", verabbotenu zichronam livracha (torat kohanim) amru shebba lomar hakkatuv shennitgayyer, veellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim.

Veish hayyisreeli. taam shello huzekar shemo, ulay shello ratza lehazekiro mishshum sheal yado haya haddavar shennakav ben hayyisreelit et hashshem, umegalgelin vechulei, veen hakkadosh baruch hu chafetz legannot adam, uma gam battora shennishar haroshem leolam vaed.

Od nitkavven hakkatuv lomar, shemmeriva asher natzu aleha hi al hahefresh hannirsham, shezze hu ben yisreelit veze ben yisreeli, vechan kalal kol ma sheamru zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 32:3) leman deamar al devar yochasin uleman deamar vechulei, velo chash hakkatuv lehaarich lashon velomar gam ken shemo ki en tzorech baddavar.

rashi: Nefesh asher tigga bo. beechad min hattemeim halalu:
Zichron terua. zichron pesuke zichronot ufesuke shofarot (sifra: rosh hashshana 32) lizkor lachem akedat yitzchak shekkarav tachtav ayil:
Veshamru et mishmarti. milleechol teruma betumat hagguf (sanhedrin 83):
Umetu vo. limmedanu shehi mita vide shamayim (sham):
Vehissiu otam. et atzmam yitanu avon beochlam et kodshehem shehuvdelu leshem teruma, vekadshu veneesru alehen; veunkelos shettirgem "bemechalhon besoava", shello letzorech tirgemo chen:

Vehissiu otam. ze echad mishshelosha etim shehaya rabbi yishmael doresh battora shemmedabberim baadam atzmo, vechen "beyom melot yeme nizro yavi oto" (Bamidbar 6) — hu yavi et atzmo, vechen "vayyikbor oto vaggay" (Devarim 34) — hu kavar et atzmo, kach nidrash besifre:
ohc: Vehissiu otam vegomer. perush, keshello yifreu keren vechomesh yagdilu geder haasham sheasu beshogeg likkare mezid shehu avon, kevan sheyyesh beyadam letakken veenam metakkenin. vehu amro vehissiu, perush yenasseu otam, perush hem sheyyihye haddavar avon et sheeno ella ashma. veamro beachlam et kadshehem, perush sheyyechashev lahem mezid achilat hakkodashim sheachlu, lo hazadat meniat happeraon. veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk shellifne ze:

rashi: Bevoam el hechatzer happenimit. el hahechol:
targum: Vachamar la yishtun kol kehan bemealhon ledarta gavayta:

rashi: Ki lo leolam chosen. sheim atta ashir bechesef uvezahav, shemma lo yitkayyem leolam. lechach al tevazze devarim ketannim shellecha:
targum: Metul dela laalam hi achsana af shelam dara ledara:

ohc: Hazze chag hassukkot. betorat kohanim darshu yittur hazze, uferashti habbarayta befarashat metzora (Vayikra 14:7).

rashi: Umakke vehema yeshallemenna. lemala dibber behoreg behema vechan dibber beose vah chabbura:

Umakke adam yumat. afillu lo harago ella asa vo chabbura, shello neemar kan nefesh; uvemakke aviv veimmo dibber hakkatuv, uva lehakkisho lemakke vehema, ma makke vehema mechayyim, af makke aviv mechayyim, perat lemakke leachar mita; lefi shemmatzinu shehamekallelo leachar mita chayyav, hutzrach lomar bammakke sheppatur, uma bivhema bechabbala, sheim en chabbala en tashlumin, af makke aviv eno chayyav ad sheyyaashe vo chabbura (sifra; sanhedrin 84):

targum: Veal falgut dina inun yekumun lemidan bedine reuti yedunun veyat orayti veyat keyami bechol moade yishrun veyat yome shabbaya dili yekadshun:
Demaskir udeneh dela nishma orayta af tzeloteh merachaka hi:
Deshavkin nimosa mishtabbechin berisha veilen denatrin orayta mitgaryan behon dituvun:
Veal meta deenasha la yeol leistaava elahen leav uleem ulevar velivrat leach velaachat dela havat ligvar yistaavun:
Veyat ami yelfun ben kudesha lechola uven mesaava ledachya yehodunun:
Inun yaalun lemikdashi veinun yitkarvun lefatori lecham appaya leshimsha kodamay veyitrun yat matrat memri:

bart: Sede vochim. makom rachok mibbet hakkevarot shemmoshivin sham hammitta shel hammet umitvaadin uvochin sham:

Lo nittaat velo nizraat. beferek kamma demoed katan baggemara, mefaresh demishshum yeush bealim nagu vah, dechevan shekken hu, mityaashim habbealim mimmenna vehave leh kemetzar shehecheziku vo rabbim veasur lekalkelo. vedavka cheshennityaashu habbealim, shehecheziku vo harabbim kaddin. aval lo nityaashu, dehashta shello chaddin hecheziku vo, muttar lekalkelo:
Vaafarah tahor. delo machzekinan bah tuma kelal:
Veosim mimmennu tannurim lakkodesh. ma sheen ken bishne vet happeras harishonim:

Shebbodkim leose fesach. assade shennecherash bah kever kae. deim holech sham adam vetzarich lishchot et pischo, bodkim otah kedimfaresh besefa, veim lo nimtza sham etzem kasseora holech veose et pischo:

Veen bodkin litruma. dedavka lefesach somech abbedika zo, mishshum detumat bet happeras derabbanan, vachachamim lo heemidu divrehem bimkom karet, shemmi sheeno makriv karban pesach bemoado chayyav karet. aval bitruma deen baachilatah ki im ase, heemidu divrehem bimkom ase veen moelet bedika zo lehattiro batteruma:
Ulenazir. shehalach sham:
Bet shammay omrim bodkin. veim lo nimtza sham etzem kasseora eno megalleach:
Uvet hillel omrim en bodkin. deven nimtza uven lo nimtza megalleach umevi karban:
Et heafar shehu yachol lahasito. kegon afar tichoach:
Umemache. osehu dak dak beyado kede sheyyire im yesh bo etzem kasseora:
Kohen gadol. eno yotze achar hammitta. dilma ate leminga mittoch tirdato, verachamana amar (Vayikra 21) veal kol nafshot met lo yavo:

Hen nichsin vehu nigle. kevan shennitkassu nose hammitta min hammavoy, kelomar sheyyatzu mimmennu, hu nigle venichnas betocho. aval kol zeman shehen niglin venirin bammavoy, hu nichse mimmennu, sheeno nichnas letocho:
Veyotze immahen ad petach hair. shebbair metzuyin mevoot veyachol lehitkassot mehen. aval chutz lair lekka hekkera:

Shenneemar umin hammikdash lo yetze. rabbi yehuda daresh umin hammikdash lo yetze chol ikkar. verabbi meir daresh umikkedushshato lo yetze, kelomar yizdehar shello yavo lide magga, uvetoch hair sheyyesh mevoot ikka hekkera umizdehar. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Ucheshehu menachem et acherim. divmet sheeno shello kulle alma modu deyachol hu lelech, delo terid velo ate leminga. ucheshechozrin min hakkevarot veomdin beshura lenachem haavelim vechol haam ovrim ze achar ze umenachamin haavel sheomed bemaamado vechol echad omer lo titnachem min hashshamayim:
Vehamemunne mematztzeo. shehu holech limin kohen gadol vechol haam missemolo, nimtza kohen gadol baemtza:
Hamemunne. hu hassegan, shehu memunne laavod tachat kohen gadol im yeera pesul bechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim:
Anu chapparatcha. banu titkapper atta vaanachnu tachtecha lechol harauy lavo alecha:
Ucheshemmavrin oto. sheavel asur leechol seudda rishona mishshello, ukerovav veohavav maachilin oto:
Mesubbin al haaretz. hen metzerin umitabbelin betzaaro:
Vehu mesev. bechavod al hassafsal:

Haya vo sear lavan. beyom hashshabbat, veim haya roehu haya machlito, uleachar hashshabbat halach lo, hare ze lehakel. veaf al gav dei nammi chalato veshabbat, keshehalach lo achar hashshabbat haya metaharo, mikkol makom haya tzarich lehavi karban kedin metzora muchlat shennitrappa, veachshav patur:
Hayu levanot. i nammi hayu levanot beyom hashshabbat shehaya rauy lehachelito, ulemachar hishchiru, hare ze lehakel:
Achat levana veachat shechora vehishchiru shetehen. kedi nasva, deen kan lehakel, deven kach uven kach tahor. veaggav sefa dilhachmir nakat la, dekatane vehilbinu shetehen:
Arukkot. hayu hassearot beyom hashshabbat kede likrotz bezug, dehaynu shiur tuma, ulemachar nitkatztzeru, hayenu lehakel:
Achat arukka veachat ketzara. kedi nasva, deven kach uven kach tahor. ella aggav sefa dilhachmir nakat la, dekatane veheerichu shetehen:

Nismach hashshechin. lishte searot, leachar hashshabbat, uveshabbat lo haya vo shechin, deillu beshabbat raahu haya machlito mechamat hassearot levanot shebbetoch habbaheret, veachshav leachar hashshabbat shebba hashshechin venismach lishtehen o leachat mehen, enan siman tuma:
Hikkif hashshechin vechulei. o shehikkif hashshechin lishte hassearot levanot:

O leachat mehen o chillekan hashshechin. shebba hashshechin o michyat hashshechin o hammichva o michyat hammichva o habbohak ben sear lesear, kol hane divshabbat lo hayu uleachar shabbat bau, hare ze lehakel:

Hayta vo michya. beshabbat, shehi siman tuma, vehalcha lah leachar hashshabbat. i nammi hayta merubbaat beshabbat, vehaya rauy lehachelito, uleachar hashshabbat naaset agulla o arukka, dehashta enah siman tuma. i nammi hayta mevutztzeret hammichya veshabbat beemtza habbaheret, kemin mivtzar shel ir sheyyoshev beemtza hair, umittoch kach haya rauy lehachelito, uleachar hashshabbat naaset min hatztzad. i nammi hayta veshabbat mechunneset kaadasha bemakom echad, uleachar hashshabbat nitpazzera:
Uva hashshechin venichnas letochah. kelomar beshabbat lo haya sham shechin vehayta hammichya siman tuma, uva hashshechin venichnas letochah:
Hikkifah o chillekah o miatah. kelomar, o shello va hashshechin al kol hannega ella al ketzat hammichya, ufachata mikkaadasha:

Hashshechin umichyat hashshechin hammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak. kol hane ammiatah kayme, shemmiatah hashshechin o michyat hashshechin, dehaynu shennaasa kerum kiklippat hashshum, o hammichva o michyat hammichva, kol hane shebbeshshabbat lo hayu uleachar hashshabbat bau. vechen habbohak shebbeshshabbat hayu mearbaa marot venaasa vohak lemochorato umiet hammichya, dishchin uvohak memaatin michya, kidtanya vetorat kohanim basar chay velo hashshechin, basar chay velo habbohak:
Haya vo fisyon. beshabbat:
Vehalach lo happisyon. leachar hashshabbat, dema sheppasa veshabbat kanas lemochorato:
O shehalcha haom. ikkar hannega nikra om. vehalcha haom venishar happisyon, o shennitmaata haom veen ben shenehem kaggeris:

Hashshechin umichyat hashshechin. kelomar, i nammi beshabbat pasa velo haya mafsik beshabbat ben haom lappisyon lo shechin velo michyat hashshechin velo michva velo michyat hammichva velo vohak, uleachar hashshabbat hifsik echad meellu, hare ze lehakel:
Keoder uchemosek. derech haoder mefassek raglav. vederech hammosek magbiah zerootav. oder, chofer bakkarka. mosek, loket et zetav:
Keorechet. et happat, shemmefasseket et ragleha:
Uchemenika et benah. leinyan tachat haddad. dema shennire veotah shaa eno nechshav bet hassetarim:
Keoreget beomdim lashshechi. shemmagbahat yadah hayemanit leerog umegalla vet hashshechi shellah:

Ketova vefishtan. shedderech hattova lehagebiah yadah hassemalit umegalla hashshechi hassemali. uma sheeno nire vechach, nechshav bet hassetarim. uchetiv lechol mare ene hakkohen, perat levet hassetarim:
