Letiglachto. beyom tohorato. vetzarich legalleach, dichtiv (Vayikra 14) et rosho veet zekano veet gabbot enav, ma ellu mekom kinnus sear venire, af kol mekom kinnus sear venire, perat levet hassetarim:
En potchin lo challonot. dichtiv (Vayikra 14) kenega nira li, li velo leneri, mikkan amru bayit afel en potchin lo challonot:

Birakrak uvaadamdam. ha dekare vivgadim uvevattim siman tuma yerakrak vaadamdam, velo kare leel siman tuma learbaa marot shebbeor basar, mishshum dearbaa marot shebbeor basar afillu omdim bo chamma shanim enan machlitim belo sear lavan uvelo fisyon uvelo michya, aval bivgadim kesheamad hayerakrak o adamdam shene shavuot af al gav delo fasa, ketiv baesh tisrefennu, lehachi kare lehu vivgadim siman tuma. vechen bevattim shelosha shavuot keshechazar hannega lichmot shehaya o mirakrak laadamdam o meadamdam lirakrak, ketiv (Vayikra 14) venatatz et habbayit, keillu fasa, lehachi kare lehu siman tuma:
Leachar happetur. kegon shekkeha, im chazar achare chen, soref:
Lemilchemet harshut. milchemet shear ummot chutz mimmilchemet amalek umilchemet shiva amamin:
Uforetz. gader shel acherim:
Laasot lo derech. lalechet lecharmo ulesadehu:
Veen memachin beyado. en meakkevin alav:
Chelek barosh. chelek hayyafe borer rishon. venotel mechetza mikkol habbizza:
Ella shemone esre. shehare david hayu lo shesh nashim vekaamar leh navi veim meat veosifa lecha kahenna vechahenna, kahenna kamma shit, batra shit, hare shemone esre:

Marbe hu lo. yoter mishshemone esre. veshalosh machalokot yesh baddavar. tanna kamma savar nose shemone esre vaafillu ferutzot, veyoter mishshemone esre lo yissa vaafillu chesherot, shekkach hu gezerat hakkatuv. rabbi yehuda savar nose shemone esre vaafillu ferutzot, veyoter mishshemone esre ferutzot lo yissa, uchesherot vahagunot yissa chemo sheyyirtze. ufaleg attanna kamma bachada. rabbi shimon savar afillu achat perutza lo yissa, uchesherot vahagunot lo yissa yoter mishshemone esre. ufaleg attanna kamma bachada veadderabbi yehuda betarte. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Ella chede merkavto. davka susim betelim leharechiv dato ulehitgaddel berov susim [asur]. aval kede richbo ufarashav lehillachem beoyvav muttar:
Afsanya. sechar chelot hannichnasim veyotzim immo chol hashshana:

Vechotev lo sefer tora lishmo. chutz missefer tora shechayyav kol adam miyyisrael lihyot lo sefer tora, vehu munnach bevet genazav. vesefer tora shekkotev lishmo cheshehu melech nichnas veyotze immo tamid:
Mesev. al hashshulchan:
Mi shennimchak shetar chovo. veyesh edim sherau keshennimchak meatzmo o nittashtesh al yede mayim:
Maamid alav edim. sheyyodim meematay nichtav ume haya katuv bo, vehen osin lo kiyyum bifne bet din vechotvin lo kol ma shehaya katuv beoto shetar:
Yachalif. yikra oto shetar veyichtevu lo acher kefi hacheshbon hannishar:
Nimtza ze. hallove tzarich lishmor shovro min haachbarim, sheim yovad, yigbe hammalve et kol chovo:

Amar rabbi yose vechen yafe lo. lammalve, sheyyehe hallove tzarich lishmor shovro vimaher lifroa lo, velo yera kocho shel malve lichtov shetar acher, shehaya zeman chovo mukdam veyashuv atta meuchar velo yuchal litrof lakochot ella mizzeman hashshetar hashsheni. vahalacha kerabbi yose shekkotvin shover:
Dine mamonot. dehaynu hodaot vehalevaot:

Bishlosha. hedyotot. velo atzrechuhu rabbanan lishlosha mumchin, shello tinol delet bifne lovin, shemma yichpor hallove velo yimtza mumchin lechofo laddin ella yachid mumche o shelosha hedyotot. aval gezelot vachavalot bishlosha mumchin, delohim ketiv befarashat shomrim bevelle hammishpatim shalosh peamim. uminna yalfinan shelosha mumchin:
Nezek. adam o shor hammuad shehizziku, dimshallemim nezek shalem:

Chatzi nezek. shor tam shehizzik. veaf al gav dehaynu chavalot, ayde devae lemitne tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha sheeno meshallem kemo ma shehizzik, shemmeshallem yoter, tana nammi chatzi nezek sheeno meshallem kemo shehizzik, shehare meshallem pachot. veayde detana chatzi nezek tana nammi nezek:
Vehammotzi shem ra. lo matzati levittecha betulim veanshu oto mea chesef:
Dine nefashot. deim emet haya haddavar vezinneta tachtav usekaluha. vedine nefashot beesrim ushelosha kedilkamman. vahalacha kachachamim:

Hashshechin vehammichva mittammein beshavua echad. dishar negaim yesh lahen shene hesgerot, veellu im lo fasa veshavua rishon velo nolad sear lavan, potro. uleshon mittammein denakat, hachi kaamar, keshebbau ellu shene simanim besof shavua echad, tame, ha lo vau, tahor:
En ovsin. [en] maachilin oto al karcho vetochavim lo bigrono, uferush ovsin, osin lah evus betoch meeha:
Velo dorsim. sheddores hammaachol letoch geronah. umihu lo have kemo ovsin:
Aval malitim. shettochev lo hammaachol lemakom sheyyachol lehachezir:
En memarin. mefattemin, leshon vechelev meriim (yeshaya 1). uferush hameraa, shettochev lo hammaachol lifnim mibbet habbelia bemakom sheeno yachol lehachezir:
Umehalketin lattarnegolin. shettochev hammaachol letoch piv bemakom sheyyachol lehachezir:
Aval lo govlin. en lashin oto bammayim:
En notnin mayim lifne devorim. sheen mezonotehen alav, sheyyotzin veochlin bassade umayim metzuyin lahem baagammim:
Dorsiot. yonim sheggedelim babbattim. venikraim dorsiot al shem hordus hammelech shehaya megaddel mehen bearmono:
Baheret. germani. lavan beyoter. uvaheret azza chashsheleg niret bo cheha mittoch lavnunit yetera shebbivsaro, ufotrin oto:
Vehakkeha. niret bakkushi azza. mittoch shebbesaro shachor. umasgirin oto, devatar besaro shel nire azlinan:

Bene yisrael ani chapparatan. mittoch chibbatan haya omer ani chapparatan. kelomar kol haonesh sherauy lavo alehen ani mekabbel al atzmi kede lechapper alehen. shehen benonim umemutztzaim veenam notim leachat mishshete hakketzavot:

Lo levanim velo shechorim. ella cheeshkeroa, sheeno lo lavan velo shachor. eshkeroa, min shel erez, 314 belaaz. targum teashshur, eshkeroa. veka savar rabbi yishmael devamme shemmittaher haechad mittaharim kullam, uvamme shemmittamme haechad mittammein kullam. vekayme rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva bachada shitata:
Tzayyarim. ummanin shemmetzayyerin tzurot lenoy:
Kabbenoni. kassam habbenoni:

Marot negaim lehakel. vetaama derabbi yehuda mefaresh betorat kohanim, katuv echad omer beor besaro, vechatuv echad omer beor habbasar, matzinu shemmarot negaim lehakel aval lo lehachemir, ketzad, yerae germoni vivsaro lehakel nimtzeta mekayyem veor besaro. veet hakkushi kabbenoni lehakel nimtzeta mekayyem beor habbasar:
Ze vaze kabbenoni. germoni vechushi kabbenoni, vehayenu rabbi akiva:

Hammelech lo dan velo danin oto. vedavka malche yisrael sheenam nishmaim ledivre chachamim. aval melech mimmalche vet david, dan vedanin oto, shenneemar (yirmeya ka) bet david ko amar Adonai‏ dinu labboker mishpat:
En shomin lo. demelech shemmachal al kevodo en kevodo machul, ugenay hu lo shettachlotz veyarka befanav. vechol sheenah bat chalitza enah bat yibbum. vechen halacha:
Melech nose almanato shel melech. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda beha:
Sachin. beshemen:
Umedichin. bemayim. ufokkin nekavav, sotmin nekavav haelyonim vehattachtonim beveged o beshum davar kede shello tikkanes bahem haruach veyitpach:

Uvilvad shello yaziz bo ever. shello yetaltel veyagbiah lo yado velo raglo velo rise enav, sheasur letaltel hammet o ever meavarav, af al pi shemmuttar ligga bo. vechen kol muktze muttar bingia veasur betiltul. uvetza shennolda beshabbat o beyom tov asura afillu bingia, shemmippene kadduritah negiatah zehu tiltulah:
Veshomtim et hakkar mittachtav. venimtza muttal al hachol, aval lo metaltelin lehanicho al hachol, deha tana resha uvilvad shello yaziz bo ever:
Bishvil sheyyamtin. shello yasriach mechamat chom hassedinim vehakkarim:
Koshrim et hallechi. shel met shehaya piv holech veniftach:
Velo sheyyaale. lehissager ma shenniftach, dehaynu meziz ever, ella shello yosif lehippatach:
Somchim otah besafsal. shehare torat keli alav:
Velo shettaale. dahava leh bone:
En meammetzin. et enav beshabbat afillu leachar yetziat nefesh, dahava leh meziz ever:
Shofech damim. shebbedavar muat mekarev mitato:

Mavoy. sheeno rachav shesh esre amma, af al pi shehu patuach mishshene rashav lirshut harabbim, i nammi rachav shesh esre amma veeno mefullash ella rosho echad patuach lirshut harabbim verosho echad satum. umin hattora share letaltole beh belo shum tikkun, verabbanan hu degazur aleh dilma ate letaltole birshut harabbim gamur, vesharyu betakkanta delechi o kora deteheve leh hekkera. veim heniach et hakkora lemala meesrim amma yemaet, kelomar yashpil et hakkora ad shettihye lematta meesrim, dilmala meesrim lo shalta bah ena. veim yesh bekora [zo] amaltera, perush tziyyurim ufittuchim, afillu lemala meesrim amma eno tzarich lemaet, sheal yede otam hatztziyyurim shalta bah ena:

Rabbi yehuda omer eno tzarich. detaama dekora lav mishshum hekkera ella mishshum mechitztza, deamrinan pi tikra yored vesotem, vechevan shekken hu ma li betoch esrim ma li lemala meesrim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Veharachav meeser ammot yemaet. ditfe meeser ammot lo mikkere petach ella pirtza, vaanan petach bainan, hilkach yemaet rochav kenisato veyaamidennu al eser o al pachot:

Veim yesh lo tzurat happetach. bechol makom sheamru chachamim tzurat petach hu afillu kane mikkan vekane mikkan gevohim asara tefachim o yoter vekane al gabbehen, veaf al pi sheeno nogea bahen, veaf al pi sheggavoah mehen yoter mishshelosha tefachim. vechol haammot hashshenuyot bemishna zo uvechol eruvin vesukka vechilayim, hem amma bat shishsha tefachim, vechol tefach arba etzbaot beguddal, ella sheppeamim tzarich limdod betefach atzev, kelomar shello yasim revach beetzbeot hagguddal ben zo lezo ella yihyu metzumtzamot venogot zo bezo, ufeamim tzarich litten revach ben guddal leguddal shello yihyu nogim ze baze, vezehu hannikra tefach sochek. ketzad, bizman shehammedida betefach atzev hi lechumra, kegon mavoy shehu gavoah meesrim amma yemaet, vesukka shehi gevoha meesrim amma pesula, moddim betefach atzev. uvizman shehammedida betefach sochek hu lechumra, kegon mavoy en gavho pachot measara tefachim, sukka en gavhah pachot measara tefachim, moddin betefach sochek, vechen leolam:
Eno yotze mippetach palterin shello. sheggenay hu lammelech lehareot agmat nefesh lifne haam:
Lefayyes et haam. kede sheyyakkiru shello vaatzat david harag yoav et avner. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Dargash. mitta:

Kach lecha avadim. sheyyechammemu lecha hammerchatz. dichmo shehinnichah avinu ken tihye leolam. veaf al gav deit lan beferek kamma divmide delet bah din chalukka yachol lememar god o egod, kelomar mechor li chelkecha o ani emkor lecha chelki, shane hacha, sheen heani yachol lomar egod, sheen lo bamme liknot:
Enan yecholin lehotzi shetar chov ze al ze. dechol echad mehem yachol liton ze hashshetar shebbeyadcha ani hechezarti lecha keshepparata li hammaot shehilviticha:
Velo acher yachol lehotzi shetar chov alehem. dechol echad matze maddeche leh legabbe chavreh:
Yeshalleshu. yichtov shem avi aviv:
Veim hayu meshullashim. sheshshemotan ushemot avotehen vaavot avotehen shavin:
Yichtevu siman. peloni, shehu gichor o aroch o gutz. veim hen shavin bassimanin, yichtevu kohen. im echad kohen veechad yisrael:
Nimtza. lelove echad sham shene shetarot mishshete halevaot shellava mimmennu:
Hakkatan eno farua. dishtar echad ben shetarotav kaamar, velo shenayim:
Lo yippara min hearev. techilla, ad sheyyitba et hallove laddin vichayyevu oto bet din, veim en lo ma leshallem az yippara min hearev:

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer im yesh nechasim lallove. lo yippara min hearev. lav mikkelal detanna kamma savar afillu im yesh nechasim lallove yippara min hearev, ella matnitin chasure michassera vehachi katane, hammalve et chavero al yede arev lo yippara min hearev, veim amar al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze, yippara min hearev. bamme devarim amurim, kesheen nechasim lallove, aval yesh nechasim lallove lo yippara min hearev. vekabbelan, af al pi sheyyesh nechasim lallove yippara min hakkabbelan. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, echad arev veechad kabbelan, im yesh nechasim lallove lo yippara mehen. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. arev, hu sheomer ten lo vaani arev. kabbelan, hu sheomer ten lo vaani noten lecha:

Hearev laishsha bichtubbatah. veen labbaal nechasim, vetzarich hearev lifroa ketubbatah, lo yifra hakketubba ad sheyyaddirenna habbaal techilla hanaa al daat rabbim, neder sheen lo hattara, shello yuchal lehachazir otah, dechayshinan shemma dato lehachazirah veleechol ketubbatah leachar shettigbenna min hearev. uleinyan dina, arev dichtubba lo mishtabed veeno chayyav lifroa, vaafillu en lo nechasim labbaal. may tama, demitzva avad velav mide chisserah. vei arev ketubbata divreh hu, mishtabed, deabba legabbeh bereh shabode shabed nafsheh. vekabbelan dichtubba mishtabed, vichola haishsha shettitba mimmennu techilla, vaafillu yesh lo nechasim labbaal. vehu sheyyaddirenna habbaal hanaa techilla al daat rabbim:
Neeman alay abba. lihyot dayyan, af al pi shehu fasul min hattora leduneni lo lizchut velo lechova, kidnafka lan millo yumetu avot al banim:
Neemanim alay shelosha roe vakar. ladun. deillu leedut, roe vakar kesherim hen:
Rabbi meir omer yachol lachazor bo. afillu leachar gemar din, leachar shekkibbel haddayyan haedut veamar ish peloni atta zakkay:

Eno yachol lachazor bo. leachar gemar din bilvad hu diflige rabbanan aleh derabbi meir. deillu kodem gemar din modim chachamim lerabbi meir deyachol lachazor bo. veim kanu miyyado nammi shemmekabbel alav edut ish peloni o dino shel ish peloni, afillu kodem gemar din eno yachol lachazor bo, sheen leachar kinyan kelum. vechen halacha:

Dor li vechayye roshcha. nedor li vechayye roshcha veetten lecha ma sheatta tovea. veen tzarich lomar umachul lecha ma sheyyesh li etzlecha. venadar lo o kanu miyyado af al pi sheadayin lo nadar, eno yachol lachazor bo, kedivre chachamim. vechen halacha:

Umeayyemin alehem. modiim otam shehassochrim ede sheker hen atzman mevazzin otan vekorim lahen reshaim, dichtiv benavot (Melachim 1 21), vehoshivu shenayim anashim bene veliyyaal negdo, sheyyoatze hammelech shehayu yoatzim lesachran korim lahen bene veliyyaal:
Hu amar li. hallove amar li:
Lo amar kelum. daavid eynish deamar peloni noshe vi, kede shello yachazikuhu ashir:
Hoda lo. shehayu shenehem befanenu, ulehodot lo nitkavven, lihyot lo edim baddavar:

Afillu shenayim mezakkin o mechayyevim veechad omer eni yodea yosifu dayyanim. veaf al gav dei hava faleg alayhu hava vatel bemiuto, ki amar eni yodea have chemo shello yashav baddin, nimtza haddin bishnayim vaanan shelosha bainan:
Vehishlish et shetaro. hammalve vehallove masru hashshetar beyad shalish. shettorach haya lahem lichtov shover vesamchu al hashshalish:

Rabbi yose omer yitten. disvira leh asmachta kanya. hammavtiach lachavero davar al menat sheyyaase lo davar leatid vesomech belibbo bishat hattenay sheyyuchal lekayyem ucheshehiggia hazzeman eno yachol lekayyem, zo keruya asmachta, uledivre rabbi yose kanya. uleinyan pesak halacha, asmachta lo kanya, ella im ken kanu miyyado bevet din chashuv, vehitpis zechuyyotav beoto bet din shemmasar shetarotav ureayotav, veamar i lo atina mikkan vead sheloshim yom libbatlan zechuyyotay. verabbotay mefarshim shekkol bet din shebbekiim veyodim bedine asmachta nikraim bet din chashuv leinyan ze. aval harambam omer sheen bet din chashuv ella bet din hassamuch beeretz yisrael:
Rabbi yose oser. dechayshinan shemma tamut velo have gevoha asara velo yahev addateh vesamich ala:

Umetamme mishshum golel. im asaan golel lekever, metamme leolam im naga bo adam vechelim, keohel hammet, afillu nittal mishsham, dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) vechol asher yigga al pene hassade, vedarshinan lerabbot golel vedofek. golel hu kissuy hakkever:
Verabbi meir metaher. taama derabbi meir mishshum dekasavar kol mechitztza haomedet beruach chayyim enah mechitztza. veenah halacha:

Verabbi yose haggelili fosel. dichtiv (Devarim 24) vechatav lah sefer, ma sefer en bo ruach chayyim, af kol sheen bo ruach chayyim. verabbanan i ketiv vechatav lah bassefer kidkaamart, hasheta dichtiv vechatav lah sefer, lesippur devarim hu deata. vahalacha ketanna kamma. [veim katav] lah get bekeren shel para venatan lah et happara, dehashta eno tzarich ketzitza leachar shennichtav, kasher. aval im lo natan lah et happara ella et hakkeren, kevan shetztzarich ketzitza, lo miggarsha beh:
Rechava kede lekabbel ariach. shettehe reuya livnot aleha binyan likviut:
Vehaariach chatzi levena shel shelosha tefachim. nimtza ariach tefach umechetza rochav:

Dayya lakkora berochav tefach. hachi kaamar, kevan shehakkora rechava tefach, oto chatzi tefach hannotar, shehaariach rachav tefach umechetza, yachol limroach betit etzba mikkan veetzba mikkan, veal yede chen tihye rechava lekabbel ariach, vehachi mefaresh la baggemara:
Hamehallech bevet happeras. besade shennecherash bah kever:

Al avanim shehu yachol lahasitan. kegon al gabbe avanim sheenan tekuot ukevuot baaretz vehen nissatot mechamat haover alehen, veetzem kasseora nissat mikkocho. verochev al gabbe adam o behema [shekkochan] ra veholichuhu alehen, tame harochev, dechevan dechoach hattachton ra, mechamat massa haelyon nissetu vehave keillu hu mesit haetzem. aval im haya koach hannirkav yafe, la chashiv harochev kemesit haetzem. vehechi dame adam shekkocho ra, kol sherochvo vearkubbotav nokshot. uvehema shekkochah ra, kol sherochvah umattila gelalim:
Beharim uvasselaim. af al pi sheen kovrin sham met:
Tame. mippene afar eretz haammim shemmitgalgel sham:

Bayyam uvashshunit tahor. mittumat gushah. sheggazru al gushah shel eretz haammim lisrof teruma vekadashim shennagu baafarah veen sorfim teruma vekadashim shebbau vayyam uvashshunit, sheen kovrim sham met, aval tumat avirah shel eretz haammim yesh bahen, sheggazru al avirah litlot, shetteruma vekadashim shennichnesu laavir eretz haammim velo nagu vegushah, lo ochlin velo sorfin:
Bezapo. keshehayyam holech vesoer:
Hakkone sade vesureya. aram naharayim vaaram tzova shekkavash david. vaafarah tame kechutza laaretz, vechayyevet bammaasrot uvashsheviit keeretz yisrael:
Im yachol lehikkanes lah betohora. sheen eretz haammim mafsik ben otah sade shekkana leeretz yisrael:

Tehora. otah sade. vaafillu aggushah dida lo gazru, kevan shehi shel yisrael, demishshum hachi katane hakkone sade. aval im haya rochav tefach meeretz haammim o mibbet hakkevarot mafsik ben eretz yisrael lassade shekkana vesureya, dehashta en yachol likkanes bah betohora, afarah shel otah sade tame kechutza laaretz:
Medorot haggoyim. shebbeeretz yisrael:
Temeim. shekkovrin niflehen bevattehen:
Arbaim yom. keshiur yetzirat havvalad:
Af al pi sheen immo ishsha. denachrim perutzim baarayot umeviin nashim levattehen ballayla:
Eved. shel yisrael:
O ishsha. yisreelit:
Meshammerin. hammador shel hannachrim, shello yikberu sham:
Notnin lo shivat yeme hammishte. dichtiv uveyom heraot bo, mikkedi lichtuv rachamana uveheraot, may uveyom, lomar lach yesh yom sheatta roe veyesh yom shei atta roe:

Ze borer lo echad. echad mehabbaale dinin borer lo dayyan echad leduno ulehappech bizchuto, vechen hashsheni borer lo dayyan echad. ushene habbaale dinim beyachad borrim lahem od dayyan shelishi, umittoch kach yetze din emet laamitto, detzayte vaale dinim dina veamre kusheta ka dayne lan, desavar hachayyav hare ani veatzmi bararti haechad veim haya yachol lehappech bizchuti haya mehappech. vehaddayyan hashshelishi beatzmo noach lo lehappech bizchut shenehem, mippene sheshshenehem barru oto:
Vachachamim omrim shene haddayyanim borrim lahem echad. belo daat habbaale dinim. kede shello yihye libbo shel ze hashshelishi note etzel echad mehen. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ze posel dayyano shel ze. yachol hu lomar lo adun lifne vet din shebbararta:
Bizman shemmevi alehen reaya. shezze mevi reaya al dayyan shebbarar ze, lefaslo:

Aval im hem kesherim umumchim. hachi kaamar, aval im hayu chesherim sheenan lo kerovim velo fesulim, af al pi shehem yoshve keranot naasu chemumchin veeno yachol lefaslan. ufesak hahalacha vaze, keshekkibbelu vaale haddin mi sheyyadin lahem ben yachid ben rabbim, ufasak alehem et haddin, dino din veen sotrin dino veaf al pi sheeno mumche larabbim. veim noda shettaa, im bidvar mishna taa o vedavar hameforash baggemara, machazirim haddavar keshehaya vedanin bo chahalacha. veim i efshar lehachazir, kegon shehalach ze shennatal hammamon shello chaddin limdinat hayyam, patur haddayyan milleshallem meachar shekkibbeluhu alehem, sheaf al pi sheggaram lehazzik, lo nitkavven lehazzik. veim taa veshikkul haddaat, vehu vedavar shennechleku vo tannaim o amoraim o geonim, vesugeya dealma chechad minnayhu vedan ze haddayyan kedivre oto haggaon sheen sugeyat haolam kemoto, im lo nasa venatan bayyad yachazor haddin, veim i efshar lehachazir yeshallem mibbeto, veim nasa venatan bayyad, ma sheasa asuy vishallem mibbeto. vedayyan shello kibbelu oto vaale haddin ella sheamad meelav o minna oto hammelech o ketzat zikne hakkahal heemiduhu, im eno mumche larabbim, af al pi shennatal reshut merosh haggola, en dinav din, ben taa ben lo taa, veeno vichlal haddayyanin ella vichlal baale zeroa, vechol echad mibbaale dinin im ratza soter dino vechozer vedan bifne vet din. veim taa velo nasa venatan bayyad yachazir haddin, veim i efshar lehachazir yeshallem mibbeto kedin kol gorem lehazzik, veim nasa venatan bayyad yeshallem mibbeto vechozer venotel mibbaal din ze shennatan lo shello chahalacha. umumche larabbim shekkibbelu oto vaale dinim o shennatal reshut merosh gola af al pi shello kibbelu oto vaale dinim, hoil vehu mumche, im taa ben bidvar mishna ben beshikkul haddaat vei efshar lehachazir haddin, patur milleshallem. umumche shennatal reshut merosh gola yesh lo lachof levaale haddin sheyyadunu lefanav, ben ratzu ben lo ratzu, ben baaretz ben bechutz laaretz. umi shennatal reshut min hannasi shebbeeretz yisrael eno yachol lachof levaale haddin ella veeretz yisrael bilvad. umumche hu mi shellamad battora shebbichtav veshebbeal pe veyodea lisbor lehakkish ulehavin davar mittoch davar [hu hannikra mumche]. ucheshehu nikkar veyadua veyatza tivo el anshe doro, nikra mumche larabbim, vehu yachol ladun yechidi vaafillu lo nakat reshut merosh haggola:

Ze posel edav shel ze. pelugetayhu derabbi meir verabbanan moke la baggemara, kesheamar baal din yesh li shete chitte edim baddavar, vehevi chat rishona, veamad baal din shekkenegdo im acher veamar pesulin hen. rabbi meir omer yachol hu im acher lefaslan, velav nogea baedut hu shehare amar yesh li chat acheret. veim bikkesh velo matza, yafsid. verabbanan savre af al gav deamar techilla yesh li shete chitte edim yachol lachazor velomar en li ella ellu, venimtza ze shebba lefaslan nogea baedut hu, velo mippasle appumeh. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ohole arviyyim. enan kevuim bemakom echad, umishshum delo kevie lo kavre veh. i nammi, lefi shennosim vechonim mimmakom lemakom lo ratzu lehachazik tuma:
Vehassukkot. shel shomre perot:
Vehatztzerifim. medorot sheen lahem gag, ella haddefanot nogot berashehen zo lazo. vedirot shel tzaar hen velo kevie:
Burganin. sukkot asuyot bassade lehachenis bahen perot mippene haggeshamim:
Alketiyyot. gag omed al arbaa ammudim lehitkarer bo vakkayitz, sheharuach menashshevet bo mikkol tzedadav. uleshon alketiyyot, batte hakkayitz, targum kayitz, kayta:
Mekom hachitztzim. makom shebbene hair mannichin bo chitztzim lishmor leet milchama:
Mekom ligyonot. shechonim bo chelot shel melech:
Hammalve et chavero bishtar. af al pi sheen katuv bo acharayut nechasim gove minnechasim meshubadim, dekayma lan acharayut taut sofer hu im lo ketavo bishtar, vahare hu keillu nichtav:
Hotzi alav ketav yado shehu chayyav lo. veen sham edut acher:
Gove minnechasim bene chorin. velo mimmeshubadim. dechevan deen bo edim let leh kala velo yade beh lakochot ki hechi delizdaharu:
Achar chittum shetarot. achar shechatmu haedim bishtar, katav ani peloni bar peloni arev:
Gove. min hearev, mibbene chorin bilvad. dechevan delo chatime sahade al haarvut haveya lah milva al pe:

Amar lo ben nannas vechulei. dekasavar kol arev sheachar mattan maot lo have arev, shello al emunat hearev vehavetachato hilvahu. veaf al pi shekkilles rabbi yishmael et ben nannas, halacha kerabbi yishmael. vearev dilachar mattan maot bae kinyan, vei lo lo mishtabed. veshellifne mattan maot lo bae kinyan:
Letoch habbor. sheen bo mayim:
Sheyyehe shamur. shello yasriach mechamat hachom. veha ka mashma lan delo chayshinan dilma ate leashvoye gummot shebbekarkait habbor kede sheyyehe shave lehoshiv sham hakkedera:
Veet hammayim hayyafim. haruyim lishtiyya:

Baraim. betoch mikve mayim raim sheenan reuyin lishtiyya. umilleta difshita hi, umishshum sefa nakat la, ditnan veet hatztzonnim [bachamma] bishvil sheyyechamu, mahu detema nigzor dilma ate leatmone baremetz, ka mashma lan:
Mi shennashru chelav. shennaflu bammayim beshabbat:
Mehallech immahen veeno choshesh. shemma yachshedu oto shekkibbesan:
Higgia lechatzer hachitzona. hassemucha limvo hair, shehu makom hammishtammer:
Shotchan bachamma. leyabbeshan:

Aval lo cheneged haam. sheyyachsheduhu shekkibbesan. umishna zo dechuya hi, shehalacha beyadenu kol davar sheasru chachamim mippene marit haayin afillu bechadre chadarim asur, hilkach asur leshatchan afillu shello keneged haam:
Pashut shekkatuv bo ed echad. hachi kaamar, keshem sheppashut shekkatuv bo ed echad pasul middeorayta, kach mekushshar shekkatuv bo shene edim pasul middeorayta:
En lo ella esrim. veaf al gav dezuzim mea, chamishsha veesrim selaim hem, yad baal hashshetar al hattachtona. vehachi mefarshinan leh lishtara, mea zuzim geruim, sheenam shavin ella esrim selaim:
En lo ella mane. esrim vachamishsha selaim. dehachi mefarshinan lishtara, mea zuzin deinnun telatin selaim kallim ugeruim, shehem esrim vachamishsha min hattovim:
Venimchak. shennimchak hamminyan shennichtav acharav:
Umillematta matayim. keshekkofel et devarav bashshetar:
Hakkol holech achar hattachton. uvilvad shello yihye katuv beshita acharona:
Lamma chotvin et haelyon. hoil uvesof hashshetar chozer vechofel, veacharayut mamon ze kach vechach kibbalti alay:
Veellu hen happesulim. ladun ulehaid:

Hamesachek bekuvya. pasul leedut lefi sheeno mitassek beyishshuvo shel olam, veasur leadam sheyyitassek beolamo ella o vetora ugemilut chasadim, o vischora veummanut umelacha sheyyesh bahen yishshuvo shel olam:
Vehammalve veribbit. echad hallove veechad hammalve shenehem pesulin, dekayma lan hammalve vehallove shenehem ovrim belo taase:

Umafriche yonim. it dimfarshe min mimmine hassechok, im takdim yonatcha leyonati etten lecha kach vechach. veit dimfarshe shemmegaddel yona melummedet lehavi yonim levet bealeha beal karchan. veyesh bahen gazel mippene darche shalom, velo gazel gamur:
Vesochare sheviit. osin sechora beferot sheviit. vehattora amra (Vayikra 25) vehayta shabbat haaretz lachem leachla, velo lischora:

Rabbi shimon omer vechulei. baggemara mefaresh milleteh derabbi shimon hachi, battechilla hayu korim otam osfe sheviit, kelomar osfe ferot sheviit leatzman hayu fesulim leedut kemo sochare ferot sheviit:

Mishsherabbu haannasin. hashshoalin menat hammelech kach vechach korin tevua vechol shana, vehayu tzerichin leesof tevua shel sheviit lifroa mimmenna menat hammelech, chazru lomar sochare ferot sheviit bilvad hem pesulim, aval osfe tevuat sheviit latet lammelech kesherim leedut, kevan sheen osfim leetzor leatzman. uleinyan pesak halacha, kol mi sheavar avera shechayyav aleha mitat bet din o charet o malkot, pasul leedut. dimchuyyav mita nikra rasha, dichtiv (Bamidbar la) asher hu rasha lamut, uvechayyave malkot ketiv (Devarim 25) vehaya im bin hakkot harasha, vehattora amra (Shemot 23) al tashet yadcha im rasha lihyot ed chamas, vedarshinan al tashet rasha ed. veim laka chazar lehechshero, dichtiv venikla achicha leenecha, kevan shellaka hare hu cheachicha. veim lakach mamon shello chaddin, af al pi sheeno chayyav beh lo mita velo malkot, pasul leedut, kegon gannav vegazlan umalve veribbit. veim lakach mamon sheyyesh bo issur derabbanan, pasul leedut midderabbanan, kegon mafriche yonim, vechamsan deyahev deme velokeach hachefetz sheen habbealim rotzim lemachro, vehaggabbaim vehammochsim shellokchim leatzman, umekabbele tzedaka min hannachrim befarhesya, ellu vechayyotze vahen pesulin leedut midderabbanan, veen edutan betela ad sheyyachrizu alehem vifarsemu otan. aval pesule edut shel tora en tzerichin hacheraza. vechol happesulin leedut, ben shel tora ben shel divrehem, im noda meinyanam sheasu teshuva gemura vehammamon shellakchu shello chaddin hecheziruhu veasu seyag vegader leatzman beoto davar shechatu vo shello yosifu laasoto od, hare ellu chazru lehechsheran. umesachek bekuvya af al pi sheen baze gazel afillu middivrehem, hem pesulim leedut, lefi sheen mitassekin beyishshuvo shel olam veen bahem yirat shamayim. vedavka sheen lahem melacha veummanut ella hi, kedivre rabbi yehuda, vechen halacha. veematay chazaratan, mishsheyyeshabberu faspassehen vikabbelu alehem daafillu vechinnam lo avde:
Veharagta et haishsha veet habbehema. hayenu rovea. veittakkash leishsha, ma ishsha beesrim ushelosha af behema beesrim ushelosha:
Veomer veet habbehema taharogu. benirba ketiv. lamadnu rovea venirba:
Kemitat habbealim. kelomar kemo shehaya habbaal niddon beesrim ushelosha, im haya chayyav mita:
Kol hakkodem lehargan zacha. keshehemitu et haadam. veen tzarich lahaviam levet din:

Rabbi akiva omer vechulei. baggemara mefaresh deikka ben tanna kamma lerabbi akiva, nachash. diltanna kamma nachash mitato beesrim ushelosha, ulerabbi akiva hazzeev vehaari vehaddov vehannamer vehabbardelas mitatan beesrim ushelosha, aval nachash, hakkodem lehargo zacha, shessillek hammazzik min haolam. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Kotvin get laish. vechotmin, vehu yegaresh matay sheyyirtze, veaf al pi sheen ishto immo, shehare hi mitgareshet beal karchah:
Veshover laishsha. shehi osa levaalah al ketubbatah, dechov hu lah uzechut levaalah, vezachin laadam shello befanav:

Uvilvad sheyyehe makkiran. sheyyehe hassofer vehaedim makkirin haish vehaishsha, ben beget ben beshover. sheim eno makkiran, shemma yichtov get al shem eshet ish acher sheshshemo kishmo vetotzi oto hagget ishsha sheenah megoreshet bo. vechen beshover:
Vehallo noten sachar. vaafillu hi iska defalga milva ufalga pikkadon, afillu hachi mekabbel haiska hu noten kol hassachar lassofer:
Happatuch shebbashsheleg. hameorav beloven veodem shebbabbaheret haazza chashsheleg, nire keyayin hammazug besheleg, shellavnunito merubba veadmimut shebbo muat:

Vehappatuch shebbesid hahechol. vehameorav shebbannega shehu chesid hahechol, nire kedam hammazug bechalav, sheadmimut shebbo merubba. veaf al gav delo tane fatuch ella bevaheret vetoladtah, hu haddin deyesh patuch nammi viset vetoladtah, detanya vetorat kohanim, seet levana, melammed shemmetammea chalaka. baheret levana adamdamet, melammed shemmetammea fatuch. minnayin litten et haamur shel ze vaze, talmud lomar nega tzaraat:
Shebbaze veshebbaze. shebbashsheleg veshebbassid:
Deha. chasera min halloven, sheenah tzacha velavnunit kemotah. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Lechayayim sheamru. lechayayim shennechleku bahen rabbi eliezer vachachamim, dilrabbi eliezer tarte bainan ulerabbanan chada, zehu shiuran:
Gavhan asara tefachim. keshiur gova hammavoy, deen gavho pachot measara tefachim. vaafillu haya hammavoy gavoah harebe, dayyo belechi gavoah asara tefachim:
Verabbi yose omer rachban shelosha. devae davar chashuv bimchitztza. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Hayu machnisin otan. levaale dinin. shelleachar sheshshamu taanotehen hayu motziin otan lachutz kede sheyyisu veyittenu vaddavar velo yishmeu habbaale dinim mi mechayyev umi mezakke:
Mefirin. baal leishto veav levitto:
Venishalin. lechacham:

Shehen letzorech hashshabbat. kegon shennadar shello yochal hayyom. veannishalin davka kae, deillu baal o av mefer ben nedarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat ben nedarim sheenan letzorech hashshabbat, kevan sheeno yachol lehafer ella beyom shamo bilvad. unedarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat afillu haya lo penay lehishshael alehem kodem hashshabbat nishalin alehem beshabbat:
Ufokkin et hammaor. hachallon shemmimmennu haora nichneset, sotmin oto beluach o bishar kol davar shergilim listom bo:

Umoddin et hammatlit. kegon im hayta temea venaga betohorot, moddin otah im yesh bah shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot leda im nitmeu hattohorot im lav, dematlit pechuta mishshalosh al shalosh enah lo mittammea velo metammea:
Veet hammikve. leda im yesh bah amma al amma berum shalosh ammot. sheellu medidot shel mitzva hen, lefichach muttar limdod otan beshabbat:
Sheppakku et hammaor. et hachallon. vekaruy maor, shemmimmennu haora nichneset:
Betafiach. pach shel cheres:
Mekeda. keli cheres:
Begemi. lehachi nakat gemi, sherauy lemaachal behema velo mevattel leh lihyot kesher shel keyama:

Leda im yesh baggigit poteach tefach. kemin shevil katan haya ben shene battim shello haya mekure, ella sheggigit munnachat al gabbo, vehayu challonot petuchot min habbattim el hashshevil, vehayu choshshin shemma yamut met bevayit echad utehe hattuma ba min hachallon el hashshevil umin hashshevil el habbayit haacher derech hachallon happatuach, lefichach pakku et hachallon happatuach labbayit shehattuma betocho betafiach shel cheres vegabbo letzad hashshevil, ucheli cheres eno mittamme miggabbo, vechotzetz, ki chashshu shemma en besedek haggigit poteach tefach venimtzet haggigit maahelet al hashshevil vehattuma baa derech hashshevil mibbayit ze levayit ze. achar kach hutzrechu liftoach hachallon velittol oto tafiach happakuk bachallon, uvau leda im yesh beoto sedek shel gigit poteach tefach veen sham ohel beoto shevil lehavi et hattuma, shehattuma yotza min hashshevil derech sedek shebbaggigit kelappe mala. o en bassedek shel gigit poteach tefach, venimtzet hashshevil keohel umevia et hattuma mibbayit levayit. umaddu mekeda shel cheres ukesharuha begemi vehoshituha kelappe mala, lirot im haya besedek haggigit poteach tefach im lav:
Ketzad metaharin bet happeras. abbet happeras harishon kae, shehu sade shennecherash bo kever:
Notlin mimmennu shelosha tefachim. keshiur omek hammacharesha shemmegalgelet haatzamot:
Rabbi shimon omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Harotzef. leshon ritzpa shel avanim:
Tahor. kevan deen yachol lahasitan. sheim haya mehallech al gabban venissatot, ikka lemechash ahesset etzem shettachtehen:
Af haozek. hachofer umashlich haavanim, im asa chen bechol bet happeras, tahor. ozek, leshon vayazzekehu vaysakkelehu (yeshaya 5). veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Marot negaim shenayim. ketive vakkera vehedya seet uvaheret:

Shehen arbaa. yesh lecha lerabbot od shenayim acherim delo ketive vakkera, vehen tolada diset vetolada devaheret. dimrabbinan lehu missappachat, sheen sappachat shem nega ella leshon tefela, vechen hu omer (Shmuel 1 2) sefacheni na el achat hakkehunnot, vehittil hakkatuv sappachat ben seet levaheret, lomar lach sheyyesh tolada lasseet veyesh tolada labbaheret:
Baheret azza chashsheleg. levana veyoter. dichtiv (Vayikra 13) veim baheret levana hi, hi levana veen lemala mimmenna levana:

Seet kikrum betza. desavar hay tanna en seet ella leshon gova. vechen hu omer (yeshaya 2) veal kol haggevaot hannissaot. veen lecha chehe velavnunit bechol arbaa marot kikrum betza, lefichach hu gavoah yoter mikkullan, kemare tzel gavoah min hachamma:

Sheniyya lah ketzemer lavan. vehu az belavnunito yoter missid hahechol shehi tolada devaheret. mishshum deamar kera seet levana, leinyan may karya rachamana levana, al karchach letoladtah, shehi levana yoter mittolada devaheret:

Seet ketzemer lavan. rabbanan savre, shene marot azzot shehen sheleg vetzemer lavan, hen lishne avot baheret useet, ushene marot kehot mehen shehen sid hahechol ukerum betza, vehen toladot. ten tolada gedola laggadol, dehaynu sid hahechol labbaheret shehu av gadol, vetolada ketanna lakkatan, dehaynu kerum betza lasseet shehu katan mibbaheret. venafka minna biflugetayhu derabbanan vetanna kamma leinyan tzeruf, dachatzi geris meav vachatzi geris mittolada dideh mitztarfin, vechen shene haavot seet uvaheret mitztarfin, dedarshinan vehaya veor besaro lenega, melammed shemmitztarfin ze im ze, middichtiv vehaya velo chetiv vehayu, asa chol hannegaim echad. aval shete hattoladot en mitztarfot, detolada devaheret enah mitztarefet im tolada diset, delo kae vehaya ella asseet uvaheret dichtive vehedya, velo attoladot deatu meribbuya. vehasheta, letanna kamma sheleg ukerum betza mitztarfin, sheleg vetzemer lavan en mitztarfin. ulerabbanan, sheleg vetzemer mitztarfin, sheleg ukerum en mitztarfin. vahalacha kachachamim:
Tzemer lavan. tzemer naki shel keves ben yomo leachar sherchatzuhu venitlabben:
Makkot. malkot arbaim:
Bishlosha. dichtiv (Devarim 25) veniggeshu el hammishpat ushefatum, shenayim, veen bet din shakul mosifin alehem od echad, hare chan shelosha:

Rabbi yishmael omer beesrim ushelosha. atya rasha rasha, ketiv hacha (sham) vehirshiu et harasha, uchetiv hatam (Bamidbar la) asher hu rasha lamut. ma lehallan beesrim ushelosha, af kan beesrim ushelosha:
Ibbur hachodesh. kiddush hachodesh. veayde devae lemitne ibbur shana tana nammi ibbur hachodesh:

Bishlosha matchilin. lirot im yesh lehoshiv bet din al kach. im echad mehashshelosha omer tzarich bet din leshev uleayyen im tzericha shana leabber, mippene hattekufa vehaaviv vehapperot, ushenayim omrim en tzarich, sheen kan safek, devadday enah tzericha ibbur, batel yachid bemiuto. shenayim omrim leshev veechad omer shello leshev, holchin achar hashshenayim, umosifin od shenayim acherim sheyyisu veyittenu vaddavar, vahare chan chamishsha. shenayim omrim tzarich leabber ushelosha omrim en tzarich, batlu shenayim bemiutan. shenayim omrim enah tzericha ushelosha omrim tzericha, holchim achar harov, umosifin od shenayim sheyyihyu shiva umeabberin otah. uvaggemara mefaresh dehane shelosha chamishsha veshiva keneged birkat kohanim, sheyyesh befasuk rishon shalosh tevot, uvashsheni chamesh, uvashshelishi sheva. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:

En roin et hannegaim bashshacharit uven haarbayim vechulei. deyalfinan mikkera dichtiv lechol mare ene hakkohen, ma kohen shechaser meor enav eno roe et hannegaim, af yom shechaser meoro en roin bo et hannegaim:
Rabbi yehuda omer bearba bechamesh kulei. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Shoel. uvilvad shello yomar haleveni. dehalvaa lizman merubbe mashma, vekayma lan setam halevaa sheloshim yom, hilkach ate malve lichtov al pinkaso kach vechach hilveti lifloni, kede shello yishkach:
Manniach tallito etzlo. im eno maamino velokeach oto umakdisho beshabbat, dechovot shekkavua lahen zeman yecholin lehakedish beshabbat:
Beria lekabbel ariach. chazaka lisbol koved haariach shello tishshaver. vechen halacha:
Sachin. shemen beshabbat:
Umemashmeshin. bayyad al kol hagguf lahanaa:
Aval lo mitammelin. leshafshef bechoach:
Velo mitgardin. bemigredet, vedome lo (Iyov 2) vayyikkach lo cheres lehitgared bo, mishshum dahave keuvda dechol:

En yordin lefolima. bika melea mayim vetachteha tit kemo devek, veyesh bah mekomot sheyyitba harochetz sham beoto tit veyidbak bo, veeno yachol laalot ad sheyyitkabbetzu bene adam veyaaluhu bekoshi gadol uvedochak. perush acher, bika shettit shellah machlik veharochetz sham nofel uvegadav nishshorim bammayim, veate lide sechita:

Appiktevizin. lehaki. uferusho appik tevi zayen, kelomar lehotzi hammazon mimmekom bishshulo shehi haitztomcha. appik, motzi. tevi, mitbashshel, tzeli esh metargeminan tevi nur. zayen, mazon. vedavka lishtot mashke shemmevio lehaki hu sheasur beshabbat, aval lehachenis etzbao letoch piv kede lehaki muttar. vehecha deit leh tzara veim yaki yitrappe, muttar afillu al yede mashke:

Veen meatztzevin et hakkatan. letakkeno uleyashshev atzmotav vechuleyot shidrato, mishshum demechaze kevone. velo amaran ella leachar zeman, aval beyom leda share. meatztzevin, leshon yadecha itztzevuni vayyaasuni (sham 10):
Veen machazirin et hashshever. etzem shennishbar. veen halacha kemishna zo, ella halacha machazirin et hashshever beshabbat:
Shennifreka yado. sheyyatza haetzem min happerek shello:
Lo yitrefem. leshon betzim terufot bakkeara, shemmishtattef [betzonen] al mekom hashshever, demechaze delirfua kaaved:
Shover adam et hechavit. mippene shehu mekalkel:
Uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot keli. laasot lah pe nae:
En nokvim megufa. haddevuka befi chavit, ella notel et kullah, dechi nakiv la metakken pitcha hu:
Rabbi yose mattir. deen derech petach chavit bechach. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Velo yikkevenna mitztziddah. kelomar ha deshare rabbi yose lihyot nokev et hammegufa, lo share ella lemala berosh hammegufa, delav orcha lemeavad pitcha hatam ella notel kol hammegufa. aval mitztziddah, zimnin deaved leh lannekev betzad hammegufa mishshum pitcha veeno rotze lefatchah lemala, shello yippelu tzerorot o afar bayyayin:
Memareach. veyesh kan mishshum memachek:
Baarav. shem makom:
Choshshani lo mechattat. im merach hashshaava ledabbekah bedafne hakkeli seviv hannekev:
Have reaya. shetar zechut:
Hare ze eno chelum. shehare amar en li. vechayshinan shemma ziyyef o sachar ede sheker:
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel vechulei. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:

Kirvu peloni ufeloni vehaiduni. beha afillu rabban shimon ben gamliel mode. dechevan shehaya yodea bahen veamar en li, vadday shakran hu. aval hattoen yesh li edim o reaya vimdinat hayyam, en shomin lo leannot haddin ad sheyyishlach limdinat hayyam, ella foskin et haddin kefi ma sheroin mimmennu achshav, uchesheyyavi edim o reaya soter et haddin vechozrim vedanim kefi haedim o haraya shehevi:
Afundato. chagorato. veit dimfarshe malbush hassamuch livsaro:
Venistappeg. vekinneach:

Afillu veeser alunetiyyot. sedinim shemmekannechim bahen, venistappeg bahen ze achar ze, af al gav delo nefishe mayya bechol chad vachad, afillu hachi lo yeviem beyado letoch beto, afillu al yede eruv, sheen kan issur hotzaa ella gezera shemma yishkach veyischatem bevoo:

Aval asara bene adam. hoil umerubbin hem madkeri ahadade. vaafillu chada alunetit laasara bene adam, dehashta nefishe bah mayya, afillu hachi meviin otah beyadam velo gazrinan shemma yischatuha hoil umerubbim hen:
Penehem yedehem veraglehem. orcha demilleta nakat, vehu haddin lechol gufan. veen halacha kemishna zo, ella afillu echad mevi beyado alunetit shennistappeg bah, velo chayshinan shemma yischot:
Hakkarachat vehaggabbachat. lekamman beferek 10‏ mefaresh ezo hi karachat veezo hi gabbachat:
Bemichya uvefisyon. aval besear lavan en mittammein, lefi sheen sear tzomeach bahen:
Hakkol mittammein. vaafillu katan. demahu detema ish tzarua ketiv (Vayikra 13), ka mashma lan adam ki yihye veor besaro ketiv (sham):
Hakkol kesherim lirot et hannegaim. veaf al pi sheeno vaki vahen uvishmotehen, im chacham immo, roe. aval beno leven atzmo im eno vaki vahen uvishmotehen eno roe et hannegaim:
Shehattuma vehattohora veyad kohen. chacham yisrael roe et hannegaim veomer lakkohen, af al pi shehu shote, emor tame, emor tahor:
Ben beish echad ben bishne anashim. shennoldu shene negaim beish echad o bishne anashim, en hakkohen roe otan bevat achat, sheen hakkohen yachol lirot yafe shene negaim keechad:
Umasgiro. i var hesger hu, kegon al yede arbaa marot:
Umachlito. im rauy lehachelit, kegon al yede sear lavan o michya:
Ufotro. im hu lematta mearbaa marot:
Vechozer lashsheni. meachar shennolad hashsheni kodem shehisgir et harishon o shehechlito:

En masgirim et hammusgar. vechen nammi en machlitin et hammusgar. deim hisgiro venega echad veachar kach nolad lo nega acher sherauy lehasegiro o lehachelito, en nizkak lo. vechi mittasse min harishon en al hannega hashsheni lo torat musgar velo torat muchlat, ad sheyyizzakek lo:

Aval battechilla besof shavua masgir umasgir. im bitchillat hashshavua nolad hashsheni kodem shehisgir et harishon, masgir al harishon umasgir al hashsheni. vechen besof shavua rishon im amad harishon beenav, masgiro vechozer umasgir al hashsheni:
Machlit umachlit. machlit al harishon vechozer umachlit al hashsheni:
Masgir ufoter. masgir al harishon ufoter al hashsheni:
Machlit ufoter. machlit al harishon ufoter al hashsheni. vehu haddin ippecha, masgir umachlit, o machlit umasgir, poter umasgir, poter umachlit:
Shetare arisut. hayyored lekarka leavdah uleshamrah lemechetza lishlish velirvia:
Kabbelanut. bechach vechach korin leshana, ben asta ben lo asta:
Shetare verurin. ze borer lo echad sheyyadun lo veze borer lo echad, vechotvin bichtav, peloni berer dayyan peloni vetaanotav kach vechach, kede shello yihyu chozrim vetoanim:

Kotvim shenayim. lechol echad mibbaale dinim shetar bifne atzmo sheyyihyu taanotav sedurim bo. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, ella bishtar echad kotvin teanot shel shene baale dinim, vesheppeloni berer peloni dayyan sheyyadun lo ufeloni berer peloni dayyan acher sheyyadun lo:
Itztabba. asuya lenoy lifne habbattim. veen kovrim sham nefalim:
Ir goyim shecharva. are eretz yisrael sheddaru bah nachrim vecharva min hannachrim:
En bahen mishshum medor goyim. shechayyot metzuyot sham umotziot kol hannefalim shennikberu sham. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Kevarot. kelomar yadua shehem kevarot:
Haya safek. im meeretz haammim im meeretz yisrael:
Vetiharuhu. dachashavuhu cheeretz yisrael. i nammi, haya safek im hayu sham kevarot im lav, vetiharuhu sheheidu sheen sham kevarot:
Keni. shem makom vehayu nohagim bo tuma missafek, ad shennimnu alav rabbi uvet dino vetiharuhu:
Velo yihyu feratzot yeterot al habbinyan. vaafillu hen peratzot ketannot pechutot meeser, im happarutz merubbe al haomed enah mechitztza, veaf keneged haomed asur:
Kol pirtza shehi cheeser ammot mutteret. uvilvad sheyyehe haomed rav aleha, i nammi parutz keomed have mechitztza veaf keneged happarutz muttar:

Yater mikkan asur. afillu pirtza achat yoter meeser oseret kol hahekkef, vaafillu haomed merubbe, delo avde eynashe petach yoter meeser vehave pirtza. vedavka deen lah tzurat petach, aval it la tzurat petach afillu yoter meeser have petach:
Lefakkeach al iske challa. leayyen velachkor betzarche hakkalla:
Chalilin. kele niggun chalulin shekkolan meorer habbechi:
Lo yispod bahen yisrael. kenasa hu mishshum demuchecha milleta shebbishvil yisrael huveu:
Ella im ken bau mimmakom karov. ella im ken noda lanu beverur shebbau mimmakom shebbetoch hattechum velo heviam michutz lattechum:
Aron. leatzmo sheyyikbor bo nachri, o limkor:
Nismach hashshechin. beshabbat:
Lishtehen. lishte hassearot, dehashta lo havu siman tuma, sheen sear lavan siman tuma ella cheshehu vannega atzmo, lo vetoch hashshechin o betoch hammichva:
O hikkif hashshechin vechulei. deim raahu veshabbat lo haya machlito:

Vehalchu lahen. leachar hashshabbat, shennaasa mekom hashshechin vehammichva tzalleket, vahare hu cheor basar, venishar or habbasar im hannega kevattechilla, veim sear hallavan, umachlito, hare ze lehachemir:
Cholkin ben haom lappisyon. shehayu mafsikin beshabbat ben ikkar hannega lappisyon:
Vehalchu lahen. leachar hashshabbat, veen sham davar hammafsik, hare ellu lehachemir:
Mattah al tziddah. matte hechavit al tziddah im tzarich littol min hayyayin, vehaeven nofelet, velo yittol otah bayyadayim:
Hayta ven hechaviyyot. umityare shello tippol haeven al hechaviyyot vetishberem, magbihah lechavit kullah umesallekah mibben hechaviyyot, vesham matte otah al tziddah:

Noer et hakkar vehen noflot. keshehu tzarich lakkar veeno tzarich limkom hakkar, aval im tzarich limkomo magbiah hakkar im hammaot shealav. velo amaran ella kesheshshachach hammaot al hakkar meerev shabbat, aval henichan sham bemitkavven naasa hakkar basis ledavar haasur veasur letaltelo velo lenaer hammaot shealav:
Lashleshet. davar shel tinnuf kegon rok o rei o tzoa:
Mekannechah bismartut. velo yitten aleha mayim, distam kar shel beged hu, uveged sheriyyato bammayim zehu kibbuso:
Hayta. al kar:
Shel or. delav bar kibbus hu:
Noten aleha mayim. ad shettichle vetelech hallashleshet. aval kibbus mammash lo, dehoil usetam karim uchesatot rakkim ninhu shayyach behu kibbus beorot rakkim, umihu sheriyyatan lo zehu kibbusan:
Matztzilin mezon shalosh seudot. vaafillu bechelim harebe, deillu bichli echad amru beferek kol kitve dechamma devae matztzil:
Lachem. kol echad mezon shalosh seudot:

Uvilvad shello yispog. shello yasim sefog lishov hayyayin velachzor ulehattif, veaf al pi sheyyesh lassefog bet achiza, delekka chashash sechita, shello yaase kederech shehu ose bachol. vaafillu likkach beyado shemen udevash shehen avim venidbakim ulekanneach yado bisfat hakkeli asur, shello yaase kemaase chol:
En sochatin et happerot. dahava leh mefarek tolada dedash:
Asurin. gezera shemma yischot lechattechilla:
Rabbi yehuda omer im loochalin. hayu otan perot mechunnasim, hayyotze mehen muttar, delo nicha leh bema shezzavu velekka lemigzar behu shemma yischot:

Veim lemashkin. hayu mechunnasin, denicha leh bemay denafak minnayhu, hayyotze mehen asur, gezera shemma yischot. uvezetim vaanavim mode rabbi yehuda lachachamim deaf al gav dechinnesan loochalim hayyotze mehen asur, kevan dedarkan lischita kayme, ki atu lide mashke yahev dateh behachi. uvishar mine perot modim chachamim lerabbi yehuda, kevan delav darkan lischita. lo nechleku ella betutim verimmonim, derabbi yehuda medamme lehu lishar perot vachachamim medammu lehu lezetim vaanavim. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Challot devash. keshehen merussakim zav haddevash meatzmo mittoch hashshaava veen derech lesachto, hilkach rabbi eliezer mattir, vachachamim osrim, gazru attu sheen merussakin. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:

Semichat zekenim. al rosh par helem davar shel tzibbur. veyesh bemashmaut haddevarim gam minnuy haddayyan, shehaggadol hassomech tzarich sheyyetzaref immo shenayim kesherotze lismoch chacham kede sheyyikkare rabbi veyadun dine kenasot. uleshon semicha, mishshum dichtiv (Bamidbar 27) vayyismoch et yadav alav. velav devae mismach yedeh aleh, ella vishma karu leh rabbi. veen semicha vechutza laaretz, ella tzarich shehassomech vehannismach yihyu chullan beeretz yisrael, veaz yihye lo reshut ladun dine kenasot vaafillu vechutz laaretz, lefi shessanhedrin noheget ben baaretz ben bechutz laaretz, achar shennismechu vaaretz. vechatav harambam shennire lo shebbazzeman hazze sheen lanu samuch ish mippi ish ad moshe rabbenu, im hayu maskimim kol hachachamim shebbeeretz yisrael lismoch yachid o rabbim, hare ellu semuchim vicholim ladun dine kenasot veyesh lahen lismoch laacherim. vehaddavar tzarich hechrea:
Vaarifat haegla bishlosha. dichtiv (Vayikra 4) zikne haeda, miut zikne shenayim, veen bet din shakul, hosef alehem od echad hare shelosha:
Verabbi yehuda omer bachamishsha. vesamchu, shenayim. zikne, shenayim. veen bet din shakul, hosef alehem od echad, hare chamishsha. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Mitzvat chalitza bishlosha. dichtiv (Devarim 25) veniggesha yevimto elav leene hazzekenim, zekenim, shenayim. veen bet din shakul, hosef alehem od echad, hare shelosha. ushenayim acherim shemmosifim eno ella lefirsume milleta:
Meunin. ketanna yetoma shehissiuha immah veacheha ledatah veyotza vemeun shemmemaenet bevalah, tzarich sheyyihye vishlosha. uvivamot muchach demeun bifne shenayim maspik:
Neta revai. im ba lechallelo al hammaot, vechen maaser sheni, veen demehen yeduim. kegon perot vehirkivu sheen lahem shaar yadua:
Hahekdeshot. habba lifdotan tzarich shelosha leshuman:
Haarachin hammittaltelin. hare sheamar erech peloni alay, veen lo maot litten kefi haddamim hakketzuvim bapparasha, uva litten mittaltelin, tzarich shelosha lashum otan mittaltelim:
Echad mehen kohen. devaarachin kohen ketiv (Vayikra 27) keerkecha hakkohen:
Vehakkarkaot. veim en lo mittaltelin uva litten karka, tzarich sheyyashumu asara anashim veechad mehen kohen otah karka sheyyihye kefi haerech sheyyesh alav litten:
Veadam kayyotze vahen. veim amar deme feloni alay, sheshshamin oto kamma hu yafe limmacher bashshuk venoten damav, tzarich gam ken sheyyihyu asara veechad mehen kohen beshuma zo:
Or habbasar. shennira vo echad mearbaa marot:

Battechilla. keshehuva el hakkohen belo hesger, mittamme vesear lavan uvemichya. aval befisyon eno mittamme ad sof shavua rishon, o sof shavua sheni, uleachar happetur desof shavua sheni kesheamad beenav ufetaro, im achare chen pasa chozer vecholto:
Shelosha asar yom. deyom shevii shel shavua rishon ole lechan ulechan:
Shushevino. reehu vime chuppato, pasul lo kol yeme hachuppa:

Lo nechshedu yisrael al kach. lehaid sheker mishshum eva veahava. vechen halacha. vedavka veedut pelige rabbanan aleh. aval bedin modu rabbanan defasul lo ladun, dei rachem leh eno roe lo chova, vei sane leh lo matze leappoche vizchuta:

Pekie amir. kashshin shel shibbolim sheagadan, mattirin otan, dechol zeman shehen keshurin lav ochla ninhu, umattirin otan lishavvinhu ochla, aval pispus, lefazzeran kederech shergilin lefazzer asavim lifne behema kede shettariach rechan veyihyu yafin lah leachlan, asur bifkie amir, demeachar deitavidu ochla behetter happekiin, vehappispus eno ella letaanug bealma, umitrach bedavar shehu kevar ochel lo tarchinan:
Umefaspesim et hakkefim. anafim lachim shel erez, mefazzerim veshotchim otan lifne habbehema shettariach rechan, divlav pispus lo havu ochla:

Aval lo et hazzerin. hen hen pekie amir, ella shehappekiin yesh lahen shene kesharim, echad beroshan veechad besofan, vehazzerin yesh lahen shelosha kesharim, kesher echad yater beemtzaan. vekaamra matnitin sheen mefaspesim et hazzerin veaf al pi shehen dechukim ze baze umitchammemim vehabbehema katza bahen, ella mattir shelosha agadehen bilvad, dehattarat agadehen meshavvi la ochla kifkiin:
En merassekin et hashshachat. en mechattechin esev shel tevua, vehi aspasta, mishshum detircha shello letzorech hu:
Rabbi yehuda mattir becharuvin livhema dakka. sheshshinneha dakkot, vekashin lah. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Habbivin haamukkim. tzinnorot shemmekallechin mehen hashshefachim lirshut harabbim. veyesh sefarim shekkatuv bahem hakkuchim, leshon kuch, meara shettachat hakkarka:
Veafar hattichoach. deikka lemechash demechamat hannefel shekkavru sham naasa heafar tichoach:
Chazir uvardelas. darkan lachpor ulechappes tachat hakkarka, veim yimtzeu nefel kavur yotziuhu mishsham. bardelas, chayya shekkorin lah baaravi 193:

Mi shehechshich. noten kiso lenachri. mibbeod yom. veaf al gav dishlucho shel yisrael hu lissa et kiso beshabbat, kim lehu lerabbanan deen adam maamid atzmo al mamono, vei lo sharet leh ate laatoye arba ammot birshut harabbim:

Veim en immo nachri kulei. ha yesh immo nachri, lannachri yahev leh, may tama, chamor atta metzuvve al shevitato, nachri i atta metzuvve al shevitato. ucheshemmeniach kiso al hachamor mishshettechshach menicho aleha keshehi mehallechet, kelomar leachar sheakra ragleha lelech, delo avda akira, uchesherotza habbehema laamod notlo mealeha, uleachar shettachzor vetaakor ragleha lelech yenichenna aleha, ki hechi delo taavid habbehema akira vahanacha, dei shavek la lemebad akira vahanacha vehu mechammer achareha umanhigah nimtza mechammer achar behemto beshabbat veasur, af al pi sheenah teuna ella kol dehu, dichtiv (Shemot 20) lo taase [kol] melacha atta uvehemtecha, ezo hi melacha shennaaset ben haadam vehabbehema, heve omer ze mechammer:
Higgia lechatzer hachitzona. milleta beanpe nafsha hi velo bedin kiso ka mayre:
Lechatzer hachitzona. shel ir, shehu makom hammishtammer rishon, kesheyyavo lefarek hachamor notel beyado mealav kelim hannittalin beshabbat:
Vesheenam nittalim mattir et hachavalim. shel ukkaf shehen keshurim, vehassakkin noflim:
Lo yiskor adam poalim. dichtiv (yeshaya noach) mimtzo cheftzecha vedabber davar:

Velo yomar adam lachavero kulei. lediyyuka nakteh, lo yomar lachavero sechor lanu poalim, aval omer lo hanire shettaamod immi laerev, kelomar achshav nire im tavo elay lichshettechshach, veaf al pi sheshshenehem yodim sheal menat lesachro lifullato hu mazhiro, kevan delo mefaresh leh sechirut behedya share, dekayma lan dibbur asur hirhur muttar:

En machshichin al hattechum. lekarev atzmo beshabbat ad sof hattechum ulehachshich sham sheyyehe karov limkom happoalim o lappardes lehavi perot, dechol davar sheasur laasoto beshabbat asur lehacheshich alav, aval machshich hu lihyot karov latzet velishmor perotav, deze davar hammuttar beshabbat lishmor perotav:
Umevi ferot beyado. hoil veikkar machshavto lo hayta lechach:

Kelal amar abba shaul. attanna kamma paleg, deasar kol hacheshacha velo maflig ben hacheshacha shel mitzva lehacheshacha shel reshut, vaata ihu veamar dehachshacha shel mitzva sharya, shekkeshem shemmuttar lomar lachavero beshabbat tihye mezumman lelech leachar chashecha lehavi aron vetachrichim lammet, kach muttar lehacheshich al hattechum kede sheyyihye mezumman leachar chashecha lehavi aron vetachrichim. vesefa ditnan machshichim al hattechum [lefakkeach] al iske kalla veal iske hammet, abba shaul hi. vahalacha kemoto:

Et hashshevet. rubbo shel shevet sheavdu avoda zara bemezid, en danin ella bevet din shel shivim veechad. dichtiv (Devarim 17) vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahi el shearecha, ish veishsha atta motzi el shearecha, vei atta motzi et hashshevet el shearecha, ella bevet din haggadol:

Velo et nevi hashsheker. gamar davar davar mizzaken mamre, ketiv hacha (sham 18) asher yazid ledabber davar, uchetiv bezaken mamre (sham 17) ki yippale mimmecha davar, ma zaken mamre bevet din haggadol dichtiv (sham) vekamta vealita, af nevi sheker bevet din haggadol:
Velo et kohen gadol. deamar kera (Shemot 18) kol haddavar haggadol yaviu elecha, devarav shel gadol yaviu elecha. umoshe bimkom shivim veechad kae:
Veen motziin lemilchemet harshut. kol milchama chutz mimmilchemet shiva amamin umilchemet amalek, keruya milchemet harshut:

Ella vevet din shel shivim veechad. dichtiv bedavid (divrei hayamim 1 27) veachare achitofel benayahu ven yehoyada. achitofel ze yoetz, benayahu ven yehoyada zo sanhedrin, shehaya mufla shebbechullan vechullan nigrarim acharav:
Al hair. yerushalayim. shekkedushshatah gedola mishshear kedushshat eretz yisrael:

Vehaazarot. kedushshatan gedola mikkedushshat yerushalayim. vei efshar lechaddesh kedushsha ella bevet din shel shivim veechad, deamar kera (Shemot 25) kechol asher ani mare otcha vegomer‏ vechen taasu, ledorot. ma mishkan kadosh al pi moshe shehu vimkom sanhedri gedola, af letosefet ir vaazarot al pi sanhedri gedola:
Veen osin sanhedraot lashshevatim kulei. kidashkechan bemoshe deoke sanhedraot, umoshe bimkom shivim veechad kae:

En osin ir hanniddachat kulei. dichtiv (Devarim 17) vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahi, ish veishsha atta motzi el shearecha, levet din shebbeircha, vei atta motzi et kol hair el shearecha, ella lashshaar hameyuchad:

Bassefar. ir hammavdelet ben eretz yisrael leeretz haammim, dichtiv mikkirbecha, velo min hassefar. vetaama dikra, shemma yishmeu nachrim veyavou veyacharivu eretz yisrael, lefichach en mannichin hair tel olam kemishpat ir hanniddachat, aval horgin et yoshveha bilvad:
Velo shalosh. ayarot. ir hanniddachat bevet din echad uvemakom echad, kelomar kerovim zo lazo. aval bishnayim ushelosha mekomot osim:

Marot negaim sheloshim veshishsha. garsinan. velo garsinan marot negaim shishsha asar. usheloshim veshishsha havu, arbaa marot chalakot vearbaa marot petuchot deor basar, uchenegdan bishchin umichva, sheshshechin umichva achat hen velo chillekan hakkatuv ella lomar lach sheen mitztarfin, uchenegdan bintakim, uchenegdan bekarachat vegabbachat, shekkarachat vegabbachat achat hen, hare sheloshim ushenayim marot, virakrak vaadamdam denige vegadim, virakrak vaadamdam denige vattim, hare sheloshim veshishsha:

Akavya ven mahalalel omer shivim ushenayim. hanach sheloshim veshishsha vattechilla keshehuva el hakkohen, usheloshim veshishsha acharine chenegdan besof shavua rishon o besof shavua sheni shel hesger o besof shavua shelishi lenige vattim lehavechin ben mare shellechattechilla lemare shebbassof, hare shivim ushenayim. kach pershan harambam, veyashar hu. ella dekashya li begavva shehu mone shemona marot dintakin, vaanan kayma lan dintakin metammein bechol marot veen lahem marot meyuchadot kishar negaim:

Sheshshavua sheni shello chal beshabbat. dishne hesgerot shelosha asar yom deyom shevii shel shavua rishon ole lechan ulechan, dichtiv (Vayikra 13) vehisgiro [hakkohen] shivat yamim shenit, melammed sheyyom shevii ole lo min hamminyan millefanav umeacharav. vechen shelosha shavuot denige vattim enam ella tisha asar yom, derishon ushevii shel shavua emtzai olin lifnehem uleacharehem:

Chal lihyot betoch hashshabbat. shebbeyom hashshabbat chal shevii, en roim oto veshabbat, mippene shehu nire chedan et haddin beshabbat, ella mamtin ad leachar hashshabbat. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Rabbi meir omer af lo nige kerovav. deittakkush negaim lerivim, dichtiv (Devarim 21) kol riv vechol naga, ma rivim shello vikrovim, af negaim shello vikrovim. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Chutz minnidre atzmo. dichtiv (Bamidbar 30) lo yachel devaro, hu eno mechel aval acherim mochalin lo:

Af lo nidre ishto shebbenah leven acherim. kegon nedarim sheenan shel innuy nefesh udevarim sheenan beno levenah, shehen tzerichin chakirat chacham, veshemma yakel gabbe ishto velo yevakker yafe. vedavka bifne atzmo eno yachol lehattir vaafillu hu yachid mumche, aval mitztaref hu vichlal shelosha hedyotot, dechevan dahavu ve telata lo chashide shemma lo yachkeru yafe:
Kol habbechorot adam roe. im yecholin leachlan bemuman:
Hayta shel kash veshel kanim kulei. rabbi yehuda kaamar la, velet hilcheta kevateh:
Akumma. sheen ariach yachol lanuach aleha, vechen agulla en ariach nach bah:

Im yesh behekkefah. kelomar veezo hi middat haagulla lehacheshir, kol sheyyesh behekkefah shelosha tefachim, shetztzericha chut shelosha tefachim lehakkifah saviv, beyadua sheyyesh bah rochav tefach im techalek, shekken matzinu beyam sheasa shelomo (divrei hayamim 2 4) eser baamma missefato el sefato agol saviv vekav sheloshim baamma yissov oto saviv, alma lechol amma rochav beiggul ikka shalosh ammot hekkef:
Hechsher mavoy. hachanato vehazemanato shel mavoy letaltel betocho al yede shittufe mevoot:
Bet shammay omrim lechi vekora. shenehen tzarich, disvira lehu min hattora arba mechitztzot shelemot bainan, vaatay halacha lemoshe missinay veokimta larviit allechi vekora:

Uvet hillel omrim o lechi o kora. demin hattora shalosh mechitztzot [shelemot] bainan vetu lo, vaatay halacha lemoshe missinay lehosif harviit, o belechi mashshehu o bekora lehekker mechitztza. umavoy deayre beh hacha hu mavoy satum mishshalosh ruchotav veruach reviit petucha lirshut harabbim, vearko yoter al rachbo, dei arko kerachbo have kechatzer shennifretza happetucha lirshut harabbim vetzarich pas arbaa umashshehu o shene fassin shel kol shehen. vechen chatzer shennifretza lirshut harabbim vearkah yoter al rachbah niddona kemavoy venitteret belechi o kora. umavoy shehuchshar belechi chaluk mimmavoy shehuchshar bekora, deillu mavoy shehuchshar belechi have keillu yesh lo arba mechitztzot, vehazzorek mershut harabbim letocho chayyav, umavoy shehuchshar bekora af al pi shemmuttar letaltel betocho al yede shittuf lo have kirshut hayyachid gemura, vehazzorek mershut harabbim letocho patur, dekayma lan kora mishshum hekkera, velechi mishshum mechitztza:
Rabbi eliezer omer lechayayim. kevet shammay sevira leh, uvae lechi mikkan umikkan. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Amar talmid echad. hu rabbi meir:
Shehu fachot mearba ammot. rochav pitcho:

Amar rabbi akiva al ze veal ze nechelaku. vetanna kamma nammi hachi kaamar, delo maflig ben rachav lekatzar. umefaresh talmuda deikka benayhu mavoy sheyyesh berochav pitcho pachot mearbaa tefachim, dechad minnayhu savar en tzarich lo lechi velo kora, veidach savar tzarich lechi o kora, velo huvrar mittoch divrehem he minnayhu savar tzarich vehe minnayhu savar en tzarich:
Kol shebba bechammin. shennitbashshel:
Medichin. dahadachato enah bishshulo. aval lo shorin:
Chutz min hammaliach hayyashan. dag maliach sheavra alav shana mishshennimlach:
Vekuleyas haispanin. dag shekkelippato dakka, vahadachato bechammin hu gemar bishshulo:

Bet shammay omrim magbihin meal hashshulchan atzamot ukelippin. baggemara kaamar sheen anu somchim al mishnatenu kemot shehi shenuya, ella muchlefet hashshita, shebbet hillel omrin magbihin meal hashshulchan atzamot ukelippin, uvet shammay omrim mesallek et hattavla sheyyesh aleha torat keli aval lo yetaltel haatzamot vehakkelippin bayyadayim, devet hillel kerabbi shimon uvet shammay kerabbi yehuda. umihu lo sharu bet hillel ella baatzamot ukelippin dechazu lemaachal behema af al gav delo chazu lemaachal adam, aval i lo chazu af lemaachal behema modu bet hillel daasurim letaltel, devichhay gavna afillu rabbi shimon mode:
Maavirin meal hashshulchan perurin pachot mikkazzayit. afillu pachot mikkazzayit, vetama kedimfaresh besamuch, shehen reuyin lemaachal behema:
Vesear shel polin. sharvitim shehakkitnit gadel bahen:
Or bet achiza. bet achiza shel or sheyyochazennu bo:
En mekannechin bo. shekkesheochazo nischat ben etzbeotav vahave pesik resheh velo yamut, demode beh rabbi shimon:
Ben kach uven kach. ben yesh lo bet achiza ben en lo bet achiza, nittal beshabbat keshehu naguv:
Veeno mekabbel tuma. deeno lo keli etz velo beged velo sak velo mattechet:
Uvaal achoto vechulei. mishshum devaal keishto:
Vegiso. baal achot ishto:

Hem uvenehen vechatnehen. vedavka vanim uvanot sheyyesh lo legiso meachot ishto. aval im yesh lo vanim meishsha acheret, o chatanim nesuim levanot sheyyesh lo meishsha acheret, enan chashuvin kerovin:

Vechorgo. ben ishto meish acher. hu vilvad chashuv karov, aval ben chorgo vachatan chorgo lo. veeshet chorgo lo yaid lah, deishsha chevalah. vehaachim ze im ze, ben min haav ben min haem, hare hen rishon berishon. uvenehem ze im ze, sheni vesheni. uvene venehem ze im ze, shelishi vishlishi. uleolam shelishi verishon kasher. veen tzarich lomar shelishi vesheni. aval sheni vesheni veen tzarich lomar sheni verishon, shenehem pesulim. uchederech sheatta mone vazzecharim kach atta mone vannekevot, vechol ishsha sheatta fasul lah kach atta fasul levalah, vechol ish sheatta fasul lo kach atta fasul leishto:
Aval mishna rishona dodo uven dodo. veen halacha chemishna rishona:

Vechol harauy leyarsho. tashlum mishnato shel rabbi akiva hi velo mimmishna rishona. vechol harauy leyarsho, dehaynu kerove haav. aval kerove haem kegon achi immo shehizkarnu, kasher lo, shehare en achi immo rauy leyarsho. aval hu rauy lirash achi immo, lefichach hu fasul lehaid lo:
Haya karov. kegon chatano verauy leyarsho mechamat ishto:
Venitrachek. shemmeta ishto kodem sheraa edut zo:
Rabbi yehuda omer vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Mechattechin et haddeluin. hattelushin lifne habbehema, veaf al gav distaman lav lemaachal behema kayyeme ella laadam:
Veet hannevela. shennitnabbela hayyom, veaf al gav deven hashshemashot hayta omedet laadam velo labbehema:
Umoshe al gabbehem hare shivim veechad. deamar kera (Bamidbar 11) venasu ittecha, veat bahadayhu:
Rabbi yehuda omer shivim. dedaresh ittecha, bedomin lecha, velo sheyyihye hu yoshev immahen baddin. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Eda shofetet. asara mechayyevin:
Eda matztzelet. asara mezakkin. veshaminan minna detzarich sheyyihyu esrim, sheim yechalku yihyu asara mechayyevin vaasara mezakkin:

Hattayatcha leraa al pi shenayim. vehachi kaamar kera, lo tihye achare rabbim leraot, lechayyev al pi echad sheyyihye yater al hamezakkin. aval achare rabbim, lehattot bishnayim, afillu leraot, kesheyyihyu shenayim mechayyevin yoter al hamezakkin. hilkach al karchacha esrim ushelosha bainan, divtzir measara mezakkin lekka lememar, deha chetiv vehitztzilu haeda, vetu lo mashkachat chova bivtzir mishshenem asar:

Veen bet din shakul. en osin bet din zugot, sheim yechalku lachatzaim have lehu palga ufalga velo mashkachat la hattayatcha letova al pi echad. hilkach mosifin alehem od echad vehavu lehu esrim ushelosha:

Mea veesrim. mefaresh baggemara, esrim ushelosha, sanhedri ketanna. veshalosh shurot shel esrim ushelosha esrim ushelosha yoshvim lifnehem, sheim hutzrechu lehosif al haddayyanim mosifim mehem. vaasara vatlanim, asara vene adam betelim mikkol melacha sheyyoshvim tamid bevet hammidrash. ushene sofrim lichtov divre hamezakkin vedivre hamechayyevin. ushene chazzanim, shammashe vet din lehalekot hachayyav ulehazmin baale haddin. ushene vaale dinin. ushene edim. ushene zommin. ushene zomme zommin. ushene gabbaim, ushelishi lechallek hatztzedaka, shetztzedaka nigbet bishnayim umitchalleket bishlosha. verofe umman lehakkiz dam. velavlar. umelammed tinokot. hare mea veesrim:
Matayim usheloshim keneged sare asarot. dehaynu esrim ushelosha asiriyyot, sheyyehe chol dayyan sar shel asara. divtzir missare asara lo ashkechan serara. veen halacha kerabbi nechemya:
Tisha asar yom. rishon ushevii shel shavua emtzai olim lifnehem uleacharehem:
Pachot mishshavua echad. kegon shechin umichva:
Shelosha shavuot. kegon nige vattim:
Parperotav. mine maadannim:

Aval lo min hakketav. im katav meerev shabbat kach vechach orchim kede shello yishkechem, lo yikra beoto ketav beshabbat, gezera shemma yimchok. i nammi shemma yikra beshitre hedyotot, veen muttar likrot beshabbat ella battora shebbichtav, uvattora shebbeal pe leachar shekketavuha, uveferushehen, aval bishar devarim o besifre chachmot sheeno middivre nevua o mipperushehen, asurim:
Mefis. metil goral lechallek lemi yaggia kol mana umana:

Im banav veim bene beto. shehen semuchim al shulchano, sheen kan kefeda. aval im acher lo, divne chavura hammakpidim ze al ze sheenan mochalin veenan mevatterim ze laze ovrim mishshum midda umishshum mishkal umishshum minyan umishshum lovin uforin degazru behu rabbanan shemma yichtevu:

Uvilvad shello yitkavven vechulei. matnitin chasure michassera vehachi katane, mefis adam im banav veim bene beto al hashshulchan, vaafillu mana gedola keneged mana ketanna, vedavka im banav veim bene beto aval im acher lo, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot mana gedola keneged mana ketanna, veaz hu divyom tov asur uvechol share, aval im nitkavven laasot mana gedola keneged mana ketanna afillu bechol asur, mishshum kuvya, degezel hu veasmachta lo kanya, vehay asmachta hi, desamich al haggoral im yippol lo haggoral al hammana haggedola yizke bah, ulefichach tala atzmo af legoral hakketanna al hassafek, veillu yada mittechilla shekken, lo haya mitratztze:
Chalashim. goralot, kemo cholesh al goyim (yeshaya yad):
Al hakkadashim beyom tov. shennishchatu beyom tov, lechallek otam ben hakkohanim:
Aval lo al hammanot. shel kadashim shel etmol:
Keshehu mistapper. keshemmegalleach sear rosho:
Hannetakim. negaim shebbarosh o vazzakan keruyin netakim:
Besear tzahov dak battechilla. im battechilla nolad lo sear tzahov, machlito:
Tzahov. dome lezahav:

Besof shavua rishon uvesof shavua sheni. im besof shavua rishon pasa o nolad lo sear tzahov, machlito. veim lav, masgiro shenit, veim besof shavua sheni pasa o nolad lo sear tzahov, machlito. veim lav, potro. veim leachar happetur pasa o nolad lo sear tzahov, machlito:

Mearbaa marot hallalu mitztarfin. garsinan. velo garsinan arbaa marot, sheen kol haarbaa marot mitztarfin, deen hattolada mitztarefet ella im av shellah, ushete toladot zo im zo enan mitztarfin. aval shene avot mitztarfin, middichtiv vehaya veor besaro, velo chetiv vehayu, mashma sheose seet uvaheret keechad, dei ikka chatzi geris mizze vachatzi geris mizze mitztarfin lechaggeris. verambam katav, dechol haarbaa marot mitztarfin, ben shete hattoladot zo im zo ben av im tolada sheenah shello, kol mikkerum betza ulemala mitztarfin. vehattosefta mesayyato:
Liftor ulehachlit ulehasgir. lechol hanach mille mitztarfin. vechullehu mefaresh lehu:
Lehasegir haomed besof shavua rishon. dichtiv (Vayikra 13) veraahu hakkohen bayyom hashshevii vehinne hannega amad beenav vehisgiro hakkohen shivat yamim shenit:

Veliftor et haomed besof shavua sheni. shehaomed beshiuro velo fasa veamad bemarehu, af al pi shello yarad lematta mearbaa marot, potro vesof shavua sheni. veha dichtiv (sham) veraa hakkohen oto bayyom hashshevii shenit vehinne keha hannega vegomer‏ vetiharo hakkohen, lav lememra deen metaharo ella im ken kaha, ella ashmeinan kera daafillu nishtanna mishsheleg lesid o missid lesheleg lo amrinan nega acher hu vechozer umasgiro chattechilla, ella cheomed dame umetaharo:

Lehachelit et shennolad lo michya o sear lavan battechilla. keshehuva vitchillato el hakkohen veyesh bo vaheret kaggeris umichyat basar kaadasha merubbaat betoch mekom habbaheret, machlito miyyad. vechen nammi sear lavan, im haya shachor velo hispik lehasegiro ad shehafach lelavan, machlito miyyad. aval pisyon lo metamme vattechilla afillu fose veholech ad shello hisgir:
Besof shavua rishon. kelomar lehachelit kemo chen besof shavua rishon, shemmittechilla lo hayu lo simanin hallalu vehisgiro, ulesof shavua rishon matza vo michya o sear lavan, machlito:
O besof shavua sheni. kegon divsof shavua rishon amad beenav velo haya vo lo sear lavan velo michya, [vehisgiro paam shenit], uvesof shavua sheni noldu vo simanim hallalu, machlito:
Leachar happetur. kelomar vaafillu leachar happetur shebbesof shavua sheni lo noldu vo simane tuma ufetaro, uleachar kamma yamim noldu, machlito:

Lehachelit et shennolad lo fisyon besof shavua rishon o besof shavua sheni. kegon baheret kaggeris sheen bah michya velo sear lavan vehisgirah, im pasta vesof shavua rishon o lo fasta ella vesof shavua sheni, machlito. veim lo fasta lo beshavua rishon velo veshavua sheni ufetaro uleachar kamma yamim pasta, machlito:
Lehachelit et hahofech kullo lavan mittoch happetur. im achar sheppetaro vetiharo hakkohen parcha hatztzaraat bechullo, tame muchlat:

Liftor et hahofech kullo lavan mittoch hechlet o mittoch hesger. im leachar shettimmeo hakkohen, o leachar shehuzkak lehesger kodem shettimmeo, parcha hatztzaraat bechullo, potro vetahor, shehappericha osa min hattahor tame umin hattame tahor. vehammusgar tame mikkere:
Ellu marot negaim. arbaa marot ellu shehizkarnu, chalakot o fetuchot:
